data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**MAIN OBJECTIVE OF ROLE**
 To oversee the Procurement \& Technology portfolio, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities and compliance with governance standards, while monitoring initiative progress, validating business cases, and ensuring proper documentation and budget approvals.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Provides strategic oversight and direction for the entire portfolio, ensuring alignment with departmental and flydubai’s objectives.
* Leads the portfolio review process, ensuring timely and accurate reporting on key metrics such as budget, timelines, risks, and outcomes, while providing updates on portfolio status, performance, key milestones, potential roadblocks, and necessary corrective actions.
* Verifies and approves all relevant documents and ensure budget approvals are completed before submitting for the final sign\-off.
* Acts as a liaison between the Chief and departments under their supervision, ensuring smooth communication and timely updates on critical updates.
* Collaborates with other departments to identify interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive synergy across the flydubai portfolio.
* Validates all business cases and feasibility studies in coordination with department heads to ensure sound decision\-making.
* Tracks and manages the overall budget within the portfolio, ensuring compliance with corporate financial governance and budgetary controls, while ensuring efficiency and alignment with organizational objectives.
* Supports decision\-making by providing data\-driven analysis and recommendations on key initiatives.
* Manages escalations from department heads and other key stakeholders to ensure swift resolution of issues.
* Coordinates governance activities between the portfolio and the corporate Project Management Office, ensuring alignment on processes and reporting.
* Leads cross\-functional collaboration to ensure alignment on key initiatives across flydubai.
* Documents and administers corporate claims, ensuring proper record\-keeping and communication with relevant departments.
* Coordinates and updates project statuses to the flydubai corporate office and explores new technologies and efficiency improvements, implementing projects within Technology and Supply chain
* Develops and implements measures and metrics tailored to support technology and supply chain improvement projects, analyzing Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to identify key trends and makes recommendations for operational improvements.
* Liaises with external stakeholders during the investigation and implementation phases of business initiatives, while monitoring the progress and the efficiency improvement projects and provides updates to senior management.
* Identifies potential risks to the CTSC and develops strategies to mitigate these risks and ensures compliance with industry regulations and standards in all business improvement initiatives, ensuring all project initiatives align with flydubais strategic objectives and corporate goals.


**Qualifications**
* Masters Degree (2\+ years)
* Aviation Business Management Specialization.
* Fluent in English
* Demonstrable experience in effectively managing projects, with a proven ability to plan, execute, and achieve desired outcomes within specified timelines. Experience in aviation within IT.
* 7 \- 9 years
* Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification


**COMPETENCIES**
* Customer Focus
* Team work
* Effective Communication
* Personal Accountability \& Commitment to achieve
* Resilience and Flexibility (Can do attitude)


**Isr Requirements**
 Reads and complies with the ISR policies of the Company and diligently reports any weakness or incidents to the respective Line Manager or the Information Security team. Completes all required ISR awareness sessions and follows associated guidelines in the day\-to\-day business operations.

 Sector: Airlines and Aviation

data.jd_text:
Who We Are
   

  

 Fueled by passion, KAYALI was founded in 2018 by beauty mogul and fragrance fanatic, Mona Kattan. Translating to ‘my imagination' in Arabic, KAYALI provides a modern fragrance experience inspired by Mona's rich Middle Eastern heritage and the art of layering scents to help you create your mood; where sharing scents is a ritual and smelling good is both an act of goodwill and self\-love. Mona collaborates with some of the world's most renowned perfumers and sources the finest ingredients to create unique juices that are infinitely memorable, long\-lasting, and cruelty\-free. Each luxurious fragrance is an ode to true craftsmanship and tells a special story, from the addictive notes to the multi\-faceted jeweled bottles.
   

  

 Our Mission
   

  

 To make everyone feel like the diamond they are! To build a global community of fragrance lovers through the power of scent and by providing them with the most innovative \& luxurious fragrances, education and sharing our Middle Eastern fragrance rituals with the world.
   

  

**Summary**
 The Director of NPD \& Projects will own and lead the global product development project management function, ensuring seamless execution across all stages of the product development lifecycle, spanning concept creation, feasibility assessment, development, launch readiness, and post\-launch optimization. This leadership role will drive adoption of a standardized Stage\-Gate model across all innovation projects, driving speed\-to\-market, cross\-functional alignment, and operational excellence at scale.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
**Strategic Leadership \& NPD Excellence**
* Own and evolve KAYALI's Stage\-Gate product development framework, ensuring clear governance, decision\-making, and accountability across all phases of the lifecycle
* Define and govern stage gates, including entry/exit criteria, decision checkpoints, and escalation protocols
* Lead the development of the 24\-month global launch roadmap, ensuring alignment with brand, commercial, and supply strategies
* Drive continuous improvement of speed\-to\-market while balancing innovation, risk, and quality
* Act as the central point of accountability for on\-time, in\-full (OTIF) delivery of all launches globally


**Stage 0\-1: Concept \& Feasibility**
* Ensure robust front\-end innovation processes, including clear concept definition, consumer insight integration, and strategic opportunity sizing
* Oversee feasibility assessment across formula, packaging, regulatory, and supply capabilities
* Validate business cases (cost, margin, timelines, scale viability) prior to gate approval
* Align cross\-functional stakeholders on risk, trade\-offs, and go/no\-go decisions early in the process


**Stage 2: Development \& Validation**
* Oversee end\-to\-end development across all projects, ensuring alignment on timelines, KPIs, and quality standards
* Ensure rigorous management of formulation, packaging development, testing, and regulatory validation
* Drive disciplined milestone tracking, risk mitigation, and issue escalation across all active projects
* Build and maintain robust project timelines, ensuring proactive tracking, risk management, and milestone adherence
* Establish clear governance across projects, including stage gates, decision frameworks, and escalation protocols


**Stage 3: Industrialization \& Launch Readiness**
* Lead transition from development to production, ensuring readiness across manufacturing, supply chain, and logistics
* Oversee forecasting, demand alignment, and order placement in partnership with Demand Planning and Regional Markets
* Ensure all launch readiness criteria are met, including operational, commercial, and regulatory requirements
* Drive accountability for OTIF delivery across all launches


**Stage 4: Launch \& Post\-Launch Optimization**
* Track launch performance against defined KPIs, including sales, forecast accuracy, OTIF, and operational delivery
* Champion a mindset of innovation, agility, and continuous improvement
* Drive post\-launch reviews to capture learnings and inform future pipeline decisions
* Identify opportunities for optimization, reformulation, or lifecycle extension
* Embed continuous improvement across tools, processes, and ways of working to elevate efficiency and scalability


**Cross\-Functional Orchestration**
* Act as the central connector across all functions, ensuring alignment, accountability, and transparency across each stage gate \[JD \-Direct...dits).docx \| Word]
* Lead structured cross\-functional forums aligned to stage\-gate checkpoints
* Ensure clear communication of risks, priorities, and decisions to senior leadership


**Supplier \& External Partner Management**
* Ensure external partners are fully aligned to stage\-gate timelines, deliverables, and quality standards
* Integrate suppliers early in feasibility and development phases to de\-risk execution
* Drive accountability across manufacturing and supply partners through industrialization


**Risk Management \& Operational Excellence**
* Embed proactive risk identification and mitigation at each stage of the product lifecycle
* Establish structured "red flag" reporting tied to stage\-gate decision points


**Forecasting \& Launch Readiness**
* Oversee launch forecasting in collaboration with Demand Planning and Regional Markets
* Ensure accurate submission of forecasts and timely placement of orders for components and finished goods
* Drive excellence in launch readiness, ensuring all operational elements are aligned ahead of go\-live


**Team Leadership \& Capability Building**
* Lead and scale a high\-performing NPD \& Projects team, ensuring the right structure, capabilities, and resourcing to support business growth
* Set clear objectives, priorities, and performance expectations across the team, driving accountability and ownership
* Coach and develop team members, providing ongoing feedback, mentorship, and career development support
* Foster a culture of collaboration, agility, and continuous improvement, aligned with KAYALI values
* Ensure strong resource planning and workload prioritization across projects to optimize team efficiency
* Partner with People \& Culture to attract, retain, and develop top talent within the function


**Requirements**
* 10\+ years of experience in New Product Development, Project Management, or Transformation within beauty, fragrance, or luxury consumer goods
* Proven track record of leading complex, cross\-functional global launches
* Strong expertise across product development and end\-to\-end supply chain processes
* Experience building and leading high\-performing teams
* Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence at all levels
* Strong strategic thinking combined with operational rigor and attention to detail
* Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Asana, MS Project, etc.)
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, founder\-led, high\-growth environment


**Benefits**
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage
* Find your Magic Days
* Volunteer Day
* Birthday Leave
* Egg Freezing Benefits
* Employee discounts on all Kayali products
* Quarterly product gifting


 KAYALI is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.

data.jd_text:
**Who We Are**
 At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.
   

  

**The Role**
 The Complex Program Manager is responsible for leading and delivering large\-scale, high\-impact programs characterized by significant complexity, ambiguity, and cross\-functional dependencies. The role ensures alignment of program outcomes with strategic business objectives while managing scope, schedule, budget, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
   

  

 This position requires the ability to translate strategic vision into a portfolio of interconnected projects and drive successful execution through strong governance, leadership, and decision\-making capabilities.
   

  

**Program Leadership \& Delivery**
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of complex transformation programs with multiple interdependent workstreams
* Translate strategic objectives into structured program roadmaps with clear milestones and deliverables
* Ensure alignment between program scope, contractual commitments, and business outcomes


**Governance \& Risk Management**
* Establish and maintain robust governance frameworks aligned with organizational standards
* Identify, assess, and proactively manage risks, issues, and dependencies
* Drive decision\-making through governance forums and executive\-level reporting


**Stakeholder \& Executive Management**
* Act as the primary interface for senior stakeholders, sponsors, and clients
* Manage stakeholder expectations, resolve conflicts, and ensure alignment across teams
* Provide clear, concise executive updates, insights, and recommendations


**Financial \& Commercial Management**
* Own program financials, including budgeting, forecasting, and margin management
* Ensure contractual and commercial compliance (SLAs, financial targets)
* Drive value realization and benefits tracking across the program lifecycle


**Planning \& Execution Oversight**
* Ensure integrated planning across all program workstreams
* Monitor performance using KPIs, milestones, and success metrics
* Implement corrective actions to address deviations in scope, schedule, cost, or quality


**People Leadership \& Capability Development**
* Lead, mentor, and develop project managers and cross\-functional delivery teams
* Build high\-performing teams aligned with program objectives
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement


**Change \& Transformation Management**
* Assess organizational readiness and manage resistance to change
* Define and execute change management strategies
* Ensure delivery of measurable business outcomes and adoption of solutions


**Your Future at Kyndryl**
 Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands\-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
   

  

**Required Skills And Experience**
* 10\+ years of experience in program/project management, with proven delivery of complex transformation programs
* Demonstrated experience managing large\-scale, cross\-functional, and multi\-vendor environments
* Strong leadership skills across complex, multi\-stream programs
* Advanced stakeholder management and executive communication capabilities
* Solid expertise in governance, risk management, and compliance frameworks
* Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, and margin management
* Strategic thinking with strong analytical and decision\-making skills
* High resilience, adaptability, and ability to operate in ambiguous environments


**Preferred Skills And Experience**
* Experience delivering large\-scale technology programs (Cloud, Digital Transformation, Data/AI, Enterprise Platforms)
* Proven track record working in global or highly matrixed organizations
* Experience driving organizational change and transformation initiatives
* Strong commercial awareness and experience managing contractual obligations
* Certifications: PMP / PgMP; PRINCE2 Practitioner; Other relevant program or portfolio management certifications


**Being You**
 The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.
   

  

**What You Can Expect**
 Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
   

  

 From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
   

  

 We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
   

  

 We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.
   

  

**Get Referred!**
 If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

 Join us as our next
 **Head of Regulatory Systems Strategy** 
 reporting to our Head Compliance Management \& Customer Excellence. We are looking for an experienced Regulatory Solution Lead with a track record in leading delivery of compliance\-by\-system design solutions, and data lake design within the FMCG industry. You will combine your regulatory expertise, systems capability knowledge and project management to lead complex, projects within the Fragrance \& Beauty systems ecosystem, to lead our digital compliance transformation strategy.
   

  

 You will be a bridge between Regulatory Affairs, Product Safety, IT, and Business and other departmental teams. You will lead cross\-functional collaboration from concept to delivery, promoting compliance innovation that enhances capability, speed, quality, and trust across our organisation, and to the benefit of our customers.
   

  

**Location** 
 NJ (USA), Dubai (U.A.E); Sigapore. Based on the candidate's current location.

*Salary expectation based on technical experience 150,000 \- 200,000 usd \- This Range is for US*

*Salary expectation based on technical experience and will be in local currency.*
**In this exciting role you will**
* Lead multiple regulatory compliance system design projects, from concept to delivery, aligned with Givaudan's multi\-year digital transformation programme.
* Lead the end\-to\-end design scope, testing and validation of solutions, and driving overall project goals.
* Partner with multiple cross functional stakeholders, combining programme leadership, stakeholder engagement, and strategic foresight.
* Stakeholder \& Team Coordination Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (data scientists, developers, business analysts) and translate complex Technical concepts for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ensure regulatory understanding of modern cloud, data, and product architectures.Promote delivery practices across the project portfolio, with emphasis on value delivery, risk management, and continuous improvement.

* Experience leading Regulatory data or Compliance\-related projects within global, cross\-functional environments in the FMCG Industry.
* Ability to interpret and operationalise complex regulatory frameworks into system and design solutions.
* Experience engaging diverse stakeholders.
* Experience promoting compliance into innovation, aligned with Givaudan's commitment to sustainable and compliant growth.


**Additional Requirements**
* Experience in SAP ECC to S/4HANA transition project

* Medical
* Dental
* Vision
* Vacation days

data.jd_text:
**Summary** 




 The Programme Manager will lead the design, development, and execution of Pearl Initiative’s (PI) Governance in Technology Programme. This role will build Pearl Initiative’s thought leadership and impact in strengthening and enabling the technology and artificial intelligence sector in the GCC Region. Programming will especially focus on advancing corporate governance; ethical, strategic, and accountable decision\-making; transparency and disclosure; and governance\-enabled innovation amongst technology actors and investors. They will lead the business development, revenue generation, and fundraising initiatives of the programme, ensuring high\-impact and compliant delivery of all projects and contracts.
 



  





 Success in this role requires a strategic, detail\-oriented, and relationship\-driven leader who can design and implement high\-impact programming. This includes managing a strategic regional working group, delivering targeted interventions and projects, producing research and thought leadership that address the evolving needs of the sector, and hosting convenings and dedicated trainings.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Programmatic development and innovation** 



* Lead the design, development, planning, and budgeting of the programme strategically aligned with organisation goals and impact objectives ensuring cost\-effectiveness and efficient resource allocation.
* Drive programmatic innovation within existing offering, identifying opportunities to enhance programme effectiveness, efficiency, and impact.
* Identify and enable cross\-programmatic synergies, intersections, and collaborations.
* Identify and integrate subject matter experts, executive trainers and coaches, researchers, and any other third parties to co\-create programmatic projects and deliverables.
* Co\-create a strategic communications strategy, including priority social media channels and email campaigning, for the programme.



  





**Business development, community enablement, and financial sustainability** 



* Develop and execute a business development and market stakeholders' engagement strategy by identifying key target markets, potential funding sources, and partnership opportunities.
* Manage an annual market engagement calendar.
* Co\-define funding targets to cover programmatic costs and work towards reserving longer\-term working capital to ensure the financial sustainability of the programme.
* Explore and develop new revenue streams for the programme to diversify funding and enhance financial sustainability.
* Develop and lead community\-building initiatives, such as workshops, convenings, online forums, and networking events, to facilitate knowledge sharing, collaboration, and relationship development.
* Represent the organization by actively participating in relevant events, building new relationships with potential partners and collaborators, and promoting the organisation's programmes.
* Lead the development of compelling proposals that effectively communicate the value proposition of programmes to potential funders and partners, highlighting impact, sustainability, and strategic alignment with their objectives.
* Negotiate and finalise funding agreements and partnership contracts.



  





**Projects management and contracts compliance** 



* Manage the design, execution, and timely high\-quality delivery of collaborative needs\-based projects and flagship initiatives, focused on research, executive education, capacity\-building, and convenings.
* Adopt best practices in project management across all projects and initiatives, defining clear project scopes, developing detailed project plans, assigning roles and responsibilities, and implementing robust tracking and reporting.
* Manage programme teams and insourced third parties to ensure high accountability, strong performance, and preemptive risk management.
* Oversee the successful execution and delivery of all projects in line with contractual obligations, project timelines, and quality standards.
* Run projects and initiatives with careful cost control and resource allocation to support efforts to achieve financial sustainability with long\-term working capital.
* Proactively communicate project and initiative updates to clients, partners, and internal stakeholders with timely reports on progress, challenges, and successes.



  





**Expertise development and thought leadership** 



* Identify, study, and learn from market needs and pain points through research and stakeholder engagement to identify strategic opportunities for impact and growth.
* Lead the development of market\-driven solutions by translating identified market needs and pain points into actionable programme initiatives.
* Curate and convene the programme’s working group, bringing in together working group members and special guests.
* Monitor the market’s offering, notable trends, and any disruptions to consistently strategically position the programme.
* Produce a consistent pipeline of high\-quality, original bi\-lingual content (e.g., op\-eds, articles, blog posts, white papers, research reports, and working group position papers) that showcases expertise and generates meaningful conversations within the industry.
* Build a strong online presence by actively engaging in priority social media channels (e.g., LinkedIn, Twitter, industry\-specific forums) to share content, participate in discussions, and network with other thought leaders.
* Cultivate relationships with journalists, analysts, and other industry influencers to amplify thought leadership and reach a wider audience.



  





**Team mentorship and development** 



* Mentor and coach Programme Associate, providing timely and actionable feedback, creating teachable opportunities, and offering programme career guidance.
* Define and monitor the development plan of Programme Associate, with regular pulse checks, ensuring time and any needed resources are allocated for training.
* Enable career growth, including promotions, for Programme Associate.



  





**Impact measurement and reporting** 



* Co\-define quarterly and yearly key impact metrics and engagement KPIs for the programme, ensuring milestones are achievable and validated with feasibility assessments.
* Develop surveys and feedback forms for programmatic impact and performance based on impact strategy, methodology, and templates.
* Coordinate data collection of surveys and feedback forms for programmatic impact and performance.
* Analyze data of surveys and feedback forms to study and learn from achieved and non\-achieved programmatic impact and performance, based on key impact metrics and engagement KPIs identified in impact strategy.
* Develop an impact baseline assessment for the programme to measure progress towards meeting key market needs and addressing critical market gaps.
* Recommend and implement programmatic improvements, expansions, and other strategic directions from data and insights.
* Prepare impact reports and communicate findings on key impact metrics and engagement KPIs at key programme and project milestones.
* Curate, co\-author, and publish programme specific sections for the annual report.



  





**Tech\-enabled skills development** 



* Proficiently use tools and technology solutions to strengthen team productivity, project management, business development, and research through continuous learning and training.
* Attend expert\-led or executive training workshops relevant for programme development, project management, impact management, storytelling and writing.
* Attend expert\-led or executive training workshops relevant for programme and related special topics.



  





**Qualifications and experience** 



* A master’s degree in a relevant field such as Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, and / or the social sciences, or a related discipline, with proven expertise and strong analytical skills.
* Additional certifications in project management, corporate governance, data governance, impact measurement, or technology management are highly desirable.

data.jd_text:
**About the Company**
 Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
   

  

 Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2\.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70\+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.
   

  

***We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem\-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.***
**About The Role**
 As a Program Manager within the Product organisation, you will be the bridge that brings colleagues together to deliver complex, cross\-functional technical initiatives — often with tight deadlines and multi\-layered dependencies. You will build relationships grounded in trust and integrity across the organisation and with third\-party partners, enabling you to break through collaboration barriers, resolve conflicts, and manage risks effectively.
   

  

 This role sits within the Rides Product team, which leads product strategy and delivery for the Rides vertical to simplify mobility for customers. You will play a critical role ensuring complex programmes land on time, to a high standard, and with full visibility across the organisation — including across third\-party integration boundaries.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Work closely with engineers, product managers, designers, researchers, data analysts, commercial leaders, and operations teams to conceptualise cross\-functional initiatives with layered dependencies and plan their execution
* Organise and align multiple stakeholders — including third\-party partners — to drive timely, accountable execution
* Develop a solid understanding of the technical architecture to exercise sound judgment on risks, trade\-offs, and cross\-team dependencies
* Drive progress transparency through structured communication of status, blockers, and upcoming milestones across all levels of the organisation
* Lead incident coordination, post\-mortems, and closure of action items to build systemic resilience over time
* Own go\-live orchestration for major launches — including rollout gates, rollback triggers, and cross\-functional readiness sign\-offs
* Track and flag resourcing risks to support delivery pace and quality
* Maintain the programme's source of truth: decision logs, dependency registers, and status documentation
* Contribute to process improvement within the programme scope — identifying friction points and proposing better ways of working
* Support and contribute to tools and dashboards that surface delivery health, pace, and quality for the Rides vertical
* Embed AI tooling into core programme workflows — synthesizing meeting intelligence, surfacing dependency risks, and maintaining high\-quality stakeholder comms at pace — and actively raise the team's capability to do the same


**What You'll Need**
* 5\+ years of experience as a Program Manager in a fast\-paced engineering organisation
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand distributed systems and architectural trade\-offs
* Background in fundamental engineering concepts including SSDLC, testing methodologies, API monitoring metrics, and SLAs
* Proficiency with Agile delivery frameworks (Scrum, SAFe, or equivalent)
* Experience managing programmes with significant third\-party integration dependencies
* Familiarity with programme management and analytics tooling (e.g. Jira, Confluence, dashboarding tools)
* Operationally fluent with AI tools: for programme synthesis, risk stress\-testing, and communication
* Deep familiarity with the delivery complexity of programmes with significant external API and third\-party integration dependencies — including SLA implications, incident ownership boundaries, and rollback constraints across organisational lines
* Strong communication skills — able to distil complex information clearly for both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Demonstrated ability to work across multiple teams and manage cross\-organisational stakeholders
* Proven ability to operate with confidence in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments with frequent priority shifts
* Passionate problem solver who adapts their approach to evolving requirements and organisational contexts


**What We’ll Provide You**
 We offer colleagues the opportunity to drive impact in the region while they learn and grow. As a full time Careem colleague, you will be able to:
   

  

* Work and learn from great minds by joining a community of inspiring colleagues.
* Put your passion to work in a purposeful organisation dedicated to creating impact in a region with a lot of untapped potential.
* Explore new opportunities to learn and grow every day.
* Work remotely from any country in the world for 30 days a year with unlimited vacation days per year.
* Access to healthcare benefits and fitness reimbursements for health activities including gym, health club, and training classes.

**Preferred qualifications:**
* 10 years of multi\-disciplinary experience in network, fiber, electrical, and mechanical (cooling) systems.
* Experience working with global carriers and stakeholders in the EMEA and APAC telecommunications and data center markets.
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to navigate through ambiguity and build consensus among high\-level executive stakeholders.
* Proven track record in New Product Initiatives (NPI), specifically in defining standards for deployable infrastructure solutions.


**About The Job**
 Google's projects, like our users, span the globe and require managers to keep the big picture in focus while being able to dive into the unique engineering challenges we face daily. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you lead complex, multi\-disciplinary engineering projects using your engineering expertise. You plan requirements with internal customers and usher projects through the entire project lifecycle. This includes managing project schedules, identifying risks and clearly communicating them to project stakeholders. You're equally at home explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical trade\-offs in product development with engineers.
   

  

 Using your extensive technical and leadership expertise, you manage various Engineering\-specific programs and teams.
   

  

 The Fiber Infrastructure Engineering and Delivery team is a unified organization within Google Global Infrastructure, integrating the expertise of capacity infrastructure engineering, network infrastructure engineering, and fiber and capacity delivery. Our mission is to deliver the resilient long\-haul and metro fiber assets and data center network space that power Google's global growth and AI leadership. We operate at the intersection of cutting\-edge technology and global scale, ensuring Google’s network infrastructure is the most reliable and efficient on the planet.
   

  

 This role requires approximately 25% travel, mostly to Google’s data centers around the globe.
   

  

 Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Orchestrate program strategy across East EU and MENA to drive consistency and economies of scale. Be able to strengthen alignment between technical requirements and business objectives by providing advanced insights facilitating executive decision\-making.
* Define requirements for the Google Global Network, designing data center infrastructure (space, power, cooling) and define new product deployment globally.
* Manage complex relationships globally. Influence and collaborate with design engineering firms, carriers, internal engineering teams, and senior executives to solve large\-scale network growth challenges.
* Establish systems to identify and implement innovative solutions that optimize project delivery. Manage risks and drive improvements in lead\-time, predictability, and cost\-effectiveness.
* Lead a global team of technical program managers. Foster growth mindset and culture of learning, ensuring the team's skills are transferable across technical domains.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

data.jd_text:
A high\-growth, multi\-asset trading group is hiring a Head of Product \& PMO to lead the performance of its trading ecosystem and the execution of strategic initiatives across global operations. The business runs two regulated trading platforms covering FX, CFDs and equities on one side, and crypto spot, perpetual futures, margin and copy trading on the other, serving retail, high\-net\-worth and institutional clients across multiple jurisdictions.
 



  





 This is a dual mandate sitting at the intersection of commercial product leadership and disciplined programme delivery. You will own the product P\&L across crypto and traditional asset classes, shape monetisation strategy, and stand up the PMO function that governs how initiatives are planned, prioritised and delivered across the group.
 



  





**What you will lead** 



* Product strategy and monetisation across all trading products, with continuous refinement based on performance data, competitor moves and market dynamics.
* Full product P\&L ownership across crypto and traditional offerings, driving revenue growth, profitability and unit economics across every product line.
* Establishment and leadership of the PMO function, including governance frameworks, standardised processes, reporting and delivery tracking across all strategic initiatives.
* User acquisition, activation, retention and lifetime value strategy, with constant optimisation of user journeys, trading activity and product stickiness.
* Pricing architecture across trading fees, spreads and liquidity incentive structures, balancing competitiveness with revenue optimisation.
* Data\-driven experimentation and delivery measurement, with structured frameworks for both product and programme outcomes.
* Cross\-functional alignment across Trading, Technology, Marketing, Sales and Operations, ensuring the PMO drives genuine coordination rather than reporting overhead.
* Global expansion and regional product adaptation, maintaining global consistency while tuning for local market fit.
* Leadership and scaling of both the Product and PMO teams, with clear KPIs, accountability and a high\-performance culture.



  





**What we are looking for** 



* 8 to 12\+ years in product management and/or programme management, ideally within crypto, trading, FinTech or financial services. Proven track record of owning product P\&L and delivering complex cross\-functional initiatives. Strong understanding of trading platforms, market structures and monetisation. Experience establishing or running PMO functions and delivery frameworks. Data\-driven analytical mindset. Track record of leading high\-performing product and project teams in fast\-paced, high\-growth environments.
* Preferred: exposure across both crypto and traditional financial products, deep understanding of trading behaviour, liquidity and execution dynamics, multi\-market product and delivery experience, and fluency with Agile, Scrum or hybrid delivery methodologies.



  





**Location** 




 Dubai, onsite. Relocation supported
 








**PACKAGE** 




**Base salary in the region of USD 120,000 to 130,000 per annum, paid in AED. Performance\-related annual bonus. ESOP participation. Standard UAE benefits**

* Excellent English communication skills, Prior direct experience in the Middle East is a significant advantage.

* Familiarity with FIDIC\-based consultancy agreements, IBM DOORS\-NG/ELM, and Aconex.
* Experience on airport express, airport connector, or inter\-terminal transit rail systems.

 We are a leading provider of innovative and high\-performance solutions for airport logistics. Our portfolio includes products and solutions for baggage and cargo handling, high\-end software for the digitalization of logistics processes as well as an extensive range of maintenance and services. Major customers include renowned airports and airlines around the globe.

**What are my responsibilities?**
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of airport BHS/MHS programs, ensuring safe, on\-budget, contract\-compliant execution.
* Serve as senior client and stakeholder lead, aligning airport authorities/operators, consultants/PMCs, contractors, and internal teams.

* Proficient in project tools (e.g., MS Project/Primavera, MS Office; Jira/Confluence is a plus).
* Willingness to travel and operate in dynamic airport environments.
* Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 Amazon Now is building the future of ultra\-fast grocery delivery across the Middle East. We are looking for a Program Manager to drive measurable improvements across store capacity management, cost\-per\-order reduction, and delivery speed (Click\-to\-Door).
   

  

 This role sits within the Operations Excellence function and is responsible for identifying, scoping, and delivering high\-impact programmes that improve customer experience and unit economics across Amazon Now’s network in Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 You will work across Last Mile, Middle Mile, and Under\-The\-Roof (UTR) operations to find inefficiencies, build the business case, and drive cross\-functional execution. This is not a reactive role, you will proactively identify opportunities before they become problems, connect the dots across operational channels, and ensure every initiative ladders up to CX outcomes and P\&L impact.
   

  

 The right candidate is analytically sharp, comfortable with ambiguity, and operates with a bias for action. You think in systems, not silos. You’re as comfortable in the data as you are in a room with senior stakeholders making the case for change.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Store Capacity \& Cost Management
   

  

* Own programmes to optimise store capacity utilization, including bin density, ASIN rationalisation, gas tank management, and space allocation across darkstores.
* Drive cost\-per\-order reduction across the end\-to\-end operation: UTR pick efficiency, DA (Delivery Associate) productivity, hub\-to\-store transhipment costs, and middle mile truck utilisation.
* Analyse operational cost structures to identify the highest\-leverage opportunities for unit economics improvement. Build business cases with clear ROI and execution plans.
* Partner with UTR, Last Mile, and Middle Mile teams to implement changes that reduce waste, improve throughput, and lower cost\-to\-serve without degrading customer experience.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting mechanisms to track capacity utilisation and cost metrics across KSA stores.


 Delivery Speed \& Click\-to\-Door (C2D)
   

  

* Own the programme roadmap for C2D reduction, identifying bottlenecks across order acceptance, pick \& pack, dispatch, and last mile delivery.
* Analyse delivery defects, early delivery marking, Did\-Not\-Receive (DNR) patterns, and other CX pain points to drive root cause resolution.
* Identify and eliminate handoff delays between UTR, Middle Mile, and Last Mile that contribute to C2D inflation.


 Project \& Programme Delivery
   

  

* Scope, plan, and execute operational improvement projects end\-to\-end, from opportunity identification through to measurable business impact.
* Build and manage a portfolio of initiatives across capacity, cost, and speed, with clear prioritisation based on CX and P\&L impact.
* Create mechanisms for project tracking, stakeholder communication, and escalation. Maintain a clear view of project status, risks, and dependencies.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment with ACES, Tech, Finance, Category, and operations teams to remove blockers and deliver on commitments.
* Contribute to the development of scalable solutions that can be replicated across KSA stores, solve once, scale everywhere.


 Cross\-Functional Influence \& Visibility
   

  

* Operate as the connective tissue between operational channels, ensuring improvements in one area don’t create problems in another.
* Build visibility into operational performance through data, dashboards, and regular reporting cadences (WBR/MBR contributions).
* Influence without authority, drive outcomes through data\-backed recommendations, clear communication, and stakeholder management.
* Support Automation \& AI initiatives that drive efficiency, reduce manual effort, and improve decision\-making across operations.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Master's degree
* Experience in program requirements definition, together with data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 5\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL

data.jd_text:
**Life at Dubai Future Foundation** 




  





 Dubai Future Foundation (DFF) aims to realize the wise vision of Dubai’s leadership to institutionalize the envisioned future and forward\-thinking methodologies, while positioning Dubai as the leading city of the future. In partnership with its local and global partners from governments, companies, startups, and entrepreneurs, DFF drives joint efforts to collectively imagine, design, and execute the best possible future for humanity.
 



 Under the supervision of His Highness Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Crown Prince of Dubai, Chairman of the Executive Council of Dubai, and Chairman of the Board of Trustees of DFF, the DFF runs and oversees many futureproofing projects and initiatives, such as the Museum of the Future, Area 2071, The Centre for the Fourth Industrial Revolution UAE, Dubai Future Accelerators, One Million Arab Coders, Dubai Future Academy, Dubai Future Solutions, Dubai Future Labs, Dubai Future Forum, and Sandbox Dubai. DFF’s efforts to share knowledge, adopt innovation, support entrepreneurs and innovative startups, build capacity, and promote forward\-thinking and foresight principles contribute to Dubai’s ambitions to be a role model for the cities of the future through the power of unlimited imagination, innovation, foresight and disruptive mindset.
 



  





 For more information on the initiatives, projects, and programs of Dubai Future Foundation, please visit the website: www.dubaifuture.ae
 



  





**Where does this role fit into the bigger picture?** 




  





 Dubai Future Foundation recently launched Sandbox Dubai, a Regulatory Sandbox that centers around four key themes: Artificial Intelligence, Health Tech, Green technology, and Real Estate technology. We would like to invite talented and experienced individuals to join our dynamic team as we embark on this journey.
 



  





 As we embrace the challenges and opportunities of the modern regulatory landscape, we are seeking talented individuals who are eager to contribute their expertise and creativity to the Sandbox Dubai initiatives. We aim to explore novel solutions, foster collaboration across sectors, and pave the way for transformative changes that benefit both consumers and industries of Dubai.
 



  





 In the broader context of Sandbox Dubai, the Project Manager reports to the Head of Operations of Sandbox Dubai and will collaborate closely with the Sandbox team leads in Strategy, Policy, and Partnerships.
 



  





**Project Manager** 




  





 As a Project Manager within Sandbox Dubai, you will lead and manage sandbox programs and projects, including regulatory experiments, industry pilots, and innovation frameworks from concept to delivery or handover. You will manage multiple sandbox projects, deploy and enhance processes, coordinate cross\-functional teams, drive project timelines, engage diverse Future Foundation’s strategic goals.
 



  





**Project Management** 




  




* Full Project Lifecycle: Manage the full project cycle including managing projects timelines, budgets, milestones, setting objectives, monitoring and tracking progress, post project analysis and reporting.
* Project Development: Pitch sandbox projects with business cases, feasibility reports, and risk assessments tailored to sandbox\-specific initiatives.
* Sandbox Design \& Execution: Develop sandbox programs focused on regulatory experiments, technology validation, and proof\-of\-concept pilots across Sandbox priority areas (Artificial Intelligence, Health Tech, Green technology, and Real Estate technology).
* Global Tech Monitoring: Track international regulatory and innovation trends in key priority sectors to enhance the design of future sandbox initiatives and connect global themes/trends with opportunities for Dubai.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with legal, policy, strategy, and partnership teams to ensure project compliance and cross\-sector success.
* Documentation: Create and maintain project records, perform lessons\-learned assessments, and present reports to senior management.
* Team Collaboration: Communicate regularly with Sandbox team members and stakeholders to ensure projects run smoothly, providing updates to the Head of Operations and Director of Sandbox Dubai.
* Stakeholder Engagement and Third\-Party Relationships.
* Partner and collaborate with industry leaders, government agencies, startups, and regulatory bodies to align project goals. Ensure regular communication, and logistics are in place.
* Lead workshops, roundtables, and innovation sessions with relevant stakeholders to drive regulatory alignment and operational readiness.
* Collaborate with the Legal, Strategy, and Policy Teams to define regulatory exemptions, licensing terms, and compliance protocols.
* Work closely with finance, procurement and other internal teams to oversee procurement, invoices, and contracts ensuring legal compliance in all transactions.
* Support the development of policy proposals, regulatory models, and whitepapers in collaboration with Policy and Legal Teams.
* Ensure all projects comply with Sandbox governance frameworks, legal protocols, and international regulatory standards.
* Collaborate with the Marketing \& Communications Teams to enhance project visibility through media outreach and branding campaigns.



  





**Why this role is important?** 




  





 This role is central to translating Sandbox Dubai’s regulatory innovation goals into actionable Sandbox projects that drive policy reform, technology adoption and economic competitiveness. Moreover, this role is critical for providing operational management for core Sandbox projects throughout their lifecycle, fostering cross\-sector collaboration, and thus accelerating Dubai’s transformation into a global innovation hub.
 



  





**What Dubai Future Foundation offers?** 




  





 We will offer you a unique opportunity to work with passionate people, support shapers of the future as well as work that has an impact, not only on the organization or the UAE but all of humankind.
 



  





 You will have the chance to work on exciting and new projects, work in a highly diverse and fast paced environment that fosters creativity, disruptive ideas and innovation.

**Job Description**
 Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented
 **Project Controls Manager** 
 to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will lead and manage all project controls functions for a major railway project, including planning and scheduling, cost control, risk management, and performance reporting, ensuring alignment with project objectives, contractual requirements, and industry best practices. You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams and key stakeholders to drive schedule integrity, cost efficiency, and effective project governance across the project lifecycle.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Provide strategic leadership and oversight for project controls functions including planning, scheduling, cost management, progress tracking, risk mitigation, change control, and performance reporting across infrastructure programs.
* Provide guidance, direction, and specialized assistance to planning \& risk staff, interface with clients, and attend regular meetings.
* Develop, implement, and maintain project controls processes, procedures, systems, plans and tools and monitor compliance.
* Arrange project controls workshops/ meetings to discuss and assist contractors/consultants to close their project control issues.
* Develop a Master Schedule integrating multiple packages considering their interdependencies to identify and reflect the impact of one schedule/project on others.
* Review and convey PMC’s and Engineer’s consent to the Contractors’ Baseline schedule of works in line with Contract conditions, and using Parsons Recommended Practices.
* Validation of compatibility of project resources for timely completion of the project.
* Strong foreseeability to identify the potential risks/conflicts, and document them in the Project Risk Register.
* Evaluate \& verify the planning and scheduling information from the updated / progress schedules. Identify the potential areas of delay/slippage, highlight the critical events \& suggest mitigation measures / corrective actions / robust recovery plan.
* Exercise “What if” analysis to assess the time impact of each change, variation, and potential event at an early stage and provide alternative courses of action \& advice before issuing instructions to contractors.
* Prepare regular progress reports / monthly reports with program analysis and recommendations, addressing program issues to ensure timely project completion, and preparing presentations regarding the work's progress concerning interim and major milestones.
* Evaluate claims including Extension of Time (EoT) and Disruption claims using recognized delay analysis techniques such as Time Impact Analysis and Window Analysis, with the ability to assess concurrent delays.
* Discuss, coordinate, and resolve the planning and scheduling problems with the PMC, the Contractor and the Employer.
* Coordination with the Client to finalize the contractor’s programs, reports, and claims.
* Actively participate in project meetings (e.g., kickoff, technical, coordination, progress reviews) and prepare concise, actionable minutes of meeting (MoM).
* Preparation of Trackers / Logs to monitor critical issues during the Design and Construction stages of the Project.
* Agree on the progress measurement system (PMS) and key indicators with the consultants/contractors during the project for monitoring purposes.
* Ability to communicate clearly conduct presentations to management and interface effectively with a diverse group of professionals. Provide reasoned \& analytic response to the contractor notices and detailed particulars using programming data, sound construction practices, and contractual provisions.
* Maintain organized contemporary records to support claims analysis and contract administration processes.
* Issue formal delay notices and performance alerts when contractor progress is deficient or non\-compliant with schedule obligations
* Be able to manage a team of one or more planning engineers, providing them with technical and leadership skills.
* Lead structured risk workshops with both client and contractor teams to identify and manage project risks and opportunities.
* Champion the adoption of automation and digitalization within the project controls function to improve reporting accuracy and reduce manual workloads.


**What Required Skills You'll Bring**
* Bachelor's degree in civil engineering or construction management from a recognized institution.
* Minimum 15\+ years of experience in project controls, preferably on large\-scale construction or infrastructure projects, including prior experience on metro rail projects, with at least 3 years of experience in the UAE.
* Proficiency in Primavera P6, Primavera Risk Analysis, other Risk software and Power BI.


**What Desired Skills You'll Bring**
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Thorough knowledge of industry best practices and regulations.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.

data.jd_text:
A high\-growth, regulated fintech platform is hiring a senior delivery leader to take ownership of complex, multi\-team technical programmes that sit right at the core of the business. This is not a “project admin” role. It’s a senior, high\-trust position for someone who can bring structure to ambiguity, align strong engineering personalities, and turn platform strategy into predictable, high\-quality delivery at scale.
 



  





 You’ll operate as the connective layer between Engineering, Product, Architecture, QA/DevOps and executive stakeholders owning cross\-squad dependencies, release governance, delivery confidence, and the narrative that keeps leadership informed without noise.
 



  





 You’ll lead end\-to\-end delivery across 8–12\+ engineering squads, driving clarity across interdependencies and ensuring programmes land safely in production. That means building and maintaining dependency maps, risk registers and escalation paths, running multi\-quarter planning, and stepping in early when blockers appear not after delivery slips.
 



  





 You’ll also own release governance for large\-scale programmes. You’ll define the checkpoints, enforce production readiness standards, run go/no\-go decisions with clear criteria, and coordinate parallel workstreams across QA, Platform and DevOps so releases are controlled, auditable, and repeatable.
 



  





 This role requires a leader who can sit comfortably in technical detail when needed (API contracts, integration milestones, platform dependencies) and then translate that complexity into simple, business\-relevant updates for senior stakeholders. You’ll produce data\-driven status reporting, delivery forecasts, risk dashboards and trade\-off options with the confidence to escalate early and recommend the right path under constraint.
 



  





 Tooling and delivery intelligence are a major part of the remit. You’ll own programme\-level Jira structures (epic hierarchies, cross\-project boards, dependency linking and automation) and build executive dashboards that surface programme health using meaningful metrics like cycle time, lead time, flow efficiency, and dependency resolution SLAs. In a regulated environment, your delivery approach and tooling discipline will also support audit readiness and compliance expectations.
 



  





 We’re looking for someone with 10\+ years’ experience in Technical Delivery, Programme Management, or Engineering Leadership, with a proven track record delivering complex, multi\-team programmes in high\-stakes and/or regulated environments. You should be comfortable operating across large engineering organisations (8\+ teams), confident in driving dependency resolution, and credible with engineers, architects and platform teams when technical trade\-offs need to be challenged or clarified.
 



 You’ll likely have strong experience with Agile\-at\-scale and hybrid delivery models, advanced Jira administration and workflow design, and a history of improving delivery predictability through governance, metrics and execution discipline. Fintech, trading platforms, or similarly regulated product environments are strongly preferred.
 



  





 You’ll be stepping into a high\-impact seat with real scale: multiple squads, platform\-level dependencies, and programmes that run for months rather than weeks. You’ll have the mandate to improve delivery governance, standardise release practices, and build the reporting and operating rhythm that leadership trusts.
 



 Interested?
 



  





 If you want a confidential conversation, send your CV along with a short note on the largest multi\-team technical programme you’ve led (scope, number of teams, duration, and what you changed to improve delivery). Full details will be shared with shortlisted candidates only.

 The Lead – Business Operations, Global Oncology will play a critical role in driving launch excellence and early access strategies across small to mid\-sized markets where Glenmark Oncology does not have dedicated in\-country oncology leadership.

* Drive early access strategies including:
* Named Patient Programs (NPPs)
* Compassionate use programs
* Managed access agreements
* Collaborate with Medical, Market Access, Regulatory, and Supply teams to ensure timely market entry.
* Develop launch readiness frameworks, KPIs, and tracking mechanisms.
* Market Development (Non\-Core / White Space Markets)
* Identify, prioritize, and assess new market opportunities where Glenmark lacks oncology presence.

* Drive data\-driven decision\-making through analytics and insights generation.

* Sales force effectiveness (where applicable)
* Omnichannel engagement frameworks
* Digital enablement tools
* Organizational Readiness \& Capability Building
* Partner with the Head of Global Commercial Oncology to ensure readiness for upcoming launches.
* Define target operating models for new markets.
* Support hiring strategy, role design, and capability frameworks (especially for distributor markets).
* Develop training frameworks and onboarding programs for new teams/partners.
* Resource Allocation \& Financial Planning
* Lead commercial budgeting and resource allocation across emerging markets.
* Optimize deployment of financial and human resources based on market potential and strategic priority.
* Track ROI on launch investments and commercial initiatives.
* Support long\-range planning (LRP) and annual operating plans (AOP).
* Strategic Planning \& Governance
* Act as a strategic advisor and deputy to the Head of Global Commercial Oncology.
* Support development of global oncology commercial strategy.
* Lead cross\-functional governance forums and business reviews.
* Drive alignment across global, regional, and local stakeholders.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership
* Serve as a central coordination point across: Medical Affairs, Market Access, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Finance

* Monitor competitive landscape across oncology markets.

* Successful launch of oncology assets in priority emerging markets.

* Budget adherence and ROI optimization.
* Distributor performance and market expansion outcomes.

* Strong understanding of oncology market access and early access pathways.

We are seeking an experienced Insurance Project Lead to drive the delivery of a series of large, strategic transformation initiatives across the organization. This role combines strong program governance and execution expertise with strategic portfolio oversight to manage a complex pipeline of initiatives, drive enterprise\-wide prioritization, and ensure the realization of measurable business value.
 



  





 The successful candidate will operate across all three business lines—Personal, Commercial, and Medical—partnering closely with senior leaders and key stakeholders to manage demand intake, shape and scope initiatives, and deliver complex programs end\-to\-end within a structured Transformation Framework. The role is accountable for aligning initiatives to strategic objectives, managing interdependencies, mitigating risk, and ensuring clear benefits realization.
 



 This position reports directly to the Country Head of Transformation
 



  





**Key Role ResponsibilitiesProgram Delivery \& Governance** 



* Accountable for the end\-to\-end delivery of a portfolio of large, strategic transformation projects, ensuring alignment to enterprise objectives and measurable business outcomes.
* Establish and maintain robust program governance structures, ensuring clear decision\-making, oversight, and alignment across business units and executive stakeholders.
* Drive integrated program planning, proactively managing interdependencies, critical paths, resource capacity, and sequencing across multiple concurrent projects.
* Accountable to ensure each program is aligned to the Liva Transformation Framework and adopt and report in line with the program delivery framework.
* Provide consolidated program reporting, including dashboards, KPIs, financial tracking, risks, issues, and benefits realization updates to Senior Leadership and the Country Head of Transformation.
* Ensure effective scope, schedule, cost, and quality control across all projects within the program, applying strong delivery discipline and risk management practices.
* Oversee the development and approval of business cases, including clear articulation of strategic rationale, benefits, investment requirements, and return on investment.
* Ensure all initiatives are delivered in accordance with the Transformation Framework, maintaining consistency in standards, controls, and governance.
* Partner with senior business stakeholders to define program scope, shape solutions, and ensure requirements are clearly documented and aligned to intended outcomes.
* Oversee testing, implementation, and business readiness activities across the program to ensure smooth deployment, stakeholder adoption, and realization of defined benefits.



  





**Knowledge/ Skills/ Competencies Required** 



* Minimum 2\-4 years experience in the Insurance sector.
* Proven experience as a Project Lead, leading portfolios of interrelated projects within regulated insurance environments across Personal, Commercial, and Medical insurance lines.
* Professionally certified in program and/or project management (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, Six Sigma or equivalent).
* Strong industry knowledge of underwriting, policy administration, claims, pricing, regulatory compliance, and the end\-to\-end insurance lifecycle, with particular expertise in medical/health insurance frameworks.
* Demonstrated success delivering large\-scale enterprise transformation and change programs, including core system modernisation, regulatory initiatives, and operating model redesign.
* Expertise in managing complex program backlogs and multiple concurrent initiatives, ensuring strategic alignment, prioritisation discipline, and effective risk and dependency management.
* Advanced capability in business case development, cost\-benefit analysis, and structured benefits realisation across program lifecycles.
* Strong executive stakeholder engagement and governance leadership, overseeing requirements (BRDs), testing/UAT coordination, release control, and establishing scalable delivery frameworks in complex environments.

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose** 




 Lead research governance, partnerships, programs, and IP enablement; steer R\&D centers, awards, and proof\-of\-concepts; and deliver high\-quality studies and outcomes aligned with RTA strategy and future directions.
 



  





**Roles and Responsibilities** 




**Strategy** 




 Develop and update Authority research and studies policies, processes, systems, annual plans and KPIs, aligning them with RTA strategy and standards.
 



 Promote a research culture and define publishing frameworks, authorship rules, and review cycles for Authority research outputs.
 



 Establish governance for R\&D centers, aligning portfolios, KPIs, and annual plans with future directions and sector needs.
 



 Define proof\-of\-concept governance with selection criteria, test protocols, evaluation gates, and reporting cadence.
 



 Direct the RTA Scientific Research Award framework, rubrics, calendar, and improvement actions to raise submission quality.
 



 Plan strategic research partnerships with universities and centers, defining scopes, benefits, IP clauses, and performance indicators.
 



**Operations** 




 Supervise corporate research projects from concept to delivery, meeting scope, schedule, budget, and quality gates.
 



 Coordinate research initiatives with Dubai Future Foundation and integrate deliverables into departmental plans.
 



 Govern the central database for research outputs; enforce data standards, metadata, access controls, and publication workflows.
 



 Prepare policy/strategy documentation, leadership presentations, and periodic reports on research indicators, initiatives, risks, and corrective actions.
 



 Scout internal researchers, deliver awareness programs, and mentor early\-career researchers to strengthen the pipeline.
 



 Provide linkages to legal and IP experts; guide researchers to register and protect IP per approved procedures.
 



 Draft and review MoUs and collaboration agreements; monitor partner obligations, deliverables, and realized benefits.
 



**Product/Process Improvement** 




 Review research and PoC outcomes; mandate adoption, iteration, or closure; capture lessons and reusable methods.
 



 Review and develop R\&D sources, frameworks, and tools; enhance researcher toolkits, templates, and guidance to improve collaboration and study quality.
 



 Analyze performance trends; recommend corrective actions; and update research policies, processes, frameworks and KPIs.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s/ Master’s degree in Engineering/Science
* 9\+ years in case of Master’s degree(11\+ years in case of Bachelor’s degree)
* Expertise in R\&D project design/execution, academic partnerships, and research governance
* Certifications such as PMP/PRINCE2 (or equivalent), research ethics(e.g., CITI)

data.jd_text:
**INSPIRE \| EXHILARATE \| DELIGHT**
 For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.
   

  

 Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.
   

  

 Chalhoub Group fosters a people\-at\-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future\-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM. Their collective efforts have earned the Group the Great Place to Work® certification in several markets.
   

  

 Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040\.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 The Transformation Program Governance Director provides strategic oversight and leadership across the Group’s multi\-year digital transformation program. This role ensures disciplined execution, strategic alignment, and value realization across all streams, while acting as the guardian of program governance, standards, and vendor accountability. Operating at Group level, this leader drives cross\-entity alignment, embeds best\-in\-class governance frameworks, and establishes the program as a benchmark for disciplined transformation delivery.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Lead executive governance for the entire digital transformation program, strategically allocating resources, budgets, and priorities to maximize business impact.
* Safeguard program outcomes by overseeing benefit realization and hold workstreams accountable for delivering measurable value and results.
* Support and challenge program leaders to ensure delivery excellence, proactively managing risks, dependencies, and barriers.
* Provide senior leadership with data\-driven insights, independent assurance, and strategic recommendations to guide decision\-making.
* Define, document and continuously evolve Group\-wide governance frameworks, standards, and policies to ensure consistent and mature program delivery.
* Establish and maintain a Transformation Governance Center of Excellence (CoE) offering tools, methodologies, and training for standardized delivery.
* Uphold governance rigor by designing and maintaining clear decision\-making structures, reporting mechanisms, and escalation protocols that ensure transparency and accountability at all levels.
* Act as a senior escalation point and manage strategic vendor relationships, ensuring partners meet contractual commitments, quality standards, and timely delivery.
* Shape vendor engagement models and collaborate with Procurement, Legal, and Finance to optimize commercial terms, risk management and cost control across all vendor engagements.
* Ensure alignment across Group entities and business units, so that transformation initiatives are integrated seamlessly into the operating model and enable scalable adoption.
* Drive transparent, timely reporting and foster collaboration across geographies and functions to maintain senior stakeholder engagement and informed executive committees and SteerCos, enabling informed decision\-making and program steering.


**What You’ll Need To Succeed**
* Proven experience in leading governance and execution for large\-scale, multi\-year digital transformation programs, ideally in a multi\-entity or international group context.
* Deep expertise in governance design, operating models, and transformation frameworks, with a track record of institutionalizing standards at Group level.
* Strong leadership and influencing skills, with the ability to engage at C\-suite and Board level.
* Demonstrated success in vendor and partner governance, including complex system integrator or technology engagements.
* Strategic thinker with operational discipline, able to balance control, flexibility, and delivery speed.
* Excellent communication, diplomacy, and stakeholder management skills across diverse cultures and functions.


**What We Can Offer You**
 With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.
   

  

 We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts.
   

  

**Using GenAI in Your Application Process**
 To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations.
   

  

**We Invite All Applicants to Apply**
 It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity.
   

  

 We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.
