data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 We are seeking an accomplished Director – Major Projects \& Infrastructure to lead the strategic planning and delivery of major transport and infrastructure design programmes across the Middle East. This senior leadership role is responsible for portfolio performance, client engagement, operational oversight, and technical governance across complex multi\-disciplinary projects, ensuring high\-quality delivery, strong commercial outcomes, and trusted relationships with key government and private\-sector stakeholders.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will bring proven experience leading large\-scale highways, transport, and integrated infrastructure programmes, with the credibility to operate at executive level across clients, authorities, delivery teams, and business leadership.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Leadership \& Strategy**
* Provide strategic leadership for a portfolio of major transport and infrastructure programmes, aligning delivery priorities with business objectives, client needs, and regional market opportunities.
* Shape market positioning and support business growth through key account development, pursuit strategy, proposal leadership, and executive\-level client engagement.
* Establish clear governance, decision\-making frameworks, and performance expectations across programmes to support consistent, high\-quality delivery.
* Represent the business externally with clients, partners, and industry stakeholders, strengthening market profile and helping secure future opportunities.
* Work closely with peers and the broader leadership team in an effective and collaborative manner.


**Project \& Programme Management**
* Lead the delivery of major transport and infrastructure projects from concept through detailed design and construction support, ensuring programmes are structured, resourced, and governed effectively.
* Own programme performance against schedule, budget, margin, cash flow, and quality targets, with clear accountability for forecasting, financial control, and overall portfolio health.
* Drive programme controls including risk management, change control, reporting, KPI monitoring, schedule assurance, and recovery planning across multi\-package and multi\-stakeholder environments.
* Oversee resource planning and coordination across multi\-disciplinary teams to maintain delivery efficiency and effective interface management.


**Client \& Stakeholder Engagement**
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with key clients, government authorities, and strategic partners across the region, including ministries, commissions, municipalities, and major development entities.
* Act as the senior client interface for major programmes, leading executive discussions, resolving complex issues, and maintaining confidence in delivery performance and commercial outcomes.
* Oversee stakeholder coordination and authority engagement, including support for approvals, permitting, and resolution of issues affecting programme progress.


**Technical Excellence**
* Provide technical leadership across engineering solutions, mobility strategies, and design methodologies, ensuring that projects are innovative, practical, and aligned with client objectives.
* Ensure robust technical assurance and compliance with international standards, local authority requirements, design safety obligations, and organisational quality systems.
* Champion digital engineering, BIM, model\-based delivery, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance quality, efficiency, and consistency across programmes.


**Team Leadership \& Development**
* Lead, mentor, and inspire high\-performing multi\-disciplinary teams, setting clear expectations for delivery, collaboration, and professional standards.
* Build organisational capability through effective resource planning, performance management, knowledge sharing, and development of specialist and leadership talent.
* Support recruitment, succession planning, and retention strategies to strengthen long\-term capability across the transport and infrastructure business.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Transportation Engineering, or a related discipline; Master’s degree preferred.
* 20\+ years of experience delivering major transport and infrastructure projects, with at least 10 years in the Middle East.
* Proven leadership experience on mega‑projects such as highways programmes, mobility corridors, rail/metro interfaces, smart mobility projects, and integrated infrastructure developments.
* Strong background in multi‑disciplinary design management, including roads, highways, bridges and utilities.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large consultant and contractor teams within complex programme environments, with strong capability in resource planning, delivery oversight, and interface management.
* Excellent knowledge of international and regional codes, design standards, and approval processes.
* Sound understanding of design safety, HSE leadership, regulatory compliance, and authority approvals processes across major infrastructure programmes.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and client‑facing skills with experience engaging with ministries and major authorities.
* Strong commercial and contractual acumen, including experience with bid leadership, consultancy frameworks, contract strategy, procurement interfaces, change management, and programme financial performance.
* Experience managing programme performance through governance, reporting, KPIs, and executive\-level decision\-making in high\-profile delivery environments.
* Experience working with large engineering consultancies on high\-profile regional projects.
* Chartered/Professional Engineer status (CEng, PE, PEng, etc.) is highly desirable.


**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
 Join our close\-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.
   

  

**With us, you can. Apply today.**

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 This role is for someone who wants real ownership.
   

  

 You’ll be the right hand to the Network Health and Trust \& Safety leadership, owning complex, high\-impact programs that protect customers, partners, and the business. This is not a reporting or coordination role. You will identify risks before they escalate, turn ambiguity into clear execution plans, and drive programs that balance safety, compliance, and operational reality.
   

  

 You’ll work across teams that don’t naturally align, often without direct authority. Your job is to connect the dots, make hard calls, and ensure the right things get done on time, at scale, and with measurable impact.
   

  

 If you enjoy solving messy problems, influencing senior stakeholders, and building mechanisms that last, this role will stretch you in the best way.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end Trust \& Safety and Network Health programs from problem definition to execution and sustained outcomes
* Identify systemic risks and compliance gaps; design scalable solutions rather than one\-off fixes
* Drive execution across multiple teams with competing priorities
* Set clear goals, milestones, and success metrics for complex initiatives
* Act as a thought partner to senior leadership on risk, safety, and long\-term strategy
* Build simple, durable mechanisms to track progress and enforce standards
* Raise the bar on how programs are designed, reviewed, and communicated


 A day in the life
   

  

**On a Typical Day, You Might**
* Deep dive into data to understand where risks are emerging and why
* Align with product, operations, legal, and analytics partners on priorities and trade\-offs
* Challenge unclear plans and push for sharper problem statements and success metrics
* Review program progress, unblock teams, and escalate when needed
* Translate complex issues into clear updates for senior stakeholders
* Improve existing processes so teams spend less time reacting and more time preventing issues


 Your internal stakeholders include operations leaders, product teams, analytics partners, and legal or policy counterparts.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Network Health (NH) and Trust \& Safety (T\&S) teams work together to protect Amazon’s Last Mile operations by driving compliance, partner accountability, and safety across the AMET region (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and Turkey).
   

  

 Network Health owns the end\-to\-end compliance and enforcement lifecycle for Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) — from risk identification and MEP (Monitoring \& Enforcement Plan) management to exit governance and performance reviews. The team ensures that all DSPs operate safely, ethically, and in alignment with Amazon’s Supply Chain Standards and local labor regulations.
   

  

 Trust \& Safety complements this work by focusing on driver\-level safety, identity verification, and incident resolution programs such as ID Check, APEA, and DAF, ensuring that both DSPs and drivers uphold Amazon’s zero\-tolerance standards on compliance and worker welfare.
   

  

 This role operates at the intersection of both functions, helping deliver secure, compliant, and sustainable operations in one of Amazon’s fastest\-growing regions.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables \& charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

***Design your dreams with Dior.***
 The Regional Senior Store Planning Manager supports the development and delivery of Dior Parfums retail projects across different store formats and levels of complexity. This role combines strategic project management capabilities with strong architectural and technical design expertise.
   

  

 For
 **flagship projects** 
 , the role acts as a
 **Project Manager**

 \- 建立基础设施安全体系（权限管理、访问控制、漏洞管理、DDoS防护）
 



 \- 配合安全团队构建交易安全与资金安全防护体系
 



 \- 支撑风控系统稳定运行（异常交易监控、风险引擎稳定性保障）
 



 6\. 重大故障与应急管理
 



 \- 负责重大线上事故的应急响应、根因分析（RCA）及复盘机制
 



 \- 建立事故分级响应机制（P0/P1/P2）及演练体系
 



 \- 提升整体MTTR（平均恢复时间）与系统可用性指标
 



 7\. 团队管理与组织建设
 



 \- 管理SRE/系统/网络/安全/DBA等运维团队
 



 \- 建立技术梯队与绩效体系，提升团队工程能力
 



 \- 支撑公司全球化业务扩展与组织规模增长

 \- 与研发、产品、交易系统、风控、安全等团队紧密协作

 \- 参与关键技术架构评审与系统设计决策

 \- 有交易所 / 数字货币 / 金融交易系统 / 高并发系统经验优先
 



 2\. 核心技术能力
 



 \- 熟悉Linux系统、网络架构（TCP/IP、BGP、CDN等）
 



 \- 熟悉分布式系统架构、微服务架构及中间件（Kafka/Redis/MySQL等）
 



 \- 熟悉云平台（AWS/GCP/AliCloud）及Kubernetes容器化体系

 \- 能适应全球化业务节奏与时区协作

data.raw_snippet: Dubai serves as a strategic hub for Eaton’s Middle East operations, bringing together commercial, engineering, manufacturing, and support teams within a globally connected business environment. Building on more than 40 years in the region, Eaton recently announced the development of a new sustainabl
data.jd_text:
Dubai serves as a strategic hub for Eaton’s Middle East operations, bringing together commercial, engineering, manufacturing, and support teams within a globally connected business environment. Building on more than 40 years in the region, Eaton recently announced the development of a new sustainable campus in Dubai, reinforcing our long‑term investment in growth, collaboration, and capability building.
   

  

 Eaton's Global Data Center Segment is focused on helping data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future. With the rise of big data, edge computing and the cloud, data centers are under pressure to be more high\-performing, sustainable and cost\-effective than ever, without compromising resilience or security. At the same time, new opportunities and revenue streams require faster speed\-to\-market. With our digital intelligence, world\-class cyber\-secure products and services, reliable, compatible solutions and engineering expertise, we help data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future.
   

  

 Within this segment, Eaton has an opening for a
 **Technical Program Manager/Scrum Master – Global Data Center Segment.** 
 The primary function of this role is to act as an experienced servant leader and Agile coach for cross functional Datacenter teams within Eaton’s Global Data Center Segment team that is based in UAE. This role enables teams delivering Data Center solutions to operate effectively using Scrum, accelerating value delivery while maintaining Eaton’s high standards for safety, quality, compliance, and reliability. Operating in a global, matrixed environment, the Scrum Master partners closely with Research and Development, Product Owners, engineering, compliance, and business stakeholders to remove impediments, reinforce Agile discipline, and support Eaton’s broader Data Center growth strategy.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Scrum \& Agile Facilitation
   

  

* Serve as Scrum Master for one or more Data Center Teams, or solution teams, ensuring consistent application of Scrum events, roles, and artifacts in alignment with Eaton’s Scrum framework.
* Facilitate Sprint Planning, Daily Scrums, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives, fostering transparency, focus, and continuous improvement.
* Coach teams on Agile principles, self management, and cross functional collaboration.


 Impediment Removal \& Flow Optimization
   

  

* Proactively identify and remove delivery impediments, including dependencies across engineering, testing, UL compliance, manufacturing, and supply chain partners.
* Partner with leaders and stakeholders to escalate and resolve systemic issues impacting team flow and predictability.


 Product \& Stakeholder Partnership
   

  

* Support Product Owners in backlog refinement, prioritization, and alignment to Global Data Center Segment objectives, including safety, scalability, and reliability expectations.
* Act as a bridge between technical teams and global stakeholders, enabling clear communication and shared understanding of delivery commitments.


 Metrics \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Promote the use of Agile metrics (e.g., throughput, predictability, sprint goals) to enable data driven improvement without fostering a command and control culture.
* Reinforce Kaizen and continuous improvement practices aligned with Eaton’s Continuous Improvement System.


 Scaling \& Enterprise Agility
   

  

* Support coordination across multiple teams or workstreams contributing to Gray Space UL deliverables.
* Contribute to broader Agile maturity and ways of working improvements across the Global Data Center organization, consistent with Eaton’s global operating model


**Qualifications**
* Strong working knowledge of Scrum and Agile principles, with demonstrated ability to apply them pragmatically in enterprise settings.
* Experience working with the data center or IT industry at senior levels.
* Experience working with cross functional global teams, including engineering, compliance, and operations.
* Proven ability to influence without authority in a matrixed organization.
* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline from an accredited institution.


**Skills**
* Scrum Master certification (CSM, PSM, SAFe SM, or equivalent) preferred.
* Experience supporting data centers, power systems, electrical infrastructure, or regulated product development preferred.
* Familiarity with UL certification processes or safety‑critical product development.
* Experience operating within large, global enterprises.


**What We Offer You**
* Being part of a company that has been in business for more than 100 years, is well known in the industry, and has a major impact on the energy industry
* Annual mentoring program, Eaton University, a reward, and recognition system
* Ongoing Learning and Career Development Opportunities in a global company. Build your career and apply internally for our open positions worldwide
* Strong, agile and diverse team locally and globally
* Strong processes and state\-of\-the\-art systems and tools
* Detailed induction support and well\-structured onboarding
* Balance your work and life with a hybrid worktime model


 Dubai is an internationally connected city that offers strong professional opportunities within a truly global environment. Living and working in Dubai means being part of a diverse, forward‑looking business community, supported by modern infrastructure, excellent connectivity, and a well‑established expatriate ecosystem.
   

  

 At Eaton, employees based in Dubai are part of a stable, well‑governed organization that brings together global teams, clear ways of working, and the flexibility needed to support both performance and long‑term career development.
   

  

*Ready to make a difference? Join Eaton’s Dubai Team and be part of a company shaping the future of sustainable manufacturing and power management!*
**Living and Working in Dubai**
*Dubai is a vibrant, cosmopolitan city known for its modern architecture, luxurious lifestyle, and rich cultural heritage. Living and working in Dubai offers an exceptional quality of life with world\-class amenities, a safe environment, and a thriving expatriate community. Experience a dynamic blend of work and leisure in one of the world’s most exciting cities.
   

  

 Ready to make a difference? Join Eaton’s Dubai Team and be part of a company shaping the future of sustainable manufacturing and power management!*

 Th
data.jd_text:
Ever since it was founded in 1931 in Montreux, Switzerland, Clinique La Prairie has built an international reputation as an award\-winning destination, renowned for delivering the most progressive health and wellbeing programs in an ambience of unparalleled luxury Swiss hospitality.
 



  





 The Longevity Hub by Clinique La Prairie offers a first access to the Clinique La Prairie method in selected urban locations, combining pioneering longevity, wellbeing and aesthetic technologies in an exclusive environment. Here, beauty is understood not as a surface correction but as the visible expression of a healthier biology, the most immediate manifestation of CLP’s commitment to extending the quality, resilience and vitality of human life. Our guests engage regularly with experts to build hyper\-personalized routines that unlock longevity and lasting wellbeing.
 



  





  





**THE ROLE** 




  





 As Medical Director, you are a key ambassador of the Longevity Hub by Clinique La Prairie, delivering the most advanced longevity solutions within a luxury environment. This is a dual role: you lead the Hub’s medical operations and you practise medicine every day, seeing guests in consultation as a physician. Our commitment is to help and inspire our guests to live a healthier, longer and fuller life — guided by the principle that the earlier the intervention, the more elegant the outcome, and that preservation is always more powerful than rescue. (Note: Maintain relationships with local medical authorities and serve as the designated medical authority within the Hub, in accordance with the responsibilities and duties of a Medical Director as defined by local regulatory requirements.)
 



  





 You create and maintain a culture of care and service excellence, lead the efficient and effective delivery of all medical operations, including short and long\-term strategic planning — and embody the CLP philosophy of biological authenticity: interventions that work with the guest’s biology, never against it, so that results look natural, durable and entirely faithful to the person.
 



 The position calls for a rare balance of six profiles:
 


* **Practising Physician**
* **Scientist**
* **Operator**
* **Team Leader**
* **Brand Ambassador**
* **Guest Experience Leader**



  





**KEY DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Medical practice** 



* Practise medicine daily — consult with guests, understand their concerns and goals, diagnose, analyze check\-up results and ensure a global, longitudinal management of their health all across the 4 pillars of the CLP Longevity Method (Medical, Nutrition, Wellbeing and Movement)
* Establish and maintain medical protocols, and fully understand the internal processes of all departments.
* Deliver care across the three dimensions of the CLP method — prevention, which protects biological function before visible decline; maintenance, which sustains results through longitudinal follow\-up; and amplification, which actively improves quality through targeted intervention.
* Prescribe or administer medication, therapy and other specialized medical care, selecting interventions that work with the guest’s anatomy and biology
* Supervise the execution of the consultations, tests and treatments included in the membership; explain procedures and discuss results and prescribed treatments with guests.
* Provide health and wellness advice — diet, physical activity, hygiene and disease prevention and support guests on long\-term, regenerative and preventive treatment plans.
* Master the key applications of new anti\-aging and regenerative technologies — ozone therapy, IV drips, toxicity evaluation testing and detoxification plans.
* Maintain detailed, up\-to\-date medical records and prepare official health documents when required.
* Participate in the recruitment of new physicians and medical team members.
* Organize weekly meetings with the medical team and report monthly to the Global Medical Director.



  





**Operational practice** 



* Manage the establishment and continuous monitoring of the medical licence, maintaining the relationship with local medical authority, monitoring the regulatory landscape.
* Implement the compliance procedures requested by corporate.
* Establish Local Operating Procedures (LOP) and keep the KMS updated for all local procedures and compliance documents.
* Monitor procedure execution against corporate quality standards, gather improvement points and address the learning curve with the Hub pillar teams.
* Secure the application of infection control and medical\-waste management while monitoring nursing activity, and oversee the stock of medical consumables and the procurement process.
* Ensure the continuous update of the Client Health Record and related incident reporting, liaising with local authorities where needed, and manage record exchange with the Montreux Health Resort under the Data Transfer Agreement.
* Oversee the guest journey — from appointments through to the follow\-up plan foreseen by the membership program.
* Implement and monitor external providers that enhance Hub treatments (laboratory tests, cognitive exercises and others).
* Oversee the maintenance plans of longevity equipment and coordinate support interventions as defined by supplier contracts.
* Report daily to the Hub General Manager, and monthly to the Corporate Medical Director and the Corporate Medical \& Longevity Operational Excellence Director.



  





**SKILLS, EXPERIENCE \& REQUIREMENTS** 



* Doctor of Medicine (MD), licence eligible to practise in the UAE (DHA / DoH). A specialty in Internal Medicine, Functional Medicine or Aesthetic Surgery is a plus.
* Internal Medicine Certification or recognition from a leading university (QS World University medicine rankings), ideally complemented by certification in anti\-aging and regenerative medicine.
* At least 5 years of clinical experience in the chosen specialty, with a genuine passion for both people and science and a real interest in longevity and preventive medicine.
* A practising clinician, comfortable seeing guests every day and combining hands\-on medical practice with the leadership of a medical team; able to prescribe and administer medications and other non\-surgical treatments.
* Knowledge of skin and facial aging as a multi\-tissue, multi\-level process, and of regenerative, aesthetic and lifestyle interventions that amplify healthspan rather than merely correcting appearance.
* Wide knowledge of aging research — biomarkers of aging, biological\-age testing, and longevity therapies addressing senescence\-driven decline; scientific publications and society memberships are an advantage.
* Strong ability to lead a multicultural team, with a confident presence, a self\-driven attitude and a positive mindset.
* Able to travel to Switzerland and other CLP locations for training, and to complete CLP’s onboarding and refresher programs.



  





**THE IDEAL PROFILE** 




  





 The ideal Medical Director combines strong clinical credentials in their specialty — Internal Medicine, General Practice, Aesthetic Medicine or Aesthetic Surgery — with deep longevity expertise, operational leadership and a luxury hospitality mindset.

data.jd_text:
**About Moove**
 Moove is a global mobility fintech and operations company focused on transforming mobility through innovative fleet solutions, mobility, and next\-generation transportation technologies. As we expand our operations across the UAE and GCC region, we are looking for an experienced and highly driven Project Manager to support the launch and scaling of new mobility and automotive projects.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This role leads the planning, coordination, and execution of new mobility and automotive projects across the UAE. Working closely with internal teams, OEM partners, technology providers, and strategic stakeholders, the Program Manager drives initiatives from concept through commercial launch ensuring Moove’s expansion is delivered on time, at scale, and to the highest operational standard.
   

  

 The role requires strong project management expertise, stakeholder coordination, and a working understanding of the mobility ecosystem. The ideal candidate has 5–7 years of experience in project or program management, with a track record of delivering complex, cross\-functional initiatives in mobility, fleet, logistics, or adjacent sectors.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 The role exists to own end\-to\-end delivery of mobility projects across the UAE from initial scoping through pilot and into commercial launch. Success is measured by projects delivered on time, within budget, and at the quality standard required for Moove to scale its regional operations.
   

  

 Within the first 6 months, the role is expected to own at least one active project end\-to\-end, establish clear project governance and reporting cadence for the leadership team, and build the operational frameworks that enable future market launches to be faster and more repeatable.
   

  

 Core Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end project management for mobility and automotive projects across the UAE.
* Develop detailed project plans, timelines, budgets, and execution frameworks for new market launches.
* Manage cross\-functional teams across Operations, Engineering, Compliance, Fleet, Safety, and Technology.
* Drive project execution from pilot phase through commercial launch, owning delivery outcomes end\-to\-end.
* Monitor project risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans; escalate issues proactively to senior leadership.
* Lead vendor management, OEM partner onboarding, and operational integration activities across GCC markets.
* Ensure compliance with transportation, safety, and operational standards.
* Prepare executive dashboards, management reports, operational updates, and board presentations.
* Build scalable operational processes and frameworks to enable faster and more repeatable expansion.
* Perform operational analysis, reporting, forecasting, and data tracking using advanced Excel and BI tools.


**What You Will Need For This Position**
* Experience: 5–7 years in project or program management within mobility, transportation, fleet operations, logistics, or technology; proven track record of delivering cross\-functional projects end\-to\-end in a fast\-paced environment.
* Education / Skills: Bachelor’s in Engineering, Business, Transportation, or Technology; PMP or equivalent preferred; advanced Excel and BI tools proficiency required.
* Traits: Exceptional stakeholder management, highly analytical, comfortable with ambiguity, GCC market\-savvy, strong communicator, and able to lead without authority across complex cross\-functional teams.


**Key Metrics**
* On\-time, on\-budget delivery of mobility projects across UAE.
* Quality and accuracy of executive dashboards, project reporting, and operational updates.
* Stakeholder satisfaction across internal functions and external OEM and technology partners.
* Speed and repeatability of new market launches enabled by scalable operational frameworks.
* Compliance and risk management across all active projects and UAE market operations.


**Who You'll Be Working with:**
 Directly reporting to our Managing Director, and closely working with our UAE Operations Team.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our team is collaborative, positive, curious, and engaged. We think fast, work smart, laugh often, and are looking for like\-minded people to join us in our mission to disrupt vehicle ownership and make financial freedom within reach.
   

  

 Moove is strongly committed to diversity within its community. The Company’s approved Employment Equity Plan and Targets will be considered as part of the recruitment process. As an Equal Opportunities employer, we welcome people from all backgrounds who seek the opportunity to help build a future where everyone and everything can move independently.
   

  

**Pre\-hiring Notice:** 
 Moove relies on the accuracy of information contained in employment applications, as well as the accuracy of other data presented throughout the hiring process and during employment. Any misrepresentations, falsifications, or material omissions in any information or data provided by an applicant may result in the applicant being excluded from further consideration for employment or if an individual has already been hired, termination of employment.
   

  

**EEO Statement:** 
 Moove is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, race, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, political affiliation or any other protected characteristic.

data.title: Executive Director - Real Estate
data.raw_snippet: Join the UAE’s largest bank and one of the world’s largest and safest financial institutions. We are looking for top talent and your success is our success
data.jd_text:
Join the UAE’s largest bank and one of the world’s largest and safest financial institutions. Our focus is to create value for our employees, customers, shareholders and communities to grow through differentiation, agility and innovation. We are looking for top talent and your success is our success. Accelerate your growth as you help us reach our goals and advance your career. Be ready to make your mark a top company, in an exciting \& dynamic industry.
 



  





**Job Purpose**




  





 To grow and manage large account portfolios and sensitive client relationships for assigned portfolio in the Real Estate \& Hospitality banking segment; improve service quality levels and supervise the subordinates' day\-to\-day activities and client interactions to ensure that the team's objectives are constantly met and its revenue targets achieved, while maintaining client satisfaction and portfolio credit quality.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities**




  





**Client and Market Analysis** 




  




* Conduct financial analysis on clients and their respective geographies/ industries/ markets to identify potential opportunities and risks.
* Demonstrate understanding of the sector across all RE asset classes
* Originate new business opportunities with new to bank target clients across banking products and in line with relevant policies.
* Cross collaborate to obtain support from relevant stakeholders and governance forums to close deals (e.g., credit, products, GT).
* Develop Term Sheet, Information Memorandum, Mandate letter etc.
* Examine \& resolve credit, market and operational risk aspects of the transactions in collaboration with products and enablement units.
* Leverage FAB’s network expansion through cross border deals to expand RE market share
* Anchor Strategic Alliances with UAE’s Top Developers, Authorities, and sector experts
* Expand Products Penetration Through Sector\-Focused Solutions, keeping with RE cycles and thematics
* Ensure high returns with satisfactory yields
* Maintain the credit quality of the client's relationships within the Portfolio to an acceptable level set by the
* Bank's management.
* Pitch, review, negotiate and conclude deals.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key decision makers in other banks and attend industry events to originate business.
* Up to date with the latest market, competitors, regulatory and industry and amend accordingly the account plans as when applicable.
* Ability to handle sophisticated transactions and engage assigned team members.
* Recommend policy amendments as when required to match with the latest business trends.



  





**Business Origination** 




**Client Relationship Management** 




  




* To achieve assigned financial and non\-financial objectives by meeting all borrowing \& non borrowing needs of customers with target segments (E.g., borrowers, transactors, depositors).
* Prepare and Maintain Account Plans for all clients with support from relevant partners (e.g., products, international banking, Employee banking, Asset Management, etc.).
* Support on the conduct of annual/periodic credit facility reviews in the existing portfolio in a timely manner and support on the recommendation of appropriate credit facilities in line with the banks credit. policy to maximize earnings while containing risks to an acceptable level and identifying candidates for downgrades/ upgrades.
* Develop, Implement and maintain complete control aspects i.e., documentation, periodical client visits / call reports, stock inspections and formal credit checks / informal market feedback to monitor the assigned portfolio effectively.
* Establish appropriate monitoring of client relationships and the underlying RE portfolio performance
* Organize client meetings with relevant partners/ seniority to deepen FAB relationship within the portfolio.
* Identify \& develop cross selling opportunities and increase cross\-sell ratio and returns with clients.
* Support client on their day\-to\-day banking requirements with support from the team (as applicable).
* Ensure customer satisfaction remains high and meets the targeted NPS score.
* Keep abreast of market trends and manage a disciplined marketing process by identifying steps/strategies necessary to effectively initiate relationships with prospects.
* Onboard new clients as and when required.



  





**Collaboration** 




  




* Align with the relevant Real Estate teams across the bank (credit, products) as well as other partners (international FAB offices) to identify and convert opportunities.
* Collaborate with other business divisions to drive cross\-BU collaboration. Develop proposition strategy, competition analysis, focused group approach, service delivery model, customer experience, internal \& external campaigns and alignment with other Products \& proposition including Risk policies, Payment \& Cash management, Trade products, collaboration with Retail banking including Private Banking, etc.
* Align with International banking to support client in FAB network locations.
* Support Unit/Divisional/Bank\-wide initiatives (as required or assigned).



  





**Operational** 




  




* Follow all relevant policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions so that work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner.
* Conduct periodic reviews of risks (credit, operational, compliance etc.) within the portfolio on a regular basis.
* Drive day\-to\-day administrative and transactional activities for the team such as client calls, documentation follow up, pipeline updates, and any other activities in the unit/team to ensure continuity of work and delivery of effective/high quality output.
* Ensure that internal processes for existing portfolio/ NTBs are in\-line with the Bank's policies \& procedures.
* Manage and follow up on KYC and compliance requirements to ensure consistency with the Bank's KYC and AML policies and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure all credit reviews are submitted on time and agreed conditions are met.
* Ensure all clients' files \[documents] are maintained.
* Maintain a satisfactory audit on the portfolio.
* Adhere to process KPl's and, ORM, BCP \& Internal Audit requirements.
* Prepare timely and accurate statements and reports to meet the unit's requirements, policies, and standards.



  





**Leadership** 



* Act as Role Model for the entire Real Estate \& Hospitality group and Real Estate team
* Lead, Mentor, Motivate, Develop and Coach team members to ensure career growth and short \& long term successors
* Establish high\-performance culture and ensure high engagement levels.
* Encourage ownership through rightful assignments to team members.
* Achieve individual and team's financial performance targets.
* Learning \& Development Attend appropriate on and off\-the\-job training programs and ensure development and skill upgradation of team members.
* Involvement in team members new hirings.



  





**Qualifications**




  




* Bachelor’s degree in finance or related discipline.
* Master’s degree in business administration is preferred.



  





**Experience**




  





 12\+ years of experience in Banking with at least 8\+ years in senior role of team management.
 



  





**Knowledge, Skills, And Attributes**




  




* Deep Knowledge of Wholesale Banking or investment banking.
* Demonstrable RE Sector knowledge and experience.
* Understanding of FAB's product offering and business strategy.
* Ability to collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders to drive business.
* Strong relationship management skills both internally and externally.
* Sound communication skills (written and verbal).
* Ability to analyse and research information.
* Deep Financial and credit analysis ability with an aptitude to identify opportunities and close business deals.
* Data analysis and financial modelling skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and adjust quickly to changing priorities.
* Proficient in MS Office (excel, word and Power\-point).

 Lead the technology strategy for International commercial lT across global markets! For strategy and AI partnership, responsibilities include defining the International technology strategy to align with Group direction and creating a phased delivery plan for different regions. Acting as the primary technology counterpart to the Regional Digital Leader involves providing leadership for the commercial AI roadmap. data.jd_text:
**The Executive Director of Enrollment Management (EDEM)** 
 is responsible for developing and implementing strategic initiatives to promote American University of Sharjah (AUS), advance its mission, and position it as a premier institution of choice for qualified local and international students.
   

  

 The EDEM provides leadership and oversight for key enrollment functions, including:
   

  

* Undergraduate (UG) and graduate (GR) student recruitment and admissions
* The University Testing Center
* The external sponsorships program
* The Welcome Center
* The Contact Center


 Collaborating closely with internal stakeholders, the EDEM ensures alignment with the university’s strategic objectives. This includes conducting periodic assessments, research, and analyses of the higher education landscape to inform data\-driven enrollment strategies and meet institutional targets. Additionally, the EDEM prepares annual enrollment projections to support budget planning.
   

  

 Externally, the EDEM fosters strategic partnerships with Ministries of Education/Higher Education, government agencies, sponsoring entities, high schools, and higher education institutions within and beyond the UAE to strengthen AUS’s enrollment pipeline and reputation.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Oversee the development and implementation of the Office of Enrollment Management (OEM) Multi\-Year Strategic Plan.
* Track inquiries, leads, yields, and application trends to guide decision\-making and improve efficiency.
* Serve on various committees to formulate leveraging strategies, including those related to student success, recruitment and retention, financial grants and scholarships, and a university capacity task force.
* Supervise the planning and execution of the new student orientation program.
* Prepare and maintain the departmental budget, ensuring alignment with institutional strategic enrollment goals and objectives.
* Analyze admission standards and requirements and recommend adjustments for approval by senior leadership.
* Develop print and online informational and promotional materials.
* Serve as the final arbiter on admissions decisions in accordance with established policies.
* Advocate for fair admission policies and ensure equitable treatment of all applicants regardless of background.
* Develop grade concordance tables and matrices for different secondary education systems.
* Establish and monitor the application of academic credential evaluation and assessment standards.
* Monitor the effectiveness of internal admissions processes and policies to ensure they meet key performance indicators.

data.jd_text:
A trusted partner for millions of customers, Ecolab is a global sustainability leader offering water, hygiene and infection prevention solutions and services that protect people and the resources vital to life. Building on more than a century of innovation, Ecolab has annual sales of $16 billion, employs approximately 48,000 associates and operates in more than 170 countries around the world. The Middle East and Africa Market is one of our highest\-potential growth markets, and we are investing to accelerate that growth through Enterprise AI, data, and digital innovation.
   

  

 As our
 **Enterprise Ai \- Business Engagement Leader** 
**– Middle East Africa** 
 , you will be at the centre of the MEA market leadership team and serve as the senior link between Ecolab’s
 **Enterprise AI** 
 organisation and the Divisions, Functions, and country leaders driving growth across the region. You will fuel the MEA growth agenda with technology and AI\-enabled business outcomes — accountable for the delivery of solutions, from idea to value capture.
   

  

**What’s In It For You**
* Lead the Enterprise AI agenda for one of Ecolab’s highest\-potential international markets
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of AI, data, and digital solutions that directly accelerate top\-line and margin growth across MEA
* Partner with senior Market, Division, and Function leaders as a trusted commercially aware technology advisor
* Shape technology strategy, investment prioritisation, and value capture inside a $16B global sustainability leader
* Influence Enterprise\-wide AI and digital strategy while owning local growth outcomes
* Build and develop a high\-performing team of business process analysts and digital talent across the region
* Competitive total rewards, comprehensive benefits, and global career mobility within Ecolab


**What You Will Do**
**Strategic Partnership \& Growth Alignment** 
 — Build strong partnering relationships with MEA business and function leaders to understand their growth ambitions, commercial priorities, and operational challenges. Align Ecolab’s Technology strategy with the MEA market growth strategy, leveraging technology, AI, and analytics to unlock new revenue, expand share, and improve customer outcomes. Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for the business divisions and functions.
   

  

**Solutions Accountability** 
 — Own the delivery of value stream solutions for MEA — from demand intake and business case, through design, build, deployment, adoption, and value realisation. Hold global delivery teams, partners, and local stakeholders to outcomes, schedule, cost, and quality; remove blockers; and ensure committed business value is captured and reported.
   

  

**IT Project Portfolio Management** 
 — Bring visibility and prioritisation to the portfolio of Enterprise AI and digital projects supporting MEA business and function activities. In line with global governance processes, establish project priorities, secure resource availability, and monitor progress to ensure timely and successful delivery. Manage stakeholder expectations and resolve issues and risks proactively.
   

  

**Digital \& AI Investment Management** 
 — Work with MEA business leaders to determine Enterprise AI and digital investment levels based on growth opportunity, organisational priorities, and budgetary considerations. Provide recommendations on technology investments, cost optimisation, and resource allocation to maximise commercial value and ROI.
   

  

**Business Relationship Management** 
 — Serve as the primary point of contact for MEA business and function leaders on Enterprise AI, data, and digital topics. Drive effective communication, manage expectations, and address systemic issues, escalations, and enhancement requests related to applications, infrastructure, and digital services.
   

  

**Service Delivery Assurance** 
 — Oversee Enterprise AI and Digital service and support processes for the MEA business. Proactively track service levels, drive process improvement, and act as the escalation point for service topics that impact the growth agenda.
   

  

**Demand Intake \& Prioritisation** 
 — Filter and prioritise MEA project requests before the PMO intake process starts. Verify budget exists in the business or Enterprise Ai plan, and confirm business resource readiness. Keep Enterprise AI resources focused on the highest\-value, growth\-aligned work.
   

  

**Governance, Security \& Architecture** 
 — Ensure 100% Security and Enterprise Architecture sign\-off on MEA projects. Drive adoption of standard, secure enterprise platforms that unlock data and AI opportunities at scale and protect the business.
   

  

**Talent \& Team Leadership** 
 — Lead, coach, and develop market\-aligned business process analysts and digital talent. Drive a strong Enterprise AI culture across the MEA team in line with the Ecolab leadership model, managing by influence across the broader Enterprise AI organisation.
   

  

**Position Details**
* Location: Middle East and Africa region (primary hub Dubai)
* Travel: Regional travel across Middle East and Africa; periodic international travel for Enterprise AI and Markets leadership engagements
* Reporting line: Solid\-line to the Global Markets Business Engagement Leader, with close alignment to the MEA Market Head as a member of the MEA market leadership team
* Work model: Full\-time, hybrid


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in a technical, business, or related field
* 10\+ years of relevant experience in IT, Digital, AI/Data, Business Analysis, Programme Management, or a similar leadership role
* Demonstrated accountability and track record for delivery of major technology or digital programmes in a multi\-country, matrixed environment
* Proven business and commercial acumen — experience of partnering with senior business and function leaders, building business cases, and translating technology strategy into measurable growth outcomes
* Experience managing third\-party technology service providers and global delivery partners against outcome\-based commitments
* Strong written and spoken English


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience operating across the Middle East and/or Africa region, including working with local regulatory, cultural, and commercial environments
* Experience leading AI, data, and analytics initiatives that have delivered measurable commercial growth
* Experience in a global manufacturing, B2B services, or industrial environment
* Familiarity with enterprise platforms such as SAP/ERP, CRM, data and analytics, cloud, and security technologies
* Knowledge of Ecolab’s industries — Institutional, Industrial, Healthcare, Life Sciences, Pest Elimination — is a plus
* Additional regional languages (Arabic, French) a plus
* Master’s degree or equivalent (MBA, MSc) a plus


**Key Skills \& Leadership Behaviours**
* Business and commercial acumen — understands P\&L, growth levers, customer economics, and how technology and AI investments translate into commercial outcomes
* Growth mindset — relentless focus on unlocking new revenue, market share, and productivity through Enterprise AI and digital
* Ownership — drives delivery from idea to adoption to value capture, with no hand\-off gaps
* Leadership presence to motivate and develop diverse, multi\-country teams
* Manage by influence — collaborates across global Enterprise AI groups to develop talent and drive results
* Focus and decisiveness — enables action and progress even when faced with ambiguity
* Executive communication — strong stakeholder management at C\-suite and Market leadership level


*Ecolab is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with a disability.*
**About Enterprise AI At Ecolab**
 Enterprise AI is the technology and intelligence engine behind Ecolab’s global growth — delivering the AI, data, platforms, and digital solutions that help our customers and our 48,000 associates operate cleaner, safer, and more sustainably in more than 170 countries. We combine the agility of an AI\-first organisation with the scale and stability of a Fortune 500 enterprise, partnering closely with every Ecolab Division, Market, and Function to turn data and technology into measurable commercial growth.
   

  

 Join us, and help shape what comes next — for Ecolab, for our customers, and for the planet.
   

  

**Our Commitment to a Culture of Inclusion \& Belonging**
 Ecolab is committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants and furthering the principles of Equal Opportunity to Employment. We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. Ecolab will not discriminate against any associate or applicant for employment because of race, religion, color, creed, national origin,citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, or disability.

data.jd_text:
**🚀 Head of Care\+ Ecosystem — Dubai HQ** 




 Trust Infrastructure for Device Financing in Emerging Markets
 



  





**Location:** 
 Dubai HQ (relocation) \+ regular business trips to operations countries
 



 (Nigeria, Kenya, Tanzania, Ghana, Uganda, and other emerging markets)
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time · Senior Leadership
 



**Start:** 
 ASAP
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are building trust infrastructure for device financing in emerging markets — where millions of customers finance smartphones but do not trust banks, services, or promises.
 



 Care\+ is not a warranty department.
 



  





 It is an ecosystem of trust around the device: replacement, refurbishment, anti\-fraud, service operations, and lifecycle management.
 



  





 We are looking for a Head of Care\+ Ecosystem — a founding\-level operational leader who will build and scale the entire after\-sales infrastructure across multiple countries.
 



  





 This role builds the department almost from zero — from 2 people to 8\+ senior team members during the first 18 months.
 



  





**What is Critically Important (must\-have experience)** 




 🔧
 **Device Certification** 




 — Practical experience in smartphone/consumer electronics certification in China
 



 — Real experience working with factories, certification labs, ODMs, and engineering teams
 



 — Understanding of factory documentation flow, typical bottlenecks, and “where things actually break.”
 



 — Experience with local device certification in Africa / SEA / LATAM countries
 



 — Understanding of local regulatory reality and launching devices in emerging markets
 



  





 📦
 **Spare Parts and Service Infrastructure** 




 — Deep understanding of spare parts movement and after\-sales logistics
 



 — Understanding of how spare parts actually move: factory → distributor → ASC → customer
 



 — Experience working with authorized service centers (ASC)
 



 — Understanding of SLA, replacement economics, refurbishment, and warranty operations
 



 — Understanding of local logistics reality in emerging markets, not only processes “on paper”
 



  





 🌍
 **Remote Management and Operational Audit** 




 — Proven experience in remote management of multi\-country service operations
 



 — Regular audits, inspections, and on\-site service center checks
 



 — Experience investigating:
 


* inventory leakage
* fake warranty claims
* fake parts
* grey market devices
* device swapping
* fake repairs



 — Ability to see the difference between reports and field reality
 



  





 👥
 **Hiring and Managing Local Managers** 




 — Experience hiring first\-level local Service / After\-Sales Managers
 



 — Ability to identify strong local operators “on the ground.”
 



 — Experience managing managers who work locally in\-country but functionally report to HQ
 



 — Experience building a controllable regional structure
 



 — Own network of service / after\-sales contacts in Africa or SEA is a major advantage
 



  





 📋
 **Standardization and Operational Discipline** 




 — Experience building standardized operational frameworks for multi\-country operations
 



 — Creation of SOPs, audit standards, escalation flows, and service protocols
 



 — Ability to establish consistent service quality across countries with different levels of market maturity
 



 — Ability to transform “manual management” into scalable operational infrastructure
 



 — Process discipline and reporting culture are non\-negotiable
 



  





**Strong Advantage** 




 — Experience working in the Dubai HQ of international companies
 



 — Experience working in: Nigeria, Kenya, Tanzania, Ghana, Uganda, Côte d’Ivoire, and other African countries
 



 — Experience in organizations such as Samsung, Transsion, Xiaomi, OPPO, vivo, realme, Huawei, HMD/Nokia
 



 — Understanding of how emerging markets operations really work outside corporate presentations
 



 — Experience in device financing / BNPL / smartphone financing ecosystems is a major advantage
 



  





**Basic Requirements** 




 — 8\+ years of experience in service / after\-sales / operations management
 



 — Multi\-country operations experience
 



 — Experience building and scaling teams
 



 — Strong analytical and operational mindset
 



 — English fluent (mandatory)
 



 — Willingness to travel: approximately 6–10 days/month during launch phase, with gradual reduction of travel load as operations scale
 



  





**Area of Responsibility** 




 — Building and managing the Care\+ ecosystem
 



 — Device certification in new markets
 



 — Development of service center network
 



 — Spare parts and refurbishment operations
 



 — Hiring, training, and functional management of local Service Managers
 



 — Anti\-fraud strategy and operational audit
 



 — Distributor and ASC relationship management
 



 — Building scalable operational infrastructure across multiple countries
 



  





**Compensation \& Growth** 




 — Senior\-level compensation structure discussed individually based on interview results
 



 — Includes fixed base, transparent KPI bonus structure, and long\-term participation opportunity
 



 — Transparent KPI mechanism
 



 — Grace period during the first 2 months
 



 — Dubai HQ leadership role
 



 — International multi\-country scope
 



 — Long\-term leadership growth opportunity within the ecosystem
 



  





**Career Path** 




 Year 1–2: Head of Care\+ Ecosystem
 



 Year 2–3: VP Care\+ Operations
 



 Year 3\+: COO\-track / senior ecosystem leadership
 



  





**What is Important for This Role** 




 We are looking for someone who:
 



 — understands the difference between reports and reality
 



 — knows how to build controllable operations
 



 — is capable of building discipline and standards
 



 — can operate in the complex field reality of emerging markets
 



 — can simultaneously manage people, processes, and risks
 



  





 If you know how to build a controllable after\-sales infrastructure in environments where processes on paper and processes in reality are two different things, we would like to speak with you.

data.jd_text:
**About Us**
 talabat is the leading food and grocery delivery platform across the MENA region, serving customers in 9 countries. Our mobile apps are the primary interface for hundreds of thousands of daily orders — and the engineering behind them directly shapes how millions of people eat, shop, and experience convenience. We're part of the Delivery Hero network spanning 50\+ countries.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About this role:**
 We're looking for a Mobile Engineering Manager to lead one of our mobile engineering teams building the talabat consumer experience on iOS and Android. You'll own the delivery of features that millions of users interact with daily — from discovery and ordering to real\-time tracking and payments.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on leadership role. You won't be writing code daily, but you'll be close enough to the codebase to make informed architectural decisions, unblock your engineers, and maintain high technical standards. You'll lead a team of 6–10 mobile engineers and partner closely with product, design, and backend teams.
   

  

 We practice eXtreme Programming (XP) principles — including pair programming, TDD, and continuous delivery. If you haven't worked in an XP environment before, that's fine — what matters is that you believe quality enables speed and you're excited to lead in this way.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead a team of 6–10 mobile engineers (iOS and Android) through planning, building, and shipping customer\-facing features
* Own mobile release quality — drive testing strategy, monitor crash rates and performance metrics, and maintain release cadence
* Partner with product managers and designers to shape what gets built, balancing user impact with technical feasibility
* Make architectural decisions on mobile patterns (modularisation, dependency injection, reactive patterns, navigation architecture)
* Coach and develop engineers through regular 1:1s, pairing sessions, and career development conversations
* Manage cross\-team dependencies with backend, platform, and infrastructure teams
* Contribute to mobile engineering standards and practices across talabat


**What Success Looks Like**
**By 90 days** 
 : You understand the mobile codebase, the team's delivery rhythm, and key stakeholder relationships. You've completed 1:1s with every team member and have a clear picture of strengths and growth areas.
   

  

**By 6 months** 
 : Your team is shipping incremental value consistently. You've measurably improved at least one dimension of team health — whether that's cycle time, test coverage, onboarding speed, or engineer satisfaction.
   

  

**By 12 months** 
 : You've shaped the technical roadmap for your area, developed at least one engineer toward their next career milestone, and established yourself as a trusted partner to product and design leadership.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**You must have**
* 6\+ years of hands\-on mobile engineering experience (iOS, Android, or cross\-platform)
* 2\+ years leading and managing mobile engineering teams (hiring, performance, career development)
* Deep understanding of mobile app architecture — you can evaluate trade\-offs between native vs cross\-platform, modular vs monolithic, and different state management approaches
* Experience shipping mobile apps at scale (100K\+ DAU) with a focus on performance, reliability, and user experience
* Strong automated testing mindset — you believe in CI/CD for mobile and have driven testing culture in a team
* Experience with mobile release management, feature flagging, and gradual rollouts
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced, iterative environment where priorities shift based on customer data


**Bonus If You Have**
* Experience with XP practices (TDD, pair/mob programming, trunk\-based development)
* Familiarity with Domain\-Driven Design (DDD) or event\-driven architecture
* Experience with Swift/SwiftUI and Kotlin/Jetpack Compose specifically
* Background in e\-commerce, delivery, or marketplace mobile apps
* AWS or cloud platform experience
* Experience working across time zones or with distributed teams


**This role is for you if...**
* You get energy from growing engineers, not just shipping code
* You care about mobile craft — smooth animations, fast launch times, accessible interfaces
* You're comfortable making technical calls even when the data is incomplete
* You want to lead at a company where mobile IS the product, not an afterthought


**This role is NOT for you if...**
* You want a pure people\-management role with no technical depth
* You prefer stable, slow\-moving environments with long planning cycles
* You're not comfortable with pair programming or collaborative coding practices


**Additional Information**
**Your career growth path:**
 Talabat Operates a Structured Career Framework With Clearly Defined Levels For Engineering Leaders. As a Mobile Engineering Manager, You'll Enter An Established Progression That Rewards Growing Impact, Strategic Ownership, And People Leadership
   

  

**Engineering Manager** 
 — You lead a single team, own delivery and people development, and build the engineering culture within your squad. Your direct impact is at the squad and domain level.
   

  

**Senior Engineering Manager** 
 — You lead multiple teams or a full domain. You set technical direction across squads, grow the next generation of managers, and own domain\-level strategy with a longer planning horizon.
   

  

**Engineering Director** 
 — You lead engineering across a tribe or multiple domains. You define technical vision, partner with senior business leaders, and are accountable for quality and delivery at scale.
   

  

**Senior Engineering Director** 
 — You lead engineering across multiple tribes or an entire product line. You shape company\-wide technical strategy, build director\-level talent, and represent engineering at the executive level.

The successful candidate will be confident engaging with C\-level executives and senior industry leaders across international markets.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Research \& Programm Development:**
* Help research industry trends, market developments, and audience needs
* Help develop commercially viable conference agendas and event concepts
* Identify key discussion topics and emerging market opportunities
* Conduct competitor analysis and market mapping of industries into buyer and seller chains
* Research and build databases of target individuals suitable for speaking at events or attending advisory board meetings


**Identify targets according to:**
* Seniority level (e.g. CIO, CTO, CSO)
* Geographic focus
* Major companies within target markets
* Client recommendations


**Speaker Acquisition \& Management**
* Identify, approach, and secure senior\-level approved speakers and industry experts
* Invite, follow up, and confirm approved speakers via LinkedIn, email, and phone
* Achieve agreed monthly speaker confirmation targets across assigned events
* Build and maintain strong relationships with speakers, sponsors, clients, and industry stakeholders
* Manage and maintain accurate speaker invitation trackers at all times
* Keep live event agendas updated with confirmed speakers and allocated sessions
* Collect professional bios and high\-resolution speaker photos immediately upon confirmation
* Ensure event websites are continuously updated with speaker profiles and agenda changes


 Act as the main point of contact for all speaker communications regarding:
   

  

* Event participation
* Session content
* Travel and accommodation arrangements
* Event logistics and queries


**Assist with speaker travel budget allocation where required**
* Collect and organize speaker documentation needed for local event licensing procedures
* Send detailed speaker briefing documents covering both content and logistics
* Ensure speakers are fully briefed and event\-ready at least two weeks before the event
* Organize and attend Meet the Panel briefing sessions for moderators and panelists via Zoom or Microsoft Teams
* Ensure moderators distribute final discussion workflows ahead of sessions


**Advisory Board Management**
* Invite and secure approved advisory board participants through LinkedIn, email, and phone outreach
* Secure targeted attendance numbers for advisory board meetings conducted via Zoom or Microsoft Teams


 Coordinate meeting logistics including:
   

  

* Sending Teams/Zoom invitations
* Distributing agendas in advance
* Managing confirmations and reminders


 Attend and record advisory board meetings where applicable
   

  

**Maintain accurate attendee records including:**
* Names
* Job titles
* Company details
* Contact information


 Export and manage attendee data from meeting platforms where required
   

  

 Collect attendee bios and high\-resolution photos and ensure prompt website updates
   

  

**Event Project Management**
* Manage event timelines, production schedules, and key deliverables
* Coordinate closely with sales, marketing, sponsorship, and operations teams
* Ensure all programm content and speaker deliverables are completed on time
* Maintain high standards of organization and communication throughout the production cycle
* Support onsite event delivery and attend events where required
* Assist the Content Director with ad hoc research, production tasks, and event support


**Marketing \& Website Coordination**
* Work closely with the marketing team to support event promotion and audience engagement campaigns
* Prepare marketing brief for each event including event background, elevator pitch, target audiences, why they should attend, marketing taglines and agenda topics and features
* Ensure conference websites are consistently updated with the latest agendas, confirmed speakers, attendee information, and event announcements
* Upload and maintain accurate speaker bios, photos, session details, and advisory board information across event platforms
* Assist with the development and review of marketing copy including agenda descriptions, speaker highlights, email campaigns, and social media content
* Ensure all website content is accurate, professional, and aligned with brand standards and event timelines
* Support marketing initiatives by identifying compelling content and speaker announcements to help drive delegate registrations and engagement


**Commercial Support**
* Work closely with sponsorship and delegate sales teams to support event revenue goals
* Prepare sponsorship brief for each event detailing buyer seller categories with examples, why they should invest, specific leads generated through online and primary research, competitive event listings etc.
* Pass on weekly developments, agenda updates and new potential leads to sales team
* Help develop commercially attractive conference topics and speaker line\-ups
* Support the creation of sponsorship opportunities aligned with program content
* Contribute to audience growth by inviting VIP delegates and speaker connections and overall event profitability


**Required Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong research and analytical skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Strong stakeholder and relationship management abilities
* Confidence engaging with senior executives and C\-level decision\-makers
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously
* Excellent organizational and time management skills
* Commercial awareness and understanding of B2B conference models
* High attention to detail and accuracy
* Proactive, adaptable, and solutions\-oriented mindset
* Strong networking, negotiation, and follow\-up skills


**Preferred Experience**
* Previous experience in conference production, events, media, or B2B conferences
* Experience engaging with senior executives and international stakeholders
* Familiarity with CRM systems, LinkedIn outreach, Zoom, and Microsoft Teams
* Experience working on international conferences or exhibitions is an advantage


**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Communications, Marketing, Journalism, Events, or related field

Location: Dubai, UAE
   

  

 Department: Championship Management
   

  

 Reports to: Senior Championship Manager
   

  

**Who We Are**
 The European Tour group administers golf’s global Tour \- the DP World Tour \- the HotelPlanner Tour and the Staysure Legends Tour, as well as golf’s greatest team contest, the Ryder Cup.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We’re looking for a Championship Manager to join our Championship Management team, based in our Dubai office.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, delivery\-focused role at the heart of our global events programme. You’ll work closely with Championship Management and event\-specific teams to plan, project manage and deliver world\-class events across our Tours.
   

  

 You’ll support the Championship Management Team on Tier 1 events and take the lead on Tier 2 and Tier 3 events, working under the guidance of the Championship Director.
   

  

 While the role is predominantly Middle East–based, there will be opportunities to work in Europe and Asia, including periods of travel of up to four weeks at a time, with weekend and evening working required around event delivery.
   

  

 If you thrive in a fast\-paced, international environment and enjoy taking ownership of complex events from concept to delivery, this role offers real scope and challenge.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Event planning \& delivery
   

  

* Work with internal and external stakeholders to understand event requirements, build delivery plans and execute them effectively
* Produce detailed event proposals, including timelines, venues, suppliers, staffing, budgets and legal obligations
* Lead all pre\-event planning activity for assigned events
* Run day\-to\-day operations for Tier 2 and Tier 3 events
* Support the Senior Championship Manager in creating and delivering operational plans for Tier 1 events


 Supplier \& stakeholder management
   

  

* Research and appoint venues, suppliers and contractors, working with procurement to negotiate commercial terms
* Manage and coordinate all event logistics, including venues, catering, infrastructure and staffing
* Lead operational meetings (supplier, venue and infrastructure planning) for Tier 2 and Tier 3 events
* Monitor actions, drive completion and escalate when required


 On\-site event operations
   

  

* Coordinate suppliers, manage client queries and troubleshoot issues on\-site to ensure smooth, on\-budget delivery
* Organise facilities including car parking, traffic management, security, first aid, hospitality and media
* Make operational decisions independently on Tier 2 and Tier 3 events
* Oversee event breakdown, dismantling and venue clearance


 Governance, compliance \& reporting
   

  

* Ensure insurance, legal, health \& safety and other regulatory obligations are fully met
* Produce post\-event evaluations to capture learnings and inform future events
* Research opportunities for new events and clients


 Leadership \& collaboration
   

  

* Manage other team members on defined project tasks
* Run meetings, set agendas, capture actions and present information clearly and concisely
* Work collaboratively across the business with a “one company” mindset


**Knowledge, Skills \& Experience**
 Event \& project management
   

  

* Proven experience delivering high\-profile sporting or large\-scale international events (European Tour Group or equivalent experience desirable)
* Strong project management capability, with experience following PRINCE2 methodology
* Confident using collaborative tools such as Outlook, Teams, Excel and project tracking systems (e.g. WeTrack or similar)


 Communication \& stakeholder management
   

  

* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to build strong relationships and instil confidence with senior stakeholders, partners and suppliers
* Confident managing multiple stakeholder expectations simultaneously


 Strengths \& behaviours
   

  

* Highly organised, proactive and solutions\-focused
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, evolving environment
* Flexible, adaptable and calm under pressure
* Collaborative, inclusive and culturally aware, with experience working across different countries and teams


**Additional Requirements**
* Willing and able to travel internationally for extended periods
* Strong understanding of golf and its diverse stakeholder landscape
* Additional language skills are a distinct advantage due to the international nature of our Tours


 The European Tour group promote diversity, equality, and inclusion. We ensure that we make employment decisions by matching our business needs with skills and experience of candidates, regardless of anything.

**Primary Duties**
 Operates as a part of team of Engineers in the coordination of resources in order to ensure that the construction meets all contractual requirements in the most effective and efficient manner. May be deployed on a number of projects at any time or be appointed to manage smaller projects.
   

  

  Assist the Project Manager in providing commercial and technical input for the contracts department at the estimation stage.
   

  

  Review all contract documentation to assess feasibility of construction, identify any potential areas of difficulty and take note of any variations required in the construction.
   

  

  Participate in the development and review of the project planning process and create a schedule, which is in line with the project requirements including establishing the sequence and duration of activities.
   

  

 Active
   

  

  Generate TDR (Technical Document Register) as a level 4 schedule and ensure that all relevant data required for construction is contained in it. Monitor the issue of drawings as per the forecast dates mentioned in the TDR, identify any discrepancies and bring it to the attention of the Lead Engineer. Take corrective actions wherever required in the case of missing data from either the client or vendor.
   

  

  Review Engineering drawings, documents and deliverables relating to area of functional responsibility to assess constructability and consistency with contract requirements. Prepare and issue purchase requests for materials and consumables.
   

  

  Prepare and review project specific and other procedures to ensure comprehensive cover of all project activities as per the contract requirements.
   

  

  Coordinate all project related activities with other departments and sections to ensure effective integration of tasks and minimize potential delays.
   

  

  Participate in the finalization of work to be outsourced to sub\-contractors including bid evaluation and terms of contract. Monitor the performance of the sub\-contractor once the contract has been awarded.
   

  

  Monitor the progress of the project as per the project plan and against the client’s requirements and take corrective action whenever required.
   

  

  Ensure the availability of necessary resources for the smooth execution of the project.
   

  

  Follow up with clients on approvals and instructions, attend client meetings and liaise with client on all issues of the project deliverables.
   

  

  Steer post award kick off meeting with vendor, Expedite, follow up to ensure proper monitoring and review of vendor deliverables in line with contractual requirements, execution schedule, Purchase Order requirements and terms \& conditions, follow up to ensure that suborders of materials are in line with supplier’s engineering and manufacturing schedule, and monitor respective deliveries. Resolve any potential operational issues that may impact the deliveries, Monitor the recovery of delays and implementation of remedial actions. Identify Risks and liaise with stakeholders to mitigate delays and cost impacts. Monitor the update of order progress periodically.
   

  

  Effectually nurture and maintain professional and healthy relationship with suppliers, conduct and monitor objective supplier performance appraisal.
   

  

  Carry out a routine check for field expediting requirements at supplier’s shop and plan expediting visits accordingly after consultation with the Project Manager, Solicit supplier to maintain an inspection plan, liaise with QA/QC and coordinate inspection visits. And monitoring until obtaining Material Receipt Voucher (MRV) from material controller on site.
   

  

  Investigate causes of Excess, Shortage and Damage (ESD) of supplies. Coordinate with the supplier and the procurement department to resolve ESDs and safeguard a genuine material receipt report.
   

  

  Advise supplier on invoicing instructions, Review ,verify and administer supplier invoices for payment against progress milestones.
   

  

  PO close out by Expediting supplier’s submission of final Material Record Book (MRB), and all required documents as per PO, Initiate completion of certification for progress and final payment, Maintain performance metrics and coordinate Supplier Performance Evaluation.
   

  

  Approving freight charges, deciding on the mode of shipment, resolving conflicts with suppliers, providing recommendations on whether or not to apply L/D, on inspection application or waiver, and deciding on field expediting requirements; however as delegated by Project Manager.
   

  

  Participate in the project activity report preparation and verify all data to ensure that it is accurate and accurately reflects the status of the project.
   

  

  Coordinate with relevant certification agencies for the endorsement of regulated activities.
   

  

  Participate in the preparation of all final documentation during the closure of the project.
   

  

  Participate in the formal review of the project post completion to identify areas for improvement.
