data.jd_text:
**Job Summary**
**About SC Ventures**
 SC Ventures is Standard Chartered’s innovation, fintech investment and ventures arm. We were established to reinvent banking, as the significant technological disruptions to the industry was impacting its ability to serve clients and customers, in the ways they needed to be served.
   

  

 We are a unique ecosystem of innovators, banking experts, business builders and partners who are focused on rewiring the DNA in banking and bringing breakthrough ideas to scale, together.
   

  

 We are building ecosystems around four high conviction themes: Online Economy \& Lifestyle, SMEs \& World Trade, Digital Assets, and Sustainability \& Inclusion.
   

  

 We are a global team of "Members" (excluding individual ventures), including dedicated colleagues from the Group's support functions, based in Singapore, Hong Kong, London, and the United Arab Emirates
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 The Innovation and Venture Designer is a senior individual contributor at the forefront of shaping what banking can become next. Reporting to and supporting the Head of Innovation and Design, this role will define, design, and deliver customer\-centric digital and service experiences across the SC Ventures portfolio, turning bold ideas into ventures that can scale in market.
   

  

 This is a role for someone energised by change, ambiguity, and the challenge of building in fast\-moving markets. The role holder will apply human\-centred design and product design expertise to unlock better customer outcomes, accelerate venture validation, and strengthen product\-market fit. The role carries Director\-level accountability, autonomy, and influence, working closely with venture CEOs, product leaders, engineers, and senior stakeholders to shape high\-impact decisions.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
**Proposition Shaping**
* Support the shaping of bold, differentiated venture concepts grounded in emerging trends across AI, fintech, and digital business models.
* Apply strong commercial acumen and customer insight to focus efforts on high\-potential opportunity spaces and translate them into compelling venture hypotheses.
* Work closely with venture leads, technologists, investors, and senior stakeholders to develop and refine co\-created early\-stage venture ideas.
* Leverage AI augmentation and modern design tools to accelerate ideation, concept development, and early prototyping.


**Proposition Validation**
* Turn bold venture ideas into tangible prototypes that can be tested with real users and evaluated for seed investment by the Investment Committee.
* Run fast, hands\-on validation cycles to test assumptions, gather customer insight, and build robust evidence for or against investment decisions.
* Rapidly design, prototype, and iterate using modern tools including Figma and AI tools such as Claude.
* Translate complex ideas into clear, compelling narratives and artifacts that are simple, decision\-ready, and investment\-grade.


**Product Design \& Venture Build**
* Apply strong UX, service design, and prototyping craft to move from ambiguity to clarity at speed, shaping intuitive and high\-impact user experiences.
* Support ventures post\-seed by refining early\-stage product, user journeys, and experience design.
* Create prototypes and product concepts that bridge strategy, technology, and customer experience.
* Embed AI augmentation into product design to enhance user value, differentiation, and scalability.
* Ensure alignment between customer needs, business viability, and technical feasibility across early\-stage product development.


**Overall Mindset**
* Be comfortable operating in zero\-to\-one environments, balancing creativity, speed, and rigour.
* Bring a solid understanding of fintech ecosystems and digital business models, with sound commercial judgment.
* Thrive in a fast\-moving, experimental environment where building, testing, and learning quickly matters most..


**Risk Management**
* Adhere to Policies and Procedures.
* Act and escalate quickly when any risk and control weakness become apparent and ensure they are addressed within an appropriate timeframe and escalated through the relevant committees.
* Work with SCV colleagues to deliver expected business performance results within cost constraints and applicable risk/ control framework to ensure that the Group’s ability to remain within risk appetite is not materially threatened.


**Governance**
* Have an awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.


**Regulatory \& Business Conduct**
* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.


**Key stakeholders**
* Head of Innovation and Design
* Venture leads
* SC Ventures leadership


**Other Responsibilities**
* Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in the business and SC Ventures;
* Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures.


**Skills And Experience**
* Influence
* UX/UI Design
* Innovation
* Business Acumen
* Strategic Thinking


**Qualifications**
* 10\+ years’ experience across facilitation, product design, product commercialisation, innovation design, UX/UI and/or consulting
* Experience working in AI augmented or automation rich product environments, leveraging AI tools or agents to accelerate discovery and delivery
* Ability to define intent, constraints, and evaluation criteria for AI generated outputs across design and innovation workflows
* Strong systems thinking: comfortable designing workflows, guardrails, and governance rather than only artefacts
* Proven track record designing complex, customer\-facing digital products at scale
* Strong expertise in UX research, interaction design, visual design, and prototyping (Claude Code/Cursor in addition to Figma)
* Experience operating at Director\-level influence without formal people management
* Strong understanding of agile product development and cross\-functional delivery models
* Ability to clearly articulate design decisions to senior, non\-design stakeholders


**About Standard Chartered**
 We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
   

  

 Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
   

  

**Together We**
* Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
* Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term


**What We Offer**
**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,** 
 we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
   

  

* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time\-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market\-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first\-aiders and all sorts of self\-help toolkits
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies \- everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

data.jd_text:
Pattern is a leading eCommerce accelerator with offices across the globe offering outsourced marketplace and ecommerce management services for brands worldwide. The Pattern Ecommerce Acceleration Platform leverages AI\-powered technology, industry expertise, and global distribution, logistics, and fulfilment services to help quality brands scale profitably on their own websites and through hundreds of marketplaces. Pattern works with some of the most recognized brands such as Thorne, Naturelo, Marshall, Nutricost, MegaFood, TIGI, Hair Burst and Sage and it ranks among the top 5 Amazon sellers globally.
   

  

 Pattern is expanding and we are looking for an experienced Ecommerce expert to join our MENA Team in Dubai to support the scaling of the business by driving the performance of the brands we represent on Amazon and other Marketplaces.
   

  

 You will own the relationship and financial performance of a portfolio of global brands managing their performance across marketplaces here in MENA. You will support the Associate Director of eCommerce with defining and implementing the E2E growth and profitability plan for your portfolio of brands by working cross\-functionally with Operations, Content, Advertising, Creative, Merchandising and Finance. You will also lead cross\-functional projects to implement processes to scale the organisation in MENA. You will be a strategic and commercial ecommerce professional who can engage partners and internal stakeholders towards a common goal. You will have a growth mindset and love navigating the challenges of working in fast changing landscapes.
   

  

**The core responsibilities of the Senior eCommerce Manager reflect the following**
* Drive revenue growth on marketplaces across MENA through a data\-driven approach across a portfolio of brands through B2B and D2C marketplaces.
* Ensure that a clear activity plan is in place to achieve and surpass the budget targets, including promotional planning, seasonal phasing, NPD launches, advertising campaigns etc.
* Define the strategy and joint business plan with our brands to create mutually beneficial sales and marketing plans which grow market share.
* Represent your brands brilliantly across Marketplaces through best\-in\-class product content, including but not limited to images, enhanced content, keyword SEO, local language translation, advertising campaigns etc.
* Conduct analysis of brands performance using multiple data sources and tools on a regular basis to ensure that performance is continuously optimised across all touch points.
* Manage inventory, working alongside our merchandisers to maintain a healthy pipeline
* .Establish and maintain relationships with appropriate client partners, providing day\-to\-day contact on project status and changes.
* Have a passion for continuous improvement and building and automating processes.


**What will I need to thrive in this role?﻿**
* Demonstrated success in managing an ecommerce business
* 5\+ years experience in an ecommerce role
* Strong academic background (2:1 or above)
* Previous experience managing and growing 3P business on Marketplaces (Amazon and Noon)
* Creative thinker and problem solver
* Highly organized and disciplined
* Willing to be nimble and adaptable to change
* Able to work under pressure and manage workloads effectively
* Arabic fluency preferred to facilitate communication with local market clients


**We Are Looking For Individuals Who Are**
**Game Changers** 
 \- A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern’s processes and outcomes.
   

  

**Data Fanatics** 
 \- A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data.
   

  

**Partner Obsessed** 
 \- An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner’s expectations and delivers results that exceed them, prioritises the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern.
   

  

**Team of Doers** 
 \- Someone who is a part of team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in over 70\+ countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Who We Are?**
 When you think of food delivery in the MENA region, we’d be pretty surprised if talabat didn’t pop into your mind first! Since delivering our first order in Kuwait in 2004, we’ve grown quite a lot over the past 17 years.
   

  

 Today, we deliver hundreds of millions of food orders, grocery items and other products per year, to our customers in nine countries throughout the region with more than 3,000\+ employees! Our food delivery business works with over 27,000 brands and almost 50,000 branches, while our q\-commerce concept, talabat mart, now delivers groceries to customers in Bahrain, Egypt, Jordan, Kuwait, Oman Qatar, and the UAE in 30 minutes or less!
   

  

 Our philosophy is to make sure we do what is right for our ecosystem \- our customers, our partners, our people, our riders, and the communities in which we operate. Our \#techforgood program allows our customers a safe and convenient way to contribute to important causes in their community through donating to local and international charities directly on talabat with a focus on food insecurity in the region. Since its inception in 2020, we have facilitated the donation of well over 1 million meals to those in need, as well as donated over $1\.5 million to charity with the help of our partners and customers. talabat is part of Delivery Hero, the global leader in online food delivery and q\-commerce.
   

  

**Role Summary**
* Owns regional value creation, translating strategic priorities into clear commercial initiatives with measurable impact.
* Leads complex, cross\-market programs, ensuring rigorous project management, senior\-level alignment, and disciplined execution.
* Establishes scalable commercial frameworks, enabling consistent decision\-making while preserving local market flexibility.
* Drives insight\-led decisions through advanced analytics, turning data into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Shapes executive dialogue, influencing stakeholders through structured communication and fact\-based narratives.
* Deploys technology as a performance lever, improving productivity, transparency, and speed to impact.

data.jd_text:
The First Group Hospitality is a Dubai\-headquartered, full\-service hospitality management company specialising in hotel operations, asset management, and F\&B strategy. With a team of industry veterans and a proven track record, the company delivers tailored solutions that enhance efficiency, optimise revenue, and maximise asset value for investors and hotel owners.
   

  

 As a trusted third\-party hotel management provider, The First Group Hospitality partners with leading global brands to drive operational excellence and long\-term profitability, thanks to expertise spanning property performance optimisation, cost management, and guest experience enhancement.
   

  

 Beyond management, The First Group Hospitality develops and operates a dynamic portfolio of upscale hotels, residences, and award\-winning restaurants, creating high\-value hospitality assets that stand out in the market. For more information, visit tfghospitality.com
   

  

 The Director of Revenue Management is responsible for maximizing revenue growth and optimizing profitability across all revenue\-generating channels in the hotel. This role entails setting and executing pricing strategies, managing inventory, and analyzing market data to drive revenue performance. The ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker with deep analytical expertise and a strong understanding of market trends, customer behavior, and distribution channels.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
- Strategic Revenue Management

* Develop and implement revenue management strategies and pricing models to maximize room revenue and market share.
* Conduct regular revenue analysis and forecasting to inform business decisions and strategic planning.
* Monitor competitive market trends and adjust pricing strategies as necessary to maintain a competitive edge.


- Inventory and Pricing Control

* Oversee the distribution and management of room inventory across all booking channels.
* Set room rates, packages, and promotions based on forecasted demand, market conditions, and competitive intelligence.
* Manage and optimize distribution channels, including OTAs, brand website, GDS, and other online and offline channels.


- Performance Analysis

* Track, analyze, and report on key revenue metrics, including RevPAR, ADR, occupancy, and market share.
* Regularly review and interpret revenue performance reports to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
* Present findings and recommendations to senior management to support revenue and profitability goals.


- Cross\-Departmental Collaboration

* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Reservations, and Operations teams to align revenue strategies with overall business goals.
* Provide training and guidance to sales and front office teams on revenue management principles and upselling techniques.
* Work closely with marketing teams to develop promotions and campaigns that drive occupancy and ADR.


- Technology and Systems Management

* Utilize revenue management software (e.g., RMS, CRS, PMS) to manage data and make data\-driven decisions.
* Oversee the implementation and maintenance of technology solutions that support revenue management processes.
* Ensure data integrity and accuracy in revenue management systems and processes.


- Market Intelligence

* Conduct ongoing competitive analysis, including pricing, positioning, and market trends.
* Keep abreast of industry changes, new technologies, and best practices in revenue management.
* Develop market segmentation and customer profiling strategies to enhance targeting and pricing precision.


- Budgeting and Forecasting

* Lead the annual budgeting and forecasting process for all revenue streams, including rooms, F\&B, and ancillary services.
* Ensure that revenue targets align with overall financial goals and provide regular updates on performance against budget.
* Identify opportunities to increase incremental revenue through upsell programs and ancillary offerings.
* Bachelor’s degree in hospitality management, Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or a related field
* Minimum 7\-10 years of experience in Revenue Management within the hospitality industry
* At least 3\-5 years in a leadership or multi\-property revenue management role
* Strong knowledge of hotel distribution channels, pricing strategies, and market segmentation
* Experience working with major hotel PMS, RMS, CRS, and channel management systems.
* Proven track record of driving RevPAR, ADR, and occupancy growth Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret and act on complex data sets.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present to senior management and influence key stakeholders.

**Intro:** 




 The Fund Sales Business Development Director (BDD) is responsible for originating and winning new fund services business across the United Arab Emirates, with a primary focus on the fund management community. Working closely with colleagues across Sales, Markets, and Global Financial Solutions, you will build pipelines, lead the end\-to\-end sales cycle, and convert opportunities into long\-term client relationships. You will represent CSC® externally with fund managers, asset managers, financial institutions, and key referral partners such as law firms and professional services firms. This role is suited to a high\-energy “hunter” with a strong network and a consistent track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
 



  





**Some of the things you’ll be doing:** 



* Proactively originate, qualify, and win new fund sales opportunities across the UAE.
* Build and maintain a strong referral network with external business partners (including law firms and professional services firms), deepening existing relationships and unlocking new referral sources.
* Lead the full sales cycle from prospecting to close, including discovery, solution positioning, presentations, deal management, follow\-ups, and negotiation.
* Collaborate with Global Financial Solutions and Markets teams to position CSC’s product suite, including fund administration, SPV services, depositary, AIFM, and strategic outsourcing solutions.
* Develop account and territory plans, including go\-to\-market activity plans, aligned to revenue targets and strategic priorities.
* Coordinate and contribute to proposals and RFP responses in partnership with the Funds Market team and other subject matter experts.
* Conduct deal\-by\-deal risk assessment and ensure new opportunities meet internal governance, regulatory expectations, and commercial criteria.
* Monitor market and competitor trends and provide actionable insights to support commercial strategy and growth planning.
* Represent CSC at client meetings, industry forums, conferences, and seminars to promote brand visibility and generate pipeline.
* Use sales tools and technology (e.g., Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Preqin or similar platforms) to manage pipeline, forecasting, activity tracking, and reporting.








**What technical skills, experience, and qualifications do you need?** 



* Demonstrated success in a business development / sales role with consistent achievement against quotas or revenue targets (new business acquisition focus).
* Experience selling to, or within, the fund management community (e.g., fund managers, asset managers, financial institutions) or selling closely related financial services solutions into that client base.
* Strong network within the fund management community and ability to build referral channels with law firms and professional services partners.
* Proven ability to run complex, consultative sales cycles, coordinate internal stakeholders, and close deals.
* Strong commercial judgement, negotiation skills, and ability to assess opportunity risk and fit.
* Proficiency with CRM and sales enablement tools, including Salesforce (or similar), with disciplined pipeline management and forecasting.



  





**Preferred Qualifications:** 



* Knowledge of fund servicing models and products such as fund administration, depositary, AIFM, SPVs, or strategic outsourcing.
* Existing partner relationships across the UAE fund management community.
* Experience selling regulated services and navigating governance, compliance, and risk review processes during onboarding.
* Strong presentation skills and experience representing an organisation at industry events and conferences.








**A typical career progression** 
 path could look like: Business Development Director → Senior Business Development Director / Sales Leader → Regional Sales Head / Commercial Director (Funds).
 



 Cross\-functional opportunities: pathways into Product Strategy, Funds Market Leadership, Key Account Management, or broader Global Financial Solutions commercial leadership roles.
 



 Compensation: competitive salary plus a commission plan aligned to individual performance and revenue outcomes (details discussed during the interview process), with access to CSC benefits and additional incentives as applicable.
 



  





**Why work with CSC?** 




 At CSC®, we’re always looking ahead, finding ways to improve and anticipate the future needs of our customers. Curiosity fuels our innovation and productivity drives our results. This proactive mindset has helped us adapt and create solutions that have enabled businesses to run smoother and smarter for more than 120 years.
 



 CSC is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining talented people whose personal values align with ours. We empower our employees to bring the right solutions to market to meet customer demand. That is why we are the premier provider of global solutions for more than 180,000 businesses.
 



  




* CSC is a great place to work with smart and dedicated people.
* We have been voted a Top Workplace every year since 2006\.
* We offer challenging work and career opportunities. Most positions are filled with internal moves and employee referrals.
* Employees are eligible for success sharing, bonus, or commission plans based on role and individual performance.
* CSC offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package as part of your Total Rewards that includes annual leave, tuition reimbursement, employee referral bonuses, and more.



  





**About us** 




 CSC is a global business, legal, and financial services company based in Wilmington, Delaware, USA, providing knowledge\-based solutions to clients worldwide. We have offices and capabilities in over 140 jurisdictions in the Americas, Europe, Asia Pacific, and the Middle East, and more than 8,000 colleagues. We are the business behind business.®

**About The Role**
 The PMO Manager is responsible for overseeing and optimizing project management activities across multiple streams to ensure the successful delivery of projects. This role involves supporting Project Managers (PMs), managing knowledge bases, ensuring the execution of Hypercare activities, and identifying and resolving risks and dependencies. The PMO Manager plays a key role in promoting cross\-stream alignment, implementing communication and escalation plans, and providing guidance to the project management team to achieve organizational goals.
   

  

**As a part of your job, you will:**
* Knowledge Management: Responsible for maintaining and organizing the project knowledge base, ensuring that all relevant project documentation is up to date and accessible.
* Support PMs in KPIs: Assist Project Managers in updating and tracking Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to ensure projects are aligned with organizational goals and performance metrics.
* Hypercare Activities: Lead and manage Hypercare activities, ensuring that projects transition smoothly from development to production and all post\-launch issues are addressed in a timely manner.
* Risk \& Issue Management: Collaborate with PMs to identify, assess, and resolve project risks, issues, and dependencies, ensuring projects remain on track and within scope.
* Promote Cross\-Stream Alignment: Foster strong communication and alignment between different project streams and teams, ensuring efficient collaboration and minimizing conflicts or misunderstandings.
* Communication \& Escalation Plans: Design, implement, and manage comprehensive communication and escalation plans to ensure timely updates and issue resolution across all levels of the project.
* Escalation to PMO Director: Escalate any critical project risks, issues, or delays to the PMO Director, providing them with necessary insights and support to make informed decisions.
* Coaching \& Mentoring: Provide guidance and mentorship to Project Managers, helping to build their skills and ensure adherence to best practices and processes.
* Vendor Management: Manage relationships with external vendors, ensuring they meet project requirements, timelines, and quality standards. Collaborate with vendors to address any performance issues and ensure smooth project delivery.


**What are we looking for?**
**Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field. PMP, PRINCE2, or similar project management certifications are highly desirable.

The Infra team is built on deep industry sector expertise with a demonstrably differentiated ability to address the most complex business problems and by supporting our owner/operator/contractor clients with the expertise of our deep project, Alvarez \& Marsal's ultimate goal is to reduce the level of uncertainty associated with the development and operational costs of your projects, contributing to greater shareholder value drawn from procurement through execution and asset management through different solutions.

 Inclusive Diversity

* Monitor operational risks, escalations, audit readiness, and business continuity requirements

**Requirements**

* 8\-10 years of experience in corporate services, operations support, administration, or asset\-level enablement roles

* Cross\-functional coordination

data.jd_text:
Imagine a piloted air taxi that takes off vertically, then quietly carries you and your fellow passengers over the congested city streets below, enabling you to spend more time with the people and places that matter most. At Joby, we've been working to make that dream a reality since 2009 and we're now in the final stages of certifying our aircraft with the FAA. With plans to launch our aircraft in the US and Dubai, we're now scaling manufacturing and preparing for the launch of our commercial service.
   

  

**Overview**
 As the leader for Joby’s future presence in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, you will build the business from the ground up, establishing the foundational relationships, operating model, and multi\-year strategy needed to launch a safe, compliant, and scalable service. Partnering closely with Joby’s senior leadership and U.S. headquarters teams, you will drive government and municipal engagement, develop strategic partnerships (including JVs and M\&A), and lead end\-to\-end deal execution. You will serve as Joby’s local face, elevating brand awareness, representing the company with stakeholders and media, translating market insights into action, and providing clear performance updates to executive leadership and the board.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Build the Business Foundation: Lay the foundation for the future KSA market for Joby
* Policy and Partnerships: In partnership with Joby’s senior leadership team, identify, build, and maintain strong relationships with local government entities, municipalities, and strategic partners to build trust and credibility, thereby strengthening Joby’s position in the KSA
* Corporate and Business Development: Source, evaluate, and execute M\&A, joint ventures, and strategic partnerships. Lead cross\-functional due diligence and manage deal execution from start to finish in the KSA
* Drive Strategic Execution: Implement a vision and multi\-year business strategy that balances execution across aircraft sales, business development, corporate development, government relations, OEM, manufacturing, and operations
* Develop Market Awareness: stay apprised of local trends, business opportunities, infrastructure opportunities, consumer mobility preferences, etc., within the KSA, and build action plans to exploit opportunities for Joby
* Collaborate with US Team: Work cross\-functionally with Joby’s US\-based headquarters functions to support global strategic initiatives and to support partner(s) in launching a successful, safe, and compliant service in the KSA
* Establish the Joby Brand Locally: Gather market insights and work closely with Joby’s marketing, business development, and communications teams to build a highly recognizable brand within the KSA
* Be the Local Face of Joby: Serve as the primary local representative of Joby at KSA events and with local press to drive awareness and early adoption
* Report to Joby Leadership: Provide regular updates on business performance and identify areas requiring support from the executive team and board of director s


**Required**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
* 10\+ years of experience in M\&A, Corporate Development, Program Management, Business Development, Government Relations, and/or Strategy
* 10\+ years of leadership experience, with increasing levels of responsibility
* Highly strategic thinker with strong business acumen and structured problem\-solving skills demonstrated through delivery of large complex projects/programs
* Excellent communication and presentation skills; able to influence at all levels,inspire teams, collaborate cross\-functionally, and represent the organization with external stakeholders
* An entrepreneurial mindset is suited for launching and scaling a new entity
* Exceptional ability to build and execute on a growth strategy
* Extensive professional network within the KSA and the Middle East, and proven ability to develop and maintain relationships
* Fluent in English and Arabic, both written and verbal communication
* Able to travel up to 30% of the time, including to the United States
* Legally able to work in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, or have the ability to be sponsored for a work visa


**Desired**
* MBA or advanced degree in a relevant industry
* Strong policy exposure and knowledge of regulatory frameworks (GACA, FAA, EASA)
* Proven track record of P\&L management
* Experience in the aviation or aerospace industry
* Previously launched and scaled a business or business unit
* Broad business experience in the Middle East
* Experienced in government and military relations and operations

**Job Description**
 What if you could shape a career as unique as you?
   

  

 At WSP, you can always find opportunities to grow and do what matters to you. Make the most of our global reach to discover new challenges and chances to work with diverse, talented individuals who will help you expand your horizons.
   

  

 As a
 **Project Manager** 
 you support the Senior Project Manager and Project Director in leading the planning, execution, and delivery of complex master planning projects. You will support all aspects of the project, including scope, schedule, budget, quality, and stakeholder management, ensuring that the project is completed on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards to the successful delivery of master plans. This role requires a strong understanding of urban development principles and the ability to navigate complex regulatory environments.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Detailed Key Responsibilities**
* Project Leadership \& Lifecycle Management
* End\-to\-End Delivery: Lead the tactical execution of Master Planning projects from inception through to delivery.
* Workstream Integration: Synchronize multi\-disciplinary workstreams—including infrastructure, sustainability, landscape architecture, and transport planning—to ensure a unified project output.
* Revenue Management \& Performance Monitoring: Implement and oversee Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) regarding schedule adherence, budget burn rates, and technical quality standards.
* Governance \& Change Control
* Project Reporting \& Performance Management: Lead the preparation and delivery of high\-quality weekly and monthly progress reports (MPRs) for clients, providing clear updates on programme status, key milestones, risks, resource utilisation, commercial performance, and upcoming look\-ahead activities.
* Scope Management: Rigorously monitor project boundaries; identify, document, and manage "scope creep" to ensure commercial viability.
* Change Protocol: Execute formal Change Requests for variations in schedule or budget, conducting impact assessments before escalating for Senior Management approval.
* Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify project risks (regulatory, environmental, or financial) and develop robust mitigation strategies to prevent delivery delays.
* Stakeholder Engagement \& Communication
* Primary Point of Contact: Act as the central liaison for clients, government authorities, utility providers, and contractors, ensuring transparency and trust.
* Conflict Resolution: Mediate technical or contractual disputes between stakeholders, leveraging professional diplomacy to maintain project momentum.
* Reporting Excellence: Author and present comprehensive monthly progress reports, dashboard updates, and executive briefings for internal leadership and external client boards.
* Quality Assurance \& Documentation
* Technical Compliance: Ensure all deliverables align with local planning regulations, international best practices, and the specific sustainability mandates of the project – by working with the technical leads of the project.
* Document Control: Oversee a rigorous documentation environment, ensuring all deliverables, data requests, email requests and stakeholder approvals are audited and archived correctly.
* Schedule Management: Develop and maintain detailed Project Plans using MS Project or Primavera P6\. Utilize Critical Path Methodology (CPM) to identify and mitigate potential delays.


**Qualifications**
* Academic Foundation: Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Business Management or Information Technology.
* Professional Experience: A minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in project management for management consultancies or similar. Experience of project management within large\-scale master planning or urban infrastructure is desired.
* Project Methodology: Advanced proficiency in structured frameworks such as PMBOK, PRINCE2, Agile, or Waterfall.
* Software Command: Expert\-level mastery of Microsoft Project, PowerPoint, Excel and Word. Primavera P6 is desirable.
+ Design Coordination: Familiarity with InDesign.
+ Data/Commercial: Advanced Excel (Pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, financial modelling)

* Essential Behavioural Competencies
* Self\-Starter \& Proactive Ownership: Takes initiative, thinks ahead, identifies risks and opportunities early, and drives actions forward without the need for close supervision or constant direction.
* Workload Management \& Accountability: Effectively manages own priorities, remains organised under pressure, and can independently balance multiple tasks and deadlines with minimal guidance.
* Team Contribution \& Support: Works collaboratively as part of the wider team, builds strong internal relationships, and actively supports colleagues by sharing workload and contributing where needed.
* Senior PM Support \& Added Capacity: Provides reliable support to the Senior Project Manager by taking ownership of delegated responsibilities, reducing pressure on senior leadership, and stepping in to manage additional tasks during peak periods.
* Client \& Stakeholder Relationship Building: Builds trusted, professional relationships with clients, consultants, contractors, and internal teams through clear communication and dependable delivery.
* PMO \& Project Controls Capability: Able to undertake all aspects of PMO support, including reporting, governance, programme coordination, document control, action tracking, and maintaining project controls.
* Financial Management \& Forecasting: Competent in managing project financials, including monitoring time charged, tracking spend, reviewing budgets, and maintaining accurate cost forecasts.
* Resilience \& Commitment: Comfortable working in demanding, fast\-paced environments, including longer days or additional hours when required to meet project milestones and business needs.
* Adaptability \& Flexibility: Responds positively to changing priorities, urgent issues, and evolving project requirements while maintaining a high standard of delivery.
* Communication: Exceptional command of written and spoken English. Ability to present complex data in a visually compelling and concise manner. Arabic proficiency is desirable.
* KSA Client Environment Experience: Good understanding of client expectations, business culture, and consultant standards when operating in Saudi Arabia.
* Certification: Active PMP (Project Management Professional) or Chartered Planner (RTPI/AICP/MRICS) status is highly desirable.
* Specialized Knowledge: Experience with KSA Giga\-projects is a significant advantage.
* Advanced Analytics: Use of Power BI and other analytical tools.


**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
 Work on landmark projects around the world and embrace opportunities to make an even bigger impact in the communities you care about. What if you could do the best work of your life and create a legacy for yourself?
   

  

**With us, you can. Apply today.**

Riyadh Air (RX), headquartered in the Saudi Capital, is the new national airline that’s shaping the future of flying. It seeks to lead the aviation industry by transforming Saudi Arabia into a global aviation and trade hub – a digitally native airline that will connect the kingdom to more than 100 destinations.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Are you the strategic mastermind who can turn complex aviation regulations into a symphony of safety and performance?
   

  

 In this role, you will partner with teams across Flight Operations, Ground Operations, Engineering, and Maintenance to embed quality, compliance, and accountability into every aspect of the operation, ensuring the highest standards of safety and performance.
   

  

 Take the lead in establishing, implementing, and continuously enhancing quality management systems and compliance monitoring frameworks that ensure adherence to regulatory requirements, internal policies, and industry best practices.
   

  

 Drive operational excellence by overseeing audits, compliance assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring effective risk management, audit readiness, and the successful closure of findings across all operational areas.
   

  

 Ensure quality and compliance risks are proactively identified, assessed, and mitigated through robust monitoring, transparent reporting, and corrective action plans that safeguard operational integrity and regulatory adherence.
   

  

 Hold authority to interface with regulatory bodies on compliance\-related matters, including securing approvals, responding to regulatory inquiries, managing certifications such as Third Country Operator (TCO) authorization, and representing the organization during audits and inspections.
   

  

 Lead and develop high\-performing quality and compliance teams, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, regulatory excellence, and operational accountability while ensuring sustainable compliance leadership and decision\-making continuity.
   

  

 Drive a culture of ownership, governance, and regulatory discipline by holding self and others accountable for delivering commitments, maintaining compliance standards, and achieving operational objectives.
   

  

 Promote transparency through performance monitoring, timely escalation of risks and findings, and the effective execution of corrective actions to ensure sustainable compliance and operational excellence.
   

  

 Join us to shape world\-class quality assurance and compliance programs, strengthen regulatory excellence, and drive safe, efficient, and industry\-leading operations across the organization.
   

  

**About You**
 Degree qualified, y ou will demonstrate a minimum of 7 years in airline quality assurance and compliance.
   

  

 You are expected to demonstrate an in\-depth knowledge of aviation regulations, safety standards, and industry best practices.
   

  

 We'd love to hear from you even more if you are able to lead a team, and are familiar with GACA (General Authority of Civil Aviation) regulations.
   

  

 This is your opportunity to shape the future of air travel. Bring your best and show us why you can own this position within Riyadh Air.
   

  

 Please submit your application by clicking on the Apply button. Our Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing applications shortly.

data.jd_text:
Req ID:517413
   

  

 At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high\-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
   

  

 Could you be the full\-time onsite Technical Leader for Platfrom Screen Doors "PSD" in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia we’re looking for?
   

  

 Could you be the full\-time Platform Screen Doors Project Engineer Manager in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia we’re looking for?
   

  

**Your future role**
 Take on a new challenge and apply your technical and project management expertise in a cutting\-edge field. You’ll work alongside collaborative and forward\-thinking teammates.
   

  

 You'll play a pivotal role in managing design activities with Platform Screen Doors (PSD) subcontractors and interfacing with customers and key stakeholders, including System, Sub\-system, Civil, Rail Operators, Project, and Supply Chain teams. Day\-to\-day, you’ll work closely with multidisciplinary teams across the business (such as Engineering, Supply Chain, and Quality teams), coordinate integration tests between suppliers and project teams, ensure compliance with Environment, Health \& Safety (EHS) requirements, and much more.
   

  

 You’ll specifically take care of managing subcontractors to ensure the quality, cost, and delivery (QCD) of the PSD subsystem (Design, Factory Acceptance Test, Installation, and Commissioning), but also ensure full coverage and validation of subsystem requirements.
   

  

 We’ll look to you for:
   

  

* Acting as the technical contact point between the customer, project stakeholders, and the PSD supplier
* Producing the technical part of supplier RFQs for the project and supporting the selection process for PSD suppliers
* Leading the design, interface, integration, and implementation of PSD systems across all project phases
* Reviewing and approving PSD technical specifications, drawings, calculations, and method statements
* Managing PSD/Civil interfaces along the project lifecycle
* Ensuring compliance with EN 50126, EN 50128, EN 50129, BS/EN17168, IEC standards, and relevant local railway regulations
* Overseeing installation activities and ensuring adherence to approved procedures and safety requirements
* Leading FAT, SAT, and integrated testing activities, including interface and safety validation tests
* Identifying and mitigating technical risks related to PSD implementation and system integration
* Providing technical leadership during project close\-out, documentation handover, and warranty phase


**All About You**
 We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
   

  

* Degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent
* Minimum 10 years of experience in Electrical Engineering and Design Management
* At least 7 years of professional experience in railway transportation system/sub\-system engineering, including Platform Screen Doors
* Preferably experienced in leading PSDs in large\-scale rail projects
* Experience in writing technical notes and developing solutions for complex interfaces
* Strong interface and leadership management skills
* Strong knowledge of electrical installation, testing, and commissioning
* Proficiency in AutoCAD; basic knowledge of BIM, Revit, and Navisworks preferred
* Self\-motivated, autonomous, proactive, and technically driven
* Fluent in English


**Things you’ll enjoy** 
 Join us on a life\-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:
   

  

* Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long\-term career free from boring daily routines
* Work with new security standards for rail signalling
* Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
* Contribute to innovative projects
* Utilise our agile and inclusive working environment
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award\-winning learning
* Progress towards senior leadership or specialised technical roles
* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential


 You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

Star is a human capability development company headquartered in Riyadh. Our work spans government, tourism, hospitality, healthcare, banking, and education.

 **Senior Project Manager** 
 to lead the delivery of complex, multi\-stakeholder programs from brief to completion. You will be Star's primary relationship holder with senior government and corporate clients, set the PMO approach for the delivery team, and play a key role in building our project management capability as the company grows.
   

  

 This is not a coordination role. You will own programs end\-to\-end managing scope, timelines, stakeholder relationships, subcontractors, and delivery quality simultaneously. You will also mentor junior PMs and shape how Star approaches project delivery as a practice.
   

  

**What you will be doing:**
* Leading 2\-3 large programs simultaneously for government and corporate clients
* Managing senior client relationships at ministry and executive level
* Building PMO structures, governance frameworks, and reporting systems
* Coordinating internal teams and external subcontractors toward shared milestones
* Producing executive\-level reports and stakeholder communications
* Mentoring junior project managers and setting delivery standards
* Using AI tools to improve planning, reporting, and team productivity


**Requirements**
* 5\-9 years of project management experience, preferably on government or corporate programs in Saudi Arabia
* Demonstrated experience leading programs independently from brief to delivery — not just participating in them
* Strong client relationship skills — comfortable presenting to senior government officials and executives
* Exceptional communication in Arabic and English, both written and verbal
* Structured problem\-solver — you define the problem before you solve it
* Active AI tool user — you use AI in your daily workflow, not occasionally
* Hands\-on work ethic — track record of doing the work, not just overseeing it
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; PMP or equivalent is a plus


**Benefits**
* Opportunity to lead some of Saudi Arabia's most significant human capability programs
* Fast\-growing company with real room to move into senior leadership
* Collaborative, high\-performance team
* Central Riyadh location

**Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.**
**The Opportunity**
 Do you excel at managing the transformation of complex customer environments, working to drive business transformation and large\-scale migration efforts for enterprise clients? If so, joining our team as a Program Manager for Transformation and Migration means playing a pivotal role in delivering customer outcomes as they migrate to the Nutanix Cloud Platform. You'll have the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technology and collaborate with top industry professionals to deliver business changing results via innovative solutions for our clients.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Nutanix Professional Services team delivers a strong influence on the success of each Nutanix implementation by its customers. The Services function ensures success by engaging with customers in the pre\-sales and post\-sales stages by assisting in their software\-defined data center (SDDC) strategy and architecture. Besides helping customers implement Nutanix products successfully, the Professional Services team, working with our partners, ensures customer success in fully implementing their virtualized and software\-defined data centers. The Nutanix Professional Services Consulting function includes assessment, design, implementation, integration, and automation services as well as project/program management.
   

  

**Your Role**
* Establish clear program objectives, success criteria, and governance frameworks in alignment with senior customer leaders and Nutanix Services leadership.
* Act as the primary trusted advisor for clients and internal leadership, presenting program health and strategic dashboards directly to executive and C\-level stakeholders.
* Lead high\-impact, client\-facing status meetings to manage customer expectations, mitigate risks, and drive program velocity.
* Foster deep, long\-term client relationships through world\-class project delivery, ensuring high customer satisfaction and unlocking future account growth.
* Drive end\-to\-end program execution, tracking complex dependencies, predecessors, and milestones across multiple sub\-projects and workstreams.
* Partner with architects and resourcing teams to strategically schedule and deploy internal and external consulting talent.
* Proactively anticipate budget or timeline challenges, and deliver accurate quarterly revenue forecasting within internal systems of record.
* Collaborate with global Project Managers to optimize PM methodologies, share best practices, and continuously improve team efficiency.
* Create and maintain comprehensive, audit\-ready program documentation and execution frameworks.


**What You Will Bring**
* Minimum of 8 years of regional \& industry experience.
* Broad experience with managing complex projects of a variety of hardware, software, infrastructure, and cloud platforms and platform integrations
* Exceptional organizational skills including ability to plan, attention to detail, facilitation, time management, leadership and multi\- tasking skills
* Ability to work with clients and stakeholders to identify business objectives and align program deliverables to them· Ability to align the deliverables (outputs) to the program's outcome.
* Understanding of large\-scale customer operational standards and processes, preferably in the Banking/FSI sector.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English \& Arabic.
* Proven ability to problem solve and be dynamic in complex situations
* Self starter with intense drive for improvement and delivering results
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office and Project planning tools
* Proficient with Agile project management
* Experience using change management processes for dynamic professional services projects
* External customer\-facing management experience (including partners)
* Internal customer relationship management experience (i.e. sales, pre\-sales, advisory services)
* Experience managing multiple programs, projects, and clients in parallel is required
* Working knowledge with tools like NetSuite and Salesforce a plus
* Ability to adopt new processes and tools
* PMP required, PgMP, or PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI\-ACP) a plus


**Work Arrangement**
 Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in\-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in\-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team\-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 WSP Middle East is seeking an experienced and dynamic Director of Mining based in Riyadh, KSA, to establish and lead our Major Programs Mining \& Minerals business line in the region. This strategic leadership role will combine business development, project delivery oversight, commercial and financial management, and client relationship excellence to drive growth and successful delivery in one of our key sectors. As a leader within the Middle East region, with global connectivity, this role will require a blend of technical expertise, project leadership, business development acumen, and strategic client engagement.
   

  

 You will be responsible for shaping the direction of the mining business line, building strong teams, and delivering complex, major mining programs that align with WSP’s global standards and regional ambitions
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Business Development \& Strategy:**
* Serve as the founding leader for WSP’s Mining \& Minerals major programs business in the Middle East, establishing market presence and credibility.
* Navigate regional regulatory frameworks, cultural dynamics, and client expectations to build a sustainable business footprint.
* Define and execute the growth strategy for the Mining \& Minerals business line across the Middle East.
* Identify and pursue new market opportunities, capitalize on your existing relationships with government entities, mining operators, and strategic investors.
* Lead bid preparation and proposal development, including pricing, risk assessments, and contract terms.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with new and existing clients, and effectively represent WSP in meetings, workshops, and site\-based engagements.
* Prepare proposals, technical reports, and client\-facing documentation aligned with project and business objectives.
* Lead the setup and execution of PMC frameworks for large\-scale mining programs.
* Develop delivery models tailored to regional client needs, including owner’s team services and integrated project controls.


**Strategic Oversight of Advisory \& Design Streams:**
* Provide strategic leadership for the Mining Advisory and Design service lines.
* Ensure alignment with global technical teams and leverage international expertise to support and grow regional delivery.
* Drive integration across service lines to create a unified client offering – from pit to port, from exploration to closure.


**Project Delivery \& Operations:**
* Provide leadership and oversight for the successful end\-to\-end delivery of major mining projects including feasibility studies, mine planning, delivery, and closure phases.
* Implement and enforce project delivery governance, quality standards, safety protocols, and risk management frameworks.
* Collaborate closely with multi\-disciplinary teams to ensure seamless project execution and client satisfaction.


**Client Relationship \& Stakeholder Management:**
* Develop and maintain trusted advisor relationships with key clients, government agencies, regulators, and industry partners.
* Represent WSP at industry forums, conferences, and stakeholder meetings to enhance brand positioning and business opportunities.
* Be proactive in identifying opportunities to improve client outcomes and exceed expectations.


**Commercial \& Financial Leadership:**
* Take full P\&L accountability for the Mining \& Minerals major programs business line, including budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting.
* Manage commercial agreements, contracts, claims, and scope changes to protect company interests and maximize profitability.
* Drive cost control initiatives and optimize resource allocation.


**Leadership \& Team Development:**
* Recruit, mentor, and lead a high\-performing team of mining professionals across technical, commercial, and operational disciplines.
* Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, safety, and continuous improvement.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in mining engineering, Mineral Processing, Geology, or related field; master’s degree or MBA preferred.
* Minimum 15–20 years of experience in the mining sector, with exposure to consulting and operator\-side roles in the Middle East region.
* Familiarity with regional mining regulations, standards, and market dynamics is highly desirable.
* Proven track record in business development and establishing new business lines or service offerings.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience managing P\&L, contracts, and financial performance.
* Demonstrated success in leading large\-scale mining projects or programs in the Middle East or similar regions.
* Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment and drive change effectively.

 Join our close\-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.

data.jd_text:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consultancy groups specialising in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA's mission is to design safe and sustainable transport solutions to bring people together, develop social inclusion and facilitate access to employment, education and leisure throughout the world.
   

  

 For 65 years, the Group has been working alongside cities and regions to contribute to their development by creating, improving and modernising their infrastructure and transport systems, throughout the life cycle of their projects. SYSTRA is involved from the earliest stages of design through to the testing, deployment and maintenance phases. The company provides all its services in over 80 countries worldwide and generates 74% of its turnover internationally. With its new services, SYSTRA supports its clients and partners in their digital, ecological and energy transition, in order to invent the mobility of tomorrow.
   

  

 Context
   

  

***This requirement is for a bid opportunity only at this stage. Any engagement will be subject to successful project award and final client approval.***
 The Project Director will provide overall leadership and strategic direction for PMCM services on roads and bridges projects, acting as the primary point of accountability for project performance and client satisfaction. The role will be responsible for managing multidisciplinary teams and ensuring that all project objectives are achieved in line with contractual obligations and corporate standards.
   

  

 Subject to project award, the successful candidate will lead project planning, mobilization, execution, and close\-out activities, while establishing robust governance, reporting, risk management, and stakeholder coordination processes. They will oversee project controls, construction supervision interfaces, consultant and contractor performance, and ensure compliance with quality, safety, and regulatory requirements.
   

  

 The Project Director will also be expected to maintain strong relationships with clients, government authorities, contractors, and key stakeholders, while supporting business growth through opportunity identification, bid support, and strategic client engagement where required.
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties
   

  

* Lead and direct PMCM delivery for major roads and bridges projects from inception through completion, subject to award.
* Serve as the senior client interface and ensure effective stakeholder management at all levels.
* Provide leadership to project managers, discipline leads, construction management teams, and support functions.
* Establish and monitor project delivery strategies, execution plans, schedules, budgets, and resource requirements.
* Ensure effective management of scope, risk, change control, quality, HSE, and commercial performance.
* Oversee design coordination, construction supervision, contract administration, and project controls functions.
* Drive timely decision\-making and resolution of technical, contractual, and operational issues.
* Ensure compliance with client requirements, local regulations, and company procedures.
* Prepare and present executive\-level progress reports, dashboards, and performance updates.
* Support recruitment, mentoring, and development of project team members.
* Contribute to bid preparation, technical proposals, and strategic positioning for future PMCM opportunities.


 Profile/Skills
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be a highly experienced infrastructure leader with a strong track record of delivering large, complex roads and bridges projects under PMCM or similar consultancy\-led delivery models. They will possess excellent leadership, communication, commercial, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to operate effectively in demanding, high\-profile project environments.
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
* Minimum 20 years of relevant professional experience in infrastructure project delivery, with a strong emphasis on site\-based execution and project delivery leadership for major roads and bridges projects.
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience in managing projects through key delivery stages, including mobilization, construction supervision, interface management, testing and commissioning, project close\-out, and handover.
* Proven track record in leading the day\-to\-day delivery of large\-scale infrastructure projects, ensuring performance against programme, budget, quality, and contractual obligations.
* Strong practical experience in construction management, site operations, contractor oversight, supervision teams, and resolution of on\-site technical and operational issues.
* Proven ability to manage multidisciplinary site teams and coordinate effectively across contractors, designers, client representatives, authorities, and other project stakeholders.
* GCC experience is mandatory.
* KSA experience is a strong advantage.
* Chartered Engineer status is preferred or equivalent recognized professional accreditation.
* Strong knowledge of SHEQ principles, standards, and implementation practices across major infrastructure projects.
* Demonstrated commitment to Safety, Health, Environment, and Quality leadership, with the ability to embed a strong SHEQ culture across project teams and supply chain partners.
* Proven experience in promoting safe working practices, quality compliance, risk mitigation, incident prevention, and continuous improvement throughout project delivery.
* Strong understanding of contract administration, construction management, project controls, change management, and stakeholder coordination in live project environments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Strong client\-facing presence and the ability to engage effectively with senior stakeholders and public\-sector entities.


 Systra is an equal opportunities company; this position is open to all applicants.

**Job Summary**
 The Project Director is responsible for the overall leadership and delivery of large\-scale data centre projects in Saudi Arabia within a general contracting environment. The role has full accountability for project performance, including safety, programme, cost, quality, and commercial outcomes, ensuring compliance with Saudi regulations, local authority requirements, and contractual obligations. Working closely with clients, consultants, subcontractors and key stakeholders, the Project Director builds, develops and leads multidisciplinary teams to deliver mission\-critical data centre facilities to the highest standards, while managing local supply chains, Saudization requirements, and fast\-track project demands in the KSA market.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Project Leadership \& Delivery:**
* Provide end\-to\-end leadership for complex, mission\-critical data centre project from mobilisation through commissioning and handover.
* Take full responsibility for project performance, including programme, cost control, quality, safety, and risk management.
* Ensure compliance with contractual requirements, technical specifications, and regional regulations.
* Lead project governance, reporting, and decision\-making at senior and client levels.
* Appointment of individuals to key project positions.
* Work across company functional departments to engage support for on time delivery.


**Client \& Stakeholder Management:**
* Act as the primary senior point of contact for clients, consultants, subcontractors and key stakeholders.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships, ensuring confidence in delivery and responsiveness.
* Manage client expectations and lead negotiations on variations, claims, and commercial matters.


**Commercial \& Contractual Oversight:**
* Oversee commercial strategy in collaboration with commercial team.
* Ensure effective cost control, forecasting, and cash flow management.
* Review and approve major subcontract packages, procurement strategies, and commercial decisions.
* Manage risk, claims, and dispute avoidance/resolution.


**Team \& Resource Management:**
* Build, Lead, mentor, and develop project management, engineering, construction, and support teams.
* Ensure appropriate resourcing, capability, and succession planning for project delivery.
* Promote a strong culture of safety, accountability, and performance excellence.


**Programme, Quality \& Safety:**
* Ensure robust planning and programme controls are in place to meet critical data centre milestones.
* Drive best\-in\-class quality assurance and control processes aligned with data centre standards.
* Champion health, safety, and environmental excellence across all project activities.


**Pre\-Construction \& Business Support:**
* Support pre\-construction, tendering, and bid teams with construction methodology, programme input, and risk reviews.
* Contribute to value engineering, buildability reviews, and logistics planning.
* Support business development efforts related to data centre opportunities where required.


**Preferred Experience \& Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
* 15\+ years’ experience in construction delivery, with significant experience as a Project Director or Senior Project Manager.
* Proven track record delivering large\-scale data centre projects within a General Contracting / Main Contractor environment.
* Middle East \& Saudi Arabia experience, including knowledge of local regulations and practices.
* Demonstrated experience managing large, multi\-disciplinary teams and major subcontractors.
* Strong commercial, contractual, and risk management expertise.


**Key Competencies**
* Executive\-level project leadership
* Data centre construction expertise (mission\-critical environments)
* Client and stakeholder management
* Commercial and contractual acumen
* Programme and risk management
* Decision\-making under pressure
* Safety and quality leadership


**Personal Attributes**
* Strong leadership presence and credibility at client and executive level.
* Highly organised, decisive, and results\-driven.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multi\-cultural teams.
* Ability to operate effectively in fast\-paced, high\-risk, mission\-critical environments.

 Experienced Health and Safety Director (Associate Director grade) to support the delivery of a major giga programme, working directly with the client.

 This is a senior leadership position requiring a confident, credible individual who is equally effective on construction sites and in senior leadership forums, a true “boots and suits” role.

* Maintain a strong visible leadership presence on site, confidently engaging with contractors and project teams.
* Challenge unsafe behaviours, intervene where necessary, and ensure corrective actions are embedded.
* Ensure compliance with statutory requirements, client policies, and Mace governance.
* Review, analyse, and prepare HSE data, dashboards, reports, and trend analysis for internal and client use.
* Lead audits, inspections, and assurance activities across the portfolio.
* Lead and oversee incident investigations, ensuring robust root cause analysis and lessons learned.
* Prepare and deliver clear, professional presentations to senior leadership, translating operational performance into strategic insight.
* Line manage and mentor a team of HSE Managers, setting direction, priorities, and performance expectations.
* Build a high performing, collaborative HSE team capable of supporting a complex delivery environment.


**You’ll Need To Have**
* Proven experience at Senior Manager / Director / Associate Director level within major construction or development programmes.
* Strong track record delivering HSE leadership across large, multi project environments.
* Comfortable operating at both site level and executive level, with the credibility to influence at all tiers.
* Demonstrable experience leading investigations, producing senior level reports, and managing performance data.
* Experience managing and developing HSE teams.

* Chartered status (IOSH or equivalent) – preferred.


**Our values**
**Safety first \- Going home safe and well:** 
 We champion a safe, diverse, and inclusive working environment, understanding the importance of well\-being in every team.
   

  

**Client focus \- Deliver on our promise:**

**Integrity \- Always do the right thing:** 
 We influence positive outcomes within our industry while always aligning with our compliance obligations.
   

  

**Create opportunity \- For our people to excel:** 
 We champion a continuous improvement culture throughout all activities, inspiring our people and teams to develop.
   

  

 Mace is an inclusive employer and welcomes interest from a diverse range of candidates. Even if you feel you do not fulfill all the criteria, please apply, as you may still be the best candidate for this role or another role within our organisation.
   

  

 We are also open to discussing part\-time, flexible, and hybrid working options if suitable within the role.

 AlixPartners has embraced a hybrid work model to provide flexibility and support our employees’ work\-life integration. Our hybrid model combines a mix of in\-person (at client site or AlixPartners office) and remote working. Travel is part of this position, but the frequency may vary based on client, team, and individual circumstances.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Are you ready to build a future that exceeds your expectations? At AlixPartners, a leading global consulting firm, we help CEOs, boards, and owners tackle their most complex, high\-value challenges—often those making front\-page news and shaping Board Room agendas.
   

  

 Our Energy \& Process Industries (EPI) practice works with healthy, underperforming, and distressed companies across the refining, petrochemicals, and broader downstream value chain. We are seeking an experienced and entrepreneurial Director to lead and expand our Refining \& Chemicals platform. This role requires a proven leader who can drive transformational client delivery, spearhead business development, and manage multiple high\-stakes engagements simultaneously.
   

  

 You will collaborate with C\-level executives at national, integrated, and independent energy and chemicals companies, as well as institutional investors and portfolio firms. Drawing on your deep industry expertise, you’ll deliver measurable results across strategy, operations, capital, and performance.
   

  

 As part of our collaborative, fast\-paced team, you will work on urgent, high\-impact situations—helping clients unlock value while pursuing your own professional development and growth aspirations.
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end client delivery across strategy, operational improvement, cost transformation, and commercial performance in refining and petrochemicals
* Serve as a trusted advisor to senior executives and boards—especially in situations of urgency, complexity, or underperformance
