data.jd_text:
Müller\`s Solutions is a leading Tech consulting firm with a global footprint in Germany, Saudi Arabia, United Arab Emirates, and Egypt. We specialize in various domains such as Tech Outsourcing, Managed Services, SAP implementation \& Support, and Global Tech Recruitment. Our mission is to deliver innovative solutions that empower businesses to optimize their operations, streamline processes, and unlock the potential of top talent. As a trusted partner for many organizations, we pride ourselves on our diverse talent pool and our ability to drive progress and success for our clients. We are currently seeking a Digital Transformation Consultant to join our dynamic team. In this role, the consultant will play a key part in leading our clients through their digital transformation journeys, leveraging technology to enhance their business processes and overall efficiency. The ideal candidate will possess a blend of technical expertise and consulting experience, enabling them to provide valuable insights and tailor\-made solutions across various industries. If you are driven by challenges and passionate about technology and consultancy, this position offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact within an innovative environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead digital transformation initiatives for clients, assessing current operations and identifying opportunities for technological enhancements
* Develop and implement strategic roadmaps for digital transformation projects, ensuring alignment with client business goals
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to design and deploy efficient solutions that enhance productivity and performance
* Provide expert guidance on the integration of emerging technologies including cloud computing, data analytics, and automation into existing systems
* Conduct training and workshops for client teams to build their capabilities in navigating digital tools and platforms
* Evaluate and recommend relevant software and technology solutions to streamline operational processes for clients
* Monitor and analyze project performance, providing regular updates and reports to stakeholders on progress and outcomes


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field; a master's degree is preferred
* Proven experience in digital transformation consulting or industry experience related to technology implementations
* Strong understanding of emerging technologies and trends in the digital landscape, including cloud solutions, AI, and data analytics
* Excellent project management skills, with a demonstrated ability to lead projects to successful completion on time and within budget
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with clients and team members
* Ability to analyze complex business problems and develop innovative solutions to drive results
* Willingness to travel as needed to client locations across various regions
* A minimum of 10 years of total experience, including 5 years in digital transformation management


**Benefits**
 Why Join Us:
   

  

 Opportunity to work with a talented and passionate team.
   

  

 Competitive salary and benefits package.
   

  

 Exciting projects and innovative work environment.

* Embed overall change management and communications.

* Build tools and capability to support OU/market Transformation agenda: Partner with Sector TMO and CMO to build standard tools, project management, and working methods to ensure execution discipline across our transformation and strategic projects.
* Collaborate with the Global Team to leverage global tools and capabilities and get insights from other sectors on adoption and roll\-out practices.
* Lead key scale x\-functional transformation initiatives (to be aligned with stakeholders)
* Provide leadership and project management to several scale OU/market Transformation projects
* Change Management
* Lead the change management community, plan training for new change leads and impacted managers, and drive effective organizational implementation.
* Working with EMEA Change Lead to seamlessly integrate a clear change management plan.
* Sharing learnings across projects and teams
* Estimate 2\-3 significant projects per year (often multiyear projects)


**Qualifications**
 Key Skills/Experience Required
   

  

* University degree or MBA
* 10\+ years of business experience in leadership roles at Market/OU/Region/Global level in the FMCG sector, preferably with transformation, change management and/or project management experience

* Execution: Strong leadership skills and proven track record of partnering with and influencing at all levels of the organization to develop and implement scale transformation or strategic initiatives, working across business functions to set and execute the agenda. Outstanding project management skills and ability to bring clarity and discipline to the transformation agenda. Excellent communication skills and ability to simplify.
* Relationships: collaborative team player who thrives working in an agile and ambiguous environment, demonstrating solid people skills, working well x\-function and x\-BU to align behind goals and delivery
* Agility: flexibility and willingness to take on diverse and challenging tasks, passion for supporting and managing change. Ability to operate in through ambiguity and adapt to changing priorities. Demonstrates courage and conviction required to lead scale changes initiatives and embrace new ways of working.

Our client is a large, well\-established Saudi organization with significant scale across the Kingdom. A confidential search is underway to appoint a
 ****Chief Information Officer****
 who will own the full technology agenda and lead it as a peer to the rest of the executive team.
   

  

 This is a senior executive role with full ownership of the company's technology function. The Chief Information Officer will define and execute the technology strategy across infrastructure, enterprise applications, data, integration, and security, and will be accountable for the reliability, security, and commercial relevance of the entire technology estate.
   

  

 The successful candidate will bring a clear point of view on the future state of enterprise technology, the right balance between in\-house capability and strategic partners, and the discipline to deliver value in quarters rather than years.
   

  

**Responsibilities And Duties**
* Define and execute the multi\-year technology strategy across infrastructure, applications, data, integration, and security.
* Set the target architecture for the group, including ERP, core operational systems, data and analytics, and the integration fabric that connects them.
* Make and defend the build, buy, and partner decisions that shape the technology estate.
* Run a modern, reliable enterprise systems environment that supports the core operations of the business.
* Lead any ERP modernization or migration program required to support unified reporting, real\-time decisioning, and operational scale.
* Stand up the integration and middleware capability that allows the core functions to operate from one source of truth.
* Build the data foundation, the warehouse, the governance, and the analytics layer that the commercial, operations, and finance teams need.
* Embed data\-led decision\-making across the senior leadership population.
* Hold full accountability for the cybersecurity posture of the company.
* Ensure full compliance with the National Cybersecurity Authority, the Personal Data Protection Law, and all other applicable regulatory obligations.
* Own business continuity, disaster recovery, and the controls required by internal and external audit.
* Run a service\-oriented IT operation with measurable uptime, response, and cost commitments.
* Lead the program management office for technology, with clear quarterly delivery, transparent governance, and disciplined vendor management.
* Shape the IT operating model, including the balance between in\-house capability, managed services, and strategic partners.
* Sit on the executive committee and act as a peer to the rest of the senior leadership.
* Translate technology into commercial language for the Chief Executive Officer and the board.
* Manage the technology budget with the same rigor as a P\&L, including capital allocation, vendor consolidation, and total cost of ownership.


**Requirements And Qualifications**
* Fifteen years or more in enterprise technology, with at least five at Chief Information Officer, Group CIO, or equivalent level in a complex, multi\-site organization.
* A track record of leading a full technology stack end to end, ideally in a regulated or institutionally governed environment.
* Direct, hands\-on experience with at least one major ERP transformation or core systems re\-platforming program, from business case to go\-live.
* Deep fluency in enterprise technology, including ERP platforms, integration platforms, cloud infrastructure, data and analytics, and modern security architecture.
* Strong commercial instinct, with the ability to challenge and partner with operating leaders rather than simply service them.
* Proven cybersecurity and data privacy leadership at the level expected of a major Saudi organization.
* Vendor management discipline, with a history of consolidating estates, renegotiating contracts, and holding partners to outcomes.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related discipline. Master's degree or MBA is an advantage.
* Relevant certifications in enterprise architecture, security, or program delivery are welcomed.
* Arabic language is an advantage. English is required.

Our client is a large Saudi business with a growing direct\-to\-consumer footprint and a serious digital ambition. A confidential search is underway to appoint a
 ****Chief Digital and eCommerce Officer****
 to own the online channel and lead its next phase of growth.
   

  

 The Chief Digital and eCommerce Officer will own the online channel as a full P\&L and shape the digital customer experience end to end. The role carries the authority and the accountability to professionalize the digital operating model and to make the online business a genuine, profitable, and brand\-shaping pillar of the company.
   

  

 This is a building role. The product, marketing, fulfillment, and customer functions need to be brought together under one digital leader with the experience to deliver.
   

  

**Responsibilities And Duties**
* Take full ownership of the digital P\&L, including revenue, gross margin, contribution margin, and operating profit across web, app, and any marketplace activity.
* Lead annual planning, monthly forecasting, and the weekly trading rhythm at the standard expected of a serious digital business.
* Own pricing, promotion, and category economics in close partnership with the rest of the leadership.
* Own the digital product roadmap across web and app, with a clear, customer\-led prioritization framework.
* Build the in\-house product, design, and engineering capability required to operate a modern, conversion\-optimized digital storefront.
* Lead the technology choices that support the online business, in partnership with the broader technology function.
* Run the online trading operation, including range visibility, search relevance, recommendations, and promotional planning.
* Develop the marketplace and partner strategy where appropriate.
* Ensure the online proposition is coherent and commercially optimized.
* Own the digital customer P\&L, including acquisition, retention, lifetime value, and reactivation.
* Lead performance marketing, SEO, CRM, lifecycle marketing, and loyalty.
* Build the data, personalization, and segmentation engine that turns a single view of the customer into measurable commercial impact.
* Lead the fulfillment and last\-mile strategy, including the right balance of own and third\-party logistics.
* Own the post\-purchase experience end to end, from order confirmation to delivery, returns, and after\-sales support.
* Set the standard for digital customer experience across all touchpoints.
* Sit on the executive committee as the voice of the customer and the online business.
* Represent the digital agenda to the Chief Executive Officer and the board.
* Build a digitally fluent, commercially disciplined team with strong representation of Saudi national talent.


**Requirements And Qualifications**
* Twelve to eighteen years in eCommerce, digital, or direct\-to\-consumer leadership, with at least five years owning a meaningful online P\&L.
* A demonstrable track record of taking a digital channel from low single\-digit to material double\-digit share of group revenue, profitably.
* Experience leading a digital function during a period of structural change, including operating model, talent, and platform decisions.
* Strong commercial instinct, comfortable owning gross margin, contribution margin, and operating profit, not only top\-line growth.
* Fluent in modern digital architecture, including headless commerce, composable platforms, search and personalization, app development, and CDP and CRM tooling.
* Sharp on performance marketing economics, lifetime value modeling, and the unit economics of last\-mile delivery.
* Confident with marketplace dynamics and third\-party seller models where relevant.
* Direct, data\-led, and unafraid to make trade\-offs in pricing, range, and investment.
* Bachelor's degree in business, economics, engineering, or a related discipline. Master's degree or MBA is an advantage.
* Arabic language is an advantage. English is required.

**Company Description** 
 EmaarX.AI is an agentic AI\-powered marketplace for the construction sector, uniting contractors, suppliers, subcontractors, and project stakeholders on one intelligent platform. The company focuses on simplifying procurement, improving operational efficiency, and enhancing transparency across the construction value chain. By leveraging advanced AI, EmaarX.AI enables data\-driven decision\-making and seamless collaboration among participants. Its digital solutions are designed to help construction businesses grow faster, reduce risk, and optimize project outcomes. Joining EmaarX.AI means contributing to a technology\-first company transforming how construction projects are planned, sourced, and executed.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) is a full\-time, hybrid role based in Riyadh, with flexibility for partial work from home. The CTO will define and own the overall technology vision and roadmap for EmaarX.AI’s agentic AI marketplace, ensuring scalability, security, and reliability of the platform. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include leading software engineering teams, guiding architecture decisions, and overseeing end\-to\-end product development cycles from discovery to deployment. The CTO will collaborate closely with product, operations, and commercial teams to align technology initiatives with business goals and user needs. The role also involves establishing engineering best practices, managing technology budgets and vendor relationships, and building a diverse, high\-performing technical organization. In addition, the CTO will stay current with AI and construction\-tech trends, evaluate new tools and frameworks, and ensure compliance with relevant data protection and industry standards.

* Experience in Project Management, including leading cross\-functional teams, setting priorities, and delivering complex initiatives on time.
* Prior leadership experience in a tech startup or high\-growth environment; marketplace or construction\-tech experience is an advantage.
* Familiarity with AI/ML technologies, data platforms, and API\-first ecosystems.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical and non\-technical audiences.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:** 




**Corporate Strategy** 



* As a member of the senior management, lead the development of the strategies and plans for the Information Technology department and support in the development of the Operations division strategy to ensure that Naufar executes its mission effectively, achieves organizational objectives and realizes its vision.
* Lead the translation of Naufar’s overarching strategy into business plans for the Information Technology Department and ensure effective performance monitoring and management, in order to achieve department’s strategic objectives.



**Leadership** 



* Ensure the achievement of the departmental strategic objectives by setting priorities and objectives for direct reports, managing performance, developing a highly qualified talent pool and motivating them, and providing strategic direction, in order to maximize performance, improve productivity and reach operational excellence.
* Work closely with the Assistant COO to raise employee awareness and commitment to Naufar’s vision, mission, values and corporate strategy, in order to increase workforce engagement.



**Organization Structure** 



* Define efficient and effective organization structure for the department in coordination with the Organization Development and Human Resources to ensure optimum resource utilization, fast decision\-making and better communication among staff.



**Budget Planning** 



* Provide direction on department’s budget preparation in line with the department’s annual business plan.
* Ensure effective and continuous monitoring of financial performance of the department against its budget so that the organization is aware of anticipated costs and/or revenues, is able to identify areas of unsatisfactory performance, and can capitalize on potential improvement opportunities.



**Enterprise Architecture** 



* Manage effective conceptualization and implementation of IT architecture, in order to ensure consistency and optimization of IT operations.
* Direct and guide the continuous improvement of IT architecture, systems and processes, in line with the latest global technologies and IT standards.
* Ensure compliance of IT systems with relevant international standards and local laws and regulations, especially with respect to information security and data privacy.



**Demand and Delivery Management** 



* Direct and guide the comprehensive translation of business needs into IT projects and ensure timely, quality and efficient execution, in order to ensure effective IT support to other departments. Ensure adherence to time, cost and quality, in order to ensure efficient and effective delivery of services.
* Monitor quality and quantity of IT capacity to ascertain meeting current and future demands.



**System Development** 



* Provide overall direction to the system development team to direct and lead the effective analysis of user requirements, development/enhancement of IT systems as per business priority in order to ensure effective IT services management in accordance to business requirements.



**IT Operations and Support** 



* Direct and oversee IT operations so that they meet and exceed the service levels agreed with users and conforms to relevant technical and security standards within budgeted cost.
* Provide overall direction to infrastructure management team in order to ensure effective establishment and maintenance of a scalable and agile IT infrastructure that meets emerging and changing business requirements.
* Provide strategic direction on infrastructure related upgrades, both from system and network perspectives, to facilitate optimum service delivery.
* Ensure implementation of IT security policies and systems to safeguard and protect all IT operations ensuring the reliability and integrity of data.



**IT Performance Management** 



* Ensure effective development and implementation of quality assurance and control processes and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) to facilitate provision of high quality IT services in accord with defined quality standards and SLAs.
* Ensure effective execution of IT audits, and collaboration of all relevant parties to achieve defined quality standards.
* Direct the development and management of IT services sourcing strategy and vendor management policies \& guidelines, in order to ensure meeting IT requirements in accordance with statutory and Naufar’s policies with optimum benefits to the organization.



**IT Projects and Programs** 



* Based on the IT strategy and annual plan, evaluate the viability of IT projects and develop a prioritized project list based on commercial feasibility and Naufar’s business requirements.

Akura Medical, a Shifamed portfolio company, is advancing a differentiated platform for the treatment of venous thromboembolism (VTE), which affects up to 900,000 Americans each year. The company recently received US IDE approval for its QUADRA\-PE study evaluating the Katana™ Thrombectomy System in acute pulmonary embolism patients. In parallel, Akura Medical is developing NavIQ™, a software platform that transforms CT angiograms into 3D pulmonary vascular models to enhance visualization, procedural planning, and clot assessment towards better safety, efficacy, and ease of use. Akura has recently completed a $53 million first close of its Series C financing, led by the Qatar Investment Authority, supporting the launch of a joint venture and a new R\&D and manufacturing center in Doha, Qatar.
   

  

**About Shifamed**
 Founded in 2009 by serial entrepreneur Amr Salahieh, Shifamed LLC is a privately held medical device innovation hub focused on the development of novel medical products to address clinical needs in the rapidly evolving fields of cardiology and ophthalmology.
   

  

 Description:
   

  

 This position is responsible for the development, implementation, and management of quality systems and practices. This position will oversee and ensure that the development, manufacture, testing and release of products are performed according to the applicable federal and state regulations, international standards, and the Company’s Quality Policy.
   

  

 Responsibilities, Skills \& Hands\-On Experience:
   

  

* Ensure compliance with applicable Quality System Regulations and standards, including FDA QSR, ISO 13485, MDR, GMP, and Design Controls.
* Partner with R\&D and Operations to establish and maintain quality requirements throughout product development, transfer, manufacturing, and post\-market activities.
* Lead and maintain Design History Files (DHF), Risk Management Files, and associated quality documentation for products and processes.
* Develop and implement quality engineering activities including design verification/validation, process validation, equipment qualification, test method validation, and first article inspections.
* Support manufacturing quality activities including inspection processes, nonconformance investigations, CAPA, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Develop, maintain, and oversee manufacturing and quality documentation including procedures, inspection instructions, Lot History Records, and Bills of Materials.
* Manage supplier quality activities including supplier qualification, audits, source inspections, supplier controls, and ongoing quality performance monitoring.
* Prepare for, host, and support internal, customer, supplier, and regulatory audits and inspections.
* Coordinate quality system training and promote company\-wide quality system awareness and compliance.
* Support complaint handling, MDR/vigilance reporting, field actions, and investigation of product or process failures.
* Serve as Quality representative on cross\-functional project teams and act as site Management Representative and/or Quality signature authority as required.
* Lead and manage Quality Assurance resources to ensure effective execution of quality system and regulatory compliance activities.
* Other duties as assigned.


 Education \& Work Experience:
   

  

* Bachelors or Masters in Engineering or scientific discipline, or equivalent relevant work experience
* 15\+ years of Quality or Technical Management experience in the medical device industry or a related field.
* Previous direct people management experience.
* Previous experience bringing a company into regulatory compliance and approval, preferred.
* Solid knowledge of FDA regulations and interpretation of FDA regulations, guidelines, and policy statements.
* Solid knowledge of international regulations, standards, and guidelines (i.e. MDR, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 60601 and collateral standards, IEC 62304, IEC 62366, FDA guidance documents for cybersecurity).
* Ability to train others in processes and procedures.
* Excellent communications skills (both written and verbal) required.
* Ability to work effectively across functional lines to reach effective outcomes for the business.
* Ability to travel as required.


 Our salary ranges are calculated by role, level, and location. Please note that your position within that range will be determined by your job\-related knowledge, location, skills, experience, relevant education, and training/certifications.
   

  

 NOTICE TO CANDIDATES: Please be aware that Shifamed and its portfolio companies do not conduct interviews or extend offers through mobile web chat applications. Please report any such occurrences to hr@shifamed.com.

We don’t think about job roles in a traditional way. We are anti\-silo. Anti\-career stagnation. Anti\-conventional.

 Since being founded in 2021, we’ve acquired Virgin Mobile MEA, Friendi Mobile MEA and Virgin Mobile LATAM (with 6\.5 million subscribers) and 1600 dedicated colleagues across Chile, Colombia, KSA, Kuwait, Mexico, Oman, Pakistan and UAE.
   

  

 To disrupt for good takes a rebellious spirit, a questioning mind and a warm heart. We really care about how to get things done and not who manages who. We benefit from our diversity, and together, we disrupt the way we and others thinking about our lives for good.
   

  

 Do you want to exchange ideas, learn from each other and leave your mark on our journey? This is the place for you.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 Financial Director \- Kuwait will lead the finance function for Virgin Mobile Kuwait, covering accounting, financial operations, reporting, FP\&A, compliance, controls, commercial finance support, and finance transformation. The role partners closely with the Kuwait CEO, Group Finance, commercial teams, technology, regulators, auditors, banks, and external partners to ensure accurate reporting, strong governance, effective financial planning, and commercially sound decision\-making for the telecom business.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Financial Leadership and Governance
   

  

* Lead and manage end\-to\-end accounting and finance operations for Virgin Mobile Kuwait.
* Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close process, including trial balance reviews, reconciliations, management reporting, and financial statement preparation.
* Ensure compliance with IFRS, internal controls, delegation of authority, accounting policies, and Group reporting requirements.
* Provide clear financial leadership to local management and act as the primary finance partner to the Kuwait CEO and Group Finance leadership.
* Manage finance team operations, review deliverables, coach team members, and build a high\-performance, accountable finance culture.


 Commercial Finance and Business Partnering
   

  

* Support commercial, segment, sales, and marketing teams on new products, pricing plans, discounts, commissions, promotions, and business initiatives.
* Review financial and operational performance across revenue, margins, receivables, collections, profitability, cost efficiency, and business trends.
* Provide management with financial analysis, business cases, dashboards, presentations, and strategic insights to support decision\-making.
* Coordinate with budgeting and forecasting team to support annual budgets, rolling forecasts, business plans, and performance reviews.
* Challenge business assumptions and ensure commercial decisions are supported by strong financial analysis, controls, and profitability considerations.


 Financial Operations, Reporting, and Controls
   

  

* Oversee core finance operations, including general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, intercompany, fixed assets, revenue accounting, inventory\-related finance processes, and bank reconciliations.
* Monitor receivables, ageing, collections, working capital, and cash flow, and drive timely follow\-up with relevant business owners.
* Ensure accurate accounting and reporting for telecom revenue streams, customer offers, discounts, commissions, deferred revenue, contract liabilities, and related cost recognition.
* Maintain strong financial controls over procure\-to\-pay, order\-to\-cash, record\-to\-report, treasury, and reporting processes.
* Drive continuous improvement in reporting quality, close timelines, reconciliations, and process standardisation.


 Tax, Regulatory, Audit, and Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Lead tax, statutory, and regulatory compliance activities in Kuwait in coordination with external consultants and auditors.
* Manage external audit requirements, ensure timely submission of audit schedules, and drive closure of audit matters.
* Act as the key finance point of contact with regulators, banks, auditors, external advisors, suppliers, and relevant telecom partners for financial and operational matters.
* Ensure local statutory books, filings, board reporting inputs, and regulatory submissions are accurate, complete, and delivered on time.


 Finance Transformation and Systems
   

  

* Lead finance transformation, process automation, and system implementation initiatives, including ERP, reporting, procurement, and data automation projects.
* Partner with technology, data, and operations teams to strengthen revenue assurance, system integrations, reporting accuracy, and control visibility.
* Support SAP S/4HANA or other ERP improvement initiatives, including workflow approvals, master data governance, reporting enhancements, and automated controls.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, reduce manual work, improve compliance, and create scalable finance operations for Kuwait.
* Promote a control\-focused and automation\-led finance operating model aligned with Group standards.


 Key Performance Indicators
   

  

* Timely and accurate monthly close and management reporting in line with Group deadlines.
* Clean audit delivery with timely closure of audit queries and no major unresolved control findings.
* Accurate statutory, tax, and regulatory submissions with full compliance to local requirements.
* Improved working capital visibility, including receivables ageing, collections, cash flow, and payable management.
* High\-quality commercial finance support for pricing, offers, discounts, commissions, and business cases.
* Successful delivery of finance transformation, process automation, and reporting improvement initiatives.
* Strong finance team performance, accountability, and collaboration with local and Group stakeholders.


**What You Will Need**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Professional qualification such as ACCA, CPA, CA, CMA, or equivalent is strongly preferred.
* MBA or other relevant postgraduate qualification is an advantage.


**Experience**
* 10\+ years of progressive finance experience, including senior finance leadership, controllership, financial operations, reporting, and business partnering.
* Experience in telecom, MVNO, digital services, technology, or other high\-volume consumer businesses is strongly preferred.
* Proven experience managing month\-end close, statutory reporting, audits, tax compliance, financial controls, budgeting, and forecasting.
* Experience working with executive management, commercial teams, auditors, banks, regulators, and external consultants.
* Experience leading finance transformation, SAP S/4HANA, reporting automation, or process improvement projects is an advantage.


**Skills And Attributes**
* Strong understanding of IFRS, financial reporting, management accounting, internal controls, and telecom\-related revenue and cost structures.
* Commercial mindset with the ability to translate financial data into clear business insights and actionable recommendations.
* Excellent analytical, planning, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and meet tight reporting and audit deadlines.
* Strong leadership capability with a hands\-on approach, high accountability, and the ability to develop finance teams.
* High proficiency in Excel, financial reporting tools, ERP systems, and data\-driven finance processes.
* Fluent in English; Arabic is an advantage.


**Knowledge and Expertise**
* IFRS accounting and reporting for telecom operations, including revenue recognition, discounts, commissions, deferred revenue, contract liabilities, and cost matching.
* Financial planning and analysis, budget control, working capital management, cash flow forecasting, and management reporting.
* Tax, VAT, statutory compliance, audit management, and regulatory reporting in Kuwait or GCC markets.
* Revenue assurance, system controls, reconciliation frameworks, and data\-driven reporting in telecom or digital services environments.
* ERP, workflow approval, procurement control, reporting automation, and finance process standardisation.


**What we offer:**
* Rapid learning opportunities \- we enable learning through flexible career paths, exposure to challenging \& meaningful work that will help build and strengthen your expertise.
* Hybrid work environment \- flexibility to work from home 2 days a week in our UAE \& Pakistan offices.
* Healthcare and other local benefits offered in market.


 By submitting your application, you acknowledge and consent to the use of Greenhouse \& BrightHire during the recruitment process. This may include the storage and processing of your data on servers located outside your country of residence. For further information, please contact us at dataprivacy@beyond.one.

***About Odontyn***




 Odontyn is a market place and dental practice\-management platform used by clinics, dentists, and their patients. It covers clinical records, appointments, billing, imaging, telehealth, and integration with external health systems. The product is already in production, and we're actively building on it.
 



  





***The role***




 We're hiring one experienced full\-stack developer to own Odontyn outright: the Laravel
 



 backend, the React frontend, and the AWS infrastructure it runs on. You'd be the only developer on the product. You work directly with the founder, who sets product direction, but how the system is built and how it runs is yours to decide. It's a good fit if you've owned a production system on your own before. You should be steady at shipping, confident making technical decisions, and comfortable working without close oversight.
 



  





***Tech stack***



* **Backend:** 
  PHP 8\.3, Laravel 12, Filament v4, MySQL/MariaDB, Laravel Reverb (websockets)
* **Frontend:** 
  TypeScript, React 19, Vite, TanStack Router and Query, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui
* **Infrastructure:** 
  AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, KMS), Stripe billing
* **Integrations:** 
  HL7 / NABIDH health\-system interoperability, real\-time updates, OpenAI, Deepgram, cloud.



  





***What you'll do***



* Maintain and extend the Laravel API (around 100 data models and 490 endpoints) and the role\-based React single\-page app.
* Build new features end to end, mostly small to medium, with some larger ones.
* Own the AWS side: deployments, EC2/RDS/S3, and setting up a proper CI/CD pipeline, since there isn't one yet.
* Keep production healthy: queue workers, websockets, billing, and monitoring.
* Improve test coverage and code quality as you go.
* Work closely with the founder on priorities and delivery.



  





***What we need***



* 5\+ years of professional full\-stack development experience.
* Strong PHP and Laravel: Eloquent, queues, events, and service\-layer architecture.
* Strong TypeScript and React with modern tooling (Vite, TanStack, component libraries).
* Solid REST API design and relational database skills (MySQL/MariaDB).
* Hands\-on AWS: comfortable owning EC2, RDS, and S3, and building deployment pipelines.
* Able to work independently and take full ownership of a live system.
* Good spoken English, and availability for regular calls and sync\-ups.



  





***Nice to have***



* Experience with the Filament admin framework.
* Healthcare interoperability (HL7, NABIDH) or other regulated\-industry experience.
* Privacy and compliance engineering: consent flows, audit trails, HIPAA or GDPR.
* Stripe billing and real\-time or websocket systems.
* Arabic or RTL internationalization.
* A strong testing habit, especially raising coverage on an under\-tested codebase.



  





***The details***



* Full\-time and fully remote.
* Start date: as soon as possible.
* Some overlap with Kuwait hours (GMT\+3\) is a plus; otherwise flexible, as long as you're reachable for regular calls.
* Compensation: 300–400 KWD per month, depending on experience
* Deadline to submit the application: 12th of June 2026 at 12pm
 
 (GMT\+3\).

**Minimum qualifications:**
* Associate's degree, trade school certification, or other certified training in a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience in critical facility operation management.
* Ability to communicate in English fluently to support stakeholder relationships.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience working in data center environments, including building and operating infrastructure.
* Experience with initiating and executing initiatives in a global environment.
* Experience with operations and people management.
* Ability to forecast resource requirements in a data\-motivated method.
* Ability to perform operational assessment and risk analysis of third\-party sites.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills.


**About the job** 
 At Google, we aim to foster Googley work environments that are collaborative, friendly and fun. The Facilities Management team brings our spaces to life as you oversee the daily operations of our offices. While roles with similar names at other companies can be far more mundane, you're a creative, organized customer service specialist, who takes pride in seeing things run smoothly and efficiently. You go out of your way to make sure that clients are not only satisfied, but singing Google's praises. You're comfortable in a fast\-paced environment with the highest standards of excellence. You aren't afraid to have fun with your job, and bring an enthusiasm, dedication and a collaborative spirit to build and maintain office spaces that facilitate some of the world's most cutting edge innovation.
   

  

 Third\-Party Data Center Operations team provides technical due diligence for site selection, sustains and improves the quality of vendor operated data centers, and mitigates and resolves conflict for critical work risk.
   

  

 In this role, you will focus on reliable operation of the mechanical and electrical infrastructure of data centers, working with the vendor operator for success. You will be involved in co\-location operations for electrical, cooling, and IT infrastructure. You will partner with the Google Data Center Engineering team, Hardware Operations, Network Infrastructure, and third\-party data center vendors and operators with a focus on operability, maintainability, and reliability. You will represent the operations organization, and ensure operability, maintainability, and reliability are critical criteria for Google assets.The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.
   

  

 We're behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own third\-party data centers operation within an area/region with full accountability for this area.
* Support site selection process through operational and technical knowledge.
* Perform operational assessment and risk analysis of third\-party data centers sites.
* Keep main stakeholders informed about current work and discuss decisions and directions with them.
* Contribute to focus area strategy and setting strategy for smaller local groups.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

data.search_title: "Abu Dhabi Health Services" ("Chief Technology Officer" OR CTO OR "Chief Information Officer" OR CIO OR "Head of Technology" OR "IT Director" OR "Head of IT" OR "Chief Digital Officer" OR CDO OR "VP Digital Transformation" OR "Head of Business Excellence" OR PMO OR transformation OR director)
data.jd_text:
The SOC Analyst (L1/L2\) is responsible for continuous monitoring, detection, analysis, and response to cybersecurity threats across enterprise environments. The role supports 24x7 SOC operations, performing real‑time security event monitoring, incident triage, investigation, escalation, and remediation in accordance with established runbooks, SLAs, and client requirements.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

  

- Monitor and analyze security alerts from SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and other security tools to identify potential threats.

- Perform timely triage, validation, and investigation of alerts in accordance with SLA and prioritization matrix (P1–P4\).

- Execute approved containment, response, and remediation actions using defined SOC runbooks.

- Manage incidents through the full case lifecycle, ensuring accurate documentation, status updates, and closure in the case management system.

- Follow standard case handling processes, including case stage/status flow and QA validation requirements.

- Monitor SOC communication channels (e.g., mailbox, SOAR) and ensure timely response to inquiries, escalations, and stakeholder coordination.

- Escalate high\-severity or complex incidents in line with SLAs, including immediate notification for potential P1/P2 cases.

- Ensure SLA compliance and resolution, including coordination with internal and external stakeholders.

- Perform shift\-based operations, including effective handover of active and critical cases with complete context.

- Identify and report operational issues, anomalies, or delays within the same shift to relevant leads.

- Support continuous improvement by supporting in identifying gaps in detection, logging, automation, and case handling processes.

 Technical Skills
   

  

  

- Strong understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals, including threat types, attack vectors, the CIA triad, and awareness of frameworks such as MITRE ATT\&CK for threat identification.

- Working knowledge of operating systems (Windows, Linux/Unix) and networking concepts (TCP/IP, OSI model, DNS, HTTP/S).

- Experience or familiarity with SIEM/SOAR platforms, endpoint protection, firewalls, and security monitoring tools.

- Ability to analyze logs, network traffic, and endpoint telemetry to identify malicious activity.

- Exposure to cloud security concepts (Azure, AWS, or GCP) is an advantage.

- Familiarity with the MITRE ATT\&CK framework for threat identification is an advantage.

- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, Information Technology, or a related field.

- 1–3 years of experience in Security Operations, IT security, or a related role.

- Basic understanding of cybersecurity concepts, threats, and attack methodologies.

- Hands\-on exposure or academic experience with SIEM, SOAR, EDR, or security monitoring tools is an advantage.

- Familiarity with incident handling, alert triage, and case management processes.

- Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail.

- Good written and verbal communication skills for documentation and handover reporting.

- Relevant certifications – e.g., Security\+, SC\-200, CEH (Associate level) – are an advantage but not mandatory.

A new financial markets infrastructure venture is being established in Oman, backed by prominent institutional investors and operating under an international common law framework. We are hiring an IT Operations Officer to own the corporate IT environment: end\-user devices, productivity systems, identity management, IT support, and corporate cybersecurity hygiene.
 



  





 This role covers corporate IT only. Production technology systems sit separately with the technology leadership team
 **.** 




  





**What the role covers** 



* Procurement, configuration, and lifecycle management of laptops, peripherals, and mobile devices; maintaining the device inventory and asset register
* Administering the productivity suite (M365 or equivalent) including mailboxes, file storage, collaboration tools, and licensing
* Identity and access management: account provisioning, role\-based access, multi\-factor authentication, and the joiner\-mover\-leaver process
* First\-line IT support for staff: incident triage, resolution, and escalation to the outsourced managed service provider where needed
* Applying cybersecurity policy to corporate systems: email security, endpoint protection, patching, and security awareness training
* Managing corporate IT vendor relationships, service contracts, and the IT contract register



  





  





**Who we are looking for** 




 At least five years in an IT operations, IT administration, or end\-user computing role. Demonstrated experience administering M365 or equivalent productivity suites. Working knowledge of identity management, MDM, and endpoint security. Fluent in English; working Arabic preferred. Microsoft, CompTIA, or equivalent certifications are an advantage. So is familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001\) and prior experience in a small\-firm or regulated environment.
 



  





**What this is** 




 This is a founding\-team role. The corporate IT environment is being built now, and the person in this role will set it up properly from the start. If you are self\-sufficient, security\-conscious, and want to own your environment rather than operate within one someone else built, this is worth a conversation.

**About Us:** 




 Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is an IT services, consulting and business solutions organization that has been partnering with many of the world’s largest businesses in their transformation journeys for over 50 years. TCS offers a consulting\-led, cognitive powered, integrated portfolio of business, technology and engineering services and solutions. This is delivered through its unique Location Independent Agile™ delivery model, recognized as a benchmark of excellence in software development.
 



 A part of the Tata group, India's largest multinational business group, TCS has over 616,171 of the world’s best\-trained consultants with 157 nationalities in 53 countries. For more information, visit www.tcs.com and follow TCS news at @TCS\_News.
 



  





**Job Description:**




  





 An L1 (Level 1\) Back Office (BO) Support Agent provides initial administrative, technical, or operational support to ensure smooth business functioning. They serve as a "behind\-the\-scenes" frontline agent, processing data, resolving routine requests, and escalating complex issues to L2 support, acting as a bridge between internal teams and client\-facing staff.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 · Ticket Management: Receive, log, acknowledge, and classify incoming requests, incidents, or alerts via email, chat, or ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Remedy).
 



 · Data Processing \& Entry: Enter, update, and maintain accurate records in databases, CRM systems, or ERP software.
 



 · Routine Troubleshooting: Provide first\-line fixes for basic issues such as password resets, account unlocking, software installation, or routine IT application support.
 



 · Documentation \& Reporting: Prepare daily/weekly reports on operational metrics, process documentation (e.g., invoices, bills of lading), and maintain accurate filing systems.
 



 · Escalation: Route complex or unresolved problems to L2/L3 technical teams or managers.
 



 · Vendor/Internal Coordination: Coordinate with internal departments or external vendors to process orders, manage inventory, or request support.
 



 · System Monitoring: Monitor application health or server alerts to identify potential bottlenecks or failures.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 




  





 · Technical Proficiency: Strong knowledge of MS Office Suite (especially Excel—Pivot Tables, VLookup), and familiarity with CRM or ERP tools.
 



 · Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills for updating stakeholders and documenting issues.
 



 · Attention to Detail: Meticulous approach to data entry to prevent costly errors.
 



 · Time Management: Ability to work under tight deadlines and prioritize tasks effectively.
 



 · Education: Typically requires a high school diploma or a Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, IT, or a related field.
 



 Common Roles \& Contexts
 



 · IT Service Desk L1: Remote troubleshooting, Active Directory management, O365 support.
 



 · BO Executive (Finance/HR): Managing employee records, invoicing, and payroll data.
 



 · Operational Support: Order management, tracking deliveries, and vendor coordination.
 



  





**Application Deadline: 20\-June\-2026**

**About the Company**
 Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
   

  

 Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2\.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70\+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.
   

  

***We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem\-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.***
**The Mission**
 We believe the transformative potential of AI is significantly under\-realised in our region. To bridge this gap, we are incubating a new division within Careem dedicated to Enterprise AI Transformation.
   

  

 We are reimagining and building the future of work to simplify and improve how businesses function in the era of GenAI with WorkOS: a next\-generation ‘operating system’ designed to deploy, orchestrate, and improve AI agents across every customer and operational journey (and increasingly autonomously). This isn’t just automation; it’s about creating a hybrid workforce where self\-learning AI agents handle the heavy lifting, empowering our people to focus on the highest\-value, most creative work.
   

  

**The Team**
 This group operates as a startup within Careem with a distinct mandate: move fast, build boldly, and deliver production\-grade AI systems that fundamentally change how the region leverages technology.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are looking for an exceptional founding Backend Engineer to build the WorkOS platform. This is a role for a systems\-thinker who wants to work at the intersection of high\-scale distributed systems and AI orchestration. You will be responsible for building the "brain" of WorkOS, the engine that deploys and manages autonomous agents across the region’s most complex operational journeys at massive scale.
   

  

 As one of the first engineers in WorkOS, you will have a disproportionate impact on our technical foundation, culture, and the speed at which we move from 0 to 1\.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Architect and Build the WorkOS Engine: Design and build the scalable backend services and architectures required to orchestrate complex AI workflows and real\-time data streaming. Leverage novel technologies to build cutting\-edge capabilities.
* Set the Engineering Gold Standard: As a founding member, you will establish our backend best practices, from CI/CD and observability to security and system integrity, ensuring a high\-velocity but rigorous engineering culture.
* Solve for Distributed Complexity: Navigate the unique challenges of integrating AI agents into legacy enterprise stacks, ensuring low\-latency communication and robust data consistency.
* Database design: Build our data infrastructure, leveraging relational, schemaless, and vector stores to power the platform and create persistent brains for our Agents.
* Full\-Cycle Ownership: Own the lifecycle of the platform, from rapid prototyping of new agent capabilities to maintaining production\-grade systems at enterprise scale.
* Drive AI\-Accelerated Engineering: Constantly experiment with AI\-assisted development to move faster than traditional teams, while maintaining a bar for superb technical quality and craft.
* Lead Pioneer Deployments: While building the core platform, you will occasionally lead the charge on first\-of\-their\-kind implementations for strategic partners, ensuring our tech solves real\-world operational complexity.
* Operate with High Agency: In this lean, startup\-style environment, you will be responsible for outcomes over inputs, rolling your sleeves up to code and balancing investments in the long\-term technical roadmap with the need to ship value quickly.


**What You’ll Need**
* 8–12\+ years of professional backend engineering experience, with significant tenure acting as a Staff Engineer or Technical Lead for complex, high\-scale distributed systems.
* Mastery of Backend Systems: Deep expertise in languages like Python, Go, or Node.js, with a proven track record of architecting concurrency, microservices, and high\-throughput data pipelines.
* AI\-Native Infrastructure Depth: Hands\-on experience with LLM orchestration (LangChain, etc.), vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus), and RAG architectures at a production\-grade level.
* Systems\-Level Visionary: The ability to design "platform\-first", thinking in terms of APIs, modularity, and extensibility so that the WorkOS core can support infinite customer use cases.
* Obsession with Performance: A specialist's focus on latency and system observability; you believe that AI interactions must feel "instant" and "bulletproof" to be valuable.
* Startup\-level Autonomy: Comfortable navigating a "0\-to\-1" environment where you define the technical roadmap and ship high\-quality code without a playbook.
* Willingness to work on\-site full time in UAE, to foster the high\-intensity collaboration required for this incubation phase.
* Experience with enterprise software transformation or legacy system integration is a significant plus.


**What You’ll Receive**
* A Blank Canvas and Live Ammunition: The rare opportunity to build a "0\-to\-1" product while immediately deploying it into the real\-world operations of a regional giant. No "sandbox" projects here, you’ll be shipping code that moves people and goods on day one. This is a huge opportunity to create impact in our region.
* Architecting the Engine: We’re a lean, impact\-obsessed team operating with total autonomy. You’ll be free from corporate bureaucracy and legacy baggage, focused entirely on building the core orchestration layer and agentic frameworks that will serve as the "brain" of the region’s enterprises.
* Direct Collaboration with Leadership: Direct engagement with Careem and enterprise client leadership, in addition to working side\-by\-side with the WorkOS founding team including Magnus Olsson (Careem’s original Co\-founder).
* Competitive Compensation: Including direct equity in this new division. Our philosophy is meritocratic: we want you to own a meaningful stake in the value you create.


**What We’ll Provide You**
 We offer colleagues the opportunity to drive impact in the region while they learn and grow. As a full time Careem colleague, you will be able to:
   

  

* Work and learn from great minds by joining a community of inspiring colleagues.
* Put your passion to work in a purposeful organisation dedicated to creating impact in a region with a lot of untapped potential.
* Explore new opportunities to learn and grow every day.
* Work remotely from any country in the world for 30 days a year with unlimited vacation days per year.
* Access to healthcare benefits and fitness reimbursements for health activities including gym, health club, and training classes.
